izzyondroid:app.rikka.savecopy.name: Save a copy
izzyondroid:app.rikka.savecopy.summary: A very simple app that makes a copy of the opened file.
izzyondroid:app.rikka.savecopy.description:
One of the biggest changes of Android 11 is that all apps targeting 30 can only access its' private folder. In the future, all updated apps are subject to this restriction.
 However, some apps do not give users a good experience. For example, some chat apps, save "files received from other users" to their private folder. In the future, private folders can only be accessed by the app itself, and other applications (including the file manager) and the file selector of the system cannot be accessed. This means that the user must open the app to open the file. This is very inconvenient and unreasonable. The correct approach is to save user files to a public folder (such as the "Download" folder).
 At least those apps allow the user to open files with other apps. So we have a chance. This app does a very simple job, declares that it can open all types of files and copying the opened file to a public folder. From this, users can easily find these files.
 How to use: 
 Select this app in "open with" and the file will be copied to the "Download" folder. On Android 10 and lower, storage permission is required.
 Note: This app does not have an interface, to uninstall, you may need to go to system settings.

* Import a PDF pattern: sections, rows and sizes are rebuilt automatically,

fdroid:fr.gildasledrogoff.fwknop.name: FwKnop-ng
fdroid:fr.gildasledrogoff.fwknop.summary: Classic port knocking and SPA (Fwknop) client + Wake-on-LAN
fdroid:fr.gildasledrogoff.fwknop.description:
FwKnop-ng is an Android client to open firewall ports and wake machines remotely. It supports fwknop (Single Packet Authorization), classic port knocking and Wake-on-LAN.
With fwknop, it sends an encrypted, authenticated SPA packet that makes a fwknopd server open a firewall port for your IP address. With classic port knocking, it sends a configurable sequence of ports with a delay between packets. With Wake-on-LAN, it wakes up a machine on your network.
 Features 
 Three modes: fwknop SPA, classic port knocking and Wake-on-LAN
 Rijndael (AES) and GPG (via OpenKeychain) encryption, HMAC authentication
 Configurations stored encrypted (Android Keystore, Tink, SQLCipher)
 Optional app lock (biometrics or device credential)
 Encrypted backup and restore of all configurations
 Import/export of configurations through QR codes
 NFC tag triggered knocks
 Note: configurations are bound to the device's Android Keystore. Removing the screen lock or a factory reset makes them unrecoverable: keep your fwknop keys elsewhere, or use the encrypted backup.

fdroid:io.github.snood21.workprofilevpns.name: Work Profile VPN Switcher
fdroid:io.github.snood21.workprofilevpns.summary: Automatically manage work profile when VPN connects or disconnects
fdroid:io.github.snood21.workprofilevpns.description:
App for automatically managing an Android work profile when a VPN connects.
Monitors VPN connections and automatically disables the work profile while a VPN is active, then restores its state after the VPN disconnects. Useful when the work profile contains apps that should not run through the VPN tunnel, or conversely, when work apps need to be isolated from VPN traffic.
Features:
* Automatic disabling of the work profile when VPN connects
* State restoration after VPN disconnects (optional)
* Tracking manual work profile activation while a VPN is active (optional) — choose whether to disable the profile again, or disable the VPN itself instead, keeping the profile enabled (dummy VPN, requires VPN connection permission)
* Allowlist mode — monitor only selected VPN apps
* Denylist mode — monitor all VPN connections except excluded apps (useful for AdGuard)
* Background polling — fallback VPN-detection mechanism
* Russian and English interface
Requirements:
* Android 11 (API 30) or higher
* A configured work profile (via Shelter or similar app)
* MODIFY_QUIET_MODE permission — granted manually via ADB:
 adb shell pm grant io.github.snood21.workprofilevpnswitcher android.permission.MODIFY_QUIET_MODE
* For disabling VPN via the dummy VPN — VPN connection permission, requested through a system dialog when enabling that option
Note: the MODIFY_QUIET_MODE permission must be re-granted after a clean reinstall. It persists through regular updates.
If automatic profile disabling on VPN connect does not work, enable Background polling in Advanced settings. Also allow autostart and set battery mode to No restrictions in system settings.

fdroid:org.traffxml.roadeagle.name: RoadEagle
fdroid:org.traffxml.roadeagle.description:
RoadEagle retrieves traffic information from various open data portals (most of them made available by road operators), displays the data in a list and makes it available to TraFF-aware applications, such as Navit.
Currently Poland and Lithuania are supported. A data connection is required.
The actual data reported may vary between countries. Also, as RoadEagle needs to convert the data from different formats to TraFF, it may not be able to represent all traffic messages as intended by their creators.
This app receives requests from compatible apps (consumers) which may expose the device location (and, possibly, where you intend to travel). Because of the location information, consumer apps may refuse to send such requests to apps without location permission. This is the only thing RoadEagle uses this permission for; it will never request a location update. 
Photo by Joanna Pędzich-Opioła | CC_BY 2.0

fdroid:takagi.ru.monica.fdroid.name: Monica F-Droid
fdroid:takagi.ru.monica.fdroid.summary: Open-source password manager: local encryption, autofill, TOTP, Passkey
fdroid:takagi.ru.monica.fdroid.description:
Monica is a local-first password manager built with modern Android technologies (Jetpack Compose, Material 3). This is the F-Droid build: it contains no Google Play Services and no proprietary SDKs.
 Credential management 
* Zero-knowledge vault: AES-256-GCM encryption keyed by your master password (PBKDF2), wrapped by the Android Keystore (TEE/SE)
* Store passwords, secure notes, bank cards, ID documents, billing addresses, Wi-Fi and SSH keys
* Password generator, strength analysis (zxcvbn), breach-style security analysis
* Recycle bin, entry history, snapshots
 Two-factor authentication 
* Built-in TOTP/HOTP authenticator with 2-column code grid
* Steam Guard support (optional integration; only contacts Steam servers when you use it)
* Post-fill one-tap code popup after autofill
 Autofill & Passkeys 
* System autofill service with overlay picker and inline suggestions
* Dedicated input-method (keyboard) autofill with biometric unlock
* Passkey provider for Android 14+ (create and use passkeys from other apps)
 Sync & backup — your cloud, your rules 
* WebDAV sync and encrypted backups (Nextcloud, Synology, self-hosted)
* KeePass (.kdbx) read/write compatibility
* Bitwarden account import/sync (works with self-hosted Vaultwarden)
* Encrypted local backups with optional auto-backup
* Plain-HTTP WebDAV is blocked by default and requires an explicit opt-in per app settings
 F-Droid build notes 
* OneDrive/Google Drive cloud sync and SMS autofill (Play Services based) are removed in this build
* The native MDBX database engine is compiled from source during the F-Droid build
* Optional Steam integration connects to Steam's own servers, declared as NonFreeNet
 Permissions 
Camera is used only for QR code scanning. Biometrics are used only for local vault unlock. No analytics, no tracking, no ads.

fdroid:xyz.waozi.inbe.description:
Inner Breeze is a free, open-source app for breathing, meditation, yoga and daily habits. No ads and no account needed. It works offline and keeps your data on your device.
PRACTICES
- Wim Hof Breathing: guided rounds of deep breaths and timed breath holds, based on the Wim Hof Method, with a chart of your hold times.
- Breathing patterns: Box, 4-7-8, Coherent and Extended exhale, or set your own rhythm.
- Meditation timer with an interval bell and optional background music. You can import your own music.
- Sun Salutation: follow a painted guide through all twelve poses. Choose one of four characters and set the tempo and number of rounds.
HABITS
- Track daily habits with simple check-ins or counts.
- Week and month calendars, streaks and statistics.
- Link a habit to a practice, and finished sessions count toward it.
- A quick mood check-in after each practice.
YOUR APPS
- Open Lumi, Practices, Habits, Lists and Diary from Apps, and keep your favorites close.
- Keep plans in Lists and daily thoughts in Diary.
LUMI
- Ask Lumi to start a practice, add a to-do, write to today’s Diary or change your theme.
- Local app commands work offline. Online conversation is optional, with a daily allowance for connected accounts.
YOUR DATA
- Everything is stored on your device.
- Import and export your data, or export sessions as CSV or to Health Connect.
- Optional account sync between your devices.
MAKE IT YOURS
- Light and dark themes in many colors.
- Available in 12 languages.
- Also runs in your browser and on Windows and Linux: inbe.waozi.xyz
Never do breathing exercises while driving, standing or in water.
Inner Breeze is open source under the BSD 3-Clause license: github.com/waozixyz/breeze

apple-macos:6792059326.name: LivingAbroad - VPN & Smart DNS
apple-macos:6792059326.description:
Movie night, sorted: UK and US TV, wherever you are.
LivingAbroad unlocks BBC iPlayer, ITVX, Channel 4 and the US catalogs of Netflix, Peacock, HBO Max and more, wherever you are. Turn it on, open your streaming app, press play.
Try it free for 7 days. No card needed.
ONE TAP, NOTHING TO SET UP 
No servers or countries to pick. Sign in, turn it on, and LivingAbroad keeps working in the background while you watch.
UK AND US TV, WITH YOUR OWN ACCOUNTS 
• UK: BBC iPlayer, ITVX, Channel 4, Channel 5, Sky Go, NOW 
• US streaming: Netflix, Hulu, Peacock, Paramount+, HBO Max, Prime Video, Disney+, Sling, Crunchyroll, DAZN 
• US TV networks: ABC, CBS, FOX, AMC, PBS, Comedy Central, TBS, TNT, USA Network 
• Live TV and catch-up wherever the service offers them. 
You keep your own subscriptions. LivingAbroad handles the connection.
ON EVERY SCREEN 
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Sign in with the same account on each.
FASTER THAN A VPN 
A traditional VPN sends everything through a distant server, which slows you down and can upset banking and work apps. LivingAbroad only handles the DNS lookup that tells a streaming service where you are. The stream itself and everything else go over your normal connection, at full speed.
REAL PEOPLE KEEP IT RUNNING 
We keep an eye on every service and fix hiccups fast, usually before you notice. If you need us, help is one message away.
HOW IT WORKS 
LivingAbroad sets up an on-device VPN connection that sends your device's DNS lookups (the website names your apps look up) to our servers, so supported streaming services see the right country. Your streams and all other traffic don't pass through our servers, and we never sell or share your data. The app shows exactly what we receive before you turn it on.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

# Markdown Editor for Writing
 **Scratchmark** is a pleasant text editor for writing. It tries to give you everything you need
 and otherwise stay out of your way so you can just focus on the text. The app can be used for writing
 essays and making quick notes alike. Its file management is built around a folder structure that
 can handle large projects with lots of files. You can add any folder on your computer to the library,
 and move files around by dragging and dropping.
 It uses Markdown, which means that ==all text formatting can be done by typing.==
 The editor is simple and intuitive, so anyone should be able to just pick it up and start writing.
 It can display simple writing statistics, and has features, such as focus mode and fullscreen support
 to reduce distractions.
 Markdown is an open and widely used markup language. Documents created with Scratchmark are
 more or less compatible with other similar apps. If you already have a "notebook" or a project
 from another app, you can just add the folder to Scratchmark's library. This also goes the other
 way: if you've had enough of Scratchmark, it's easy to switch to something else.

 the crypt, the garden, the corrupted sanctuary, the guard's quarters, and the alchemist's lab.
 Many obstacles and enemies will be in your way before you can purge the evil from the tower.
 Find the keys, solve the puzzles, and defeat the wight!

This builds on the principle of Sparklines defined by Edward Tufte and makes them easier to use. Sparklines are currently available as plugins or javascript elements. By installing the Sparks font you can use them immediately without the need for custom code. Sparks data needs to be formatted as comma-separated values, with curly brackets at both ends of the set, e.g., {30,60,90}. You can also have numbers at the beginning and end of the set, which are useful for providing the start and end points, e.g., 123{30,60,90}456 – Sparks has numerals built in. This package provides the Dot family.

fedora-packages:gfs-neohellenic-fonts/gf.name: gfs-neohellenic-fonts
fedora-packages:gfs-neohellenic-fonts/gf.summary: GFS NeoHellenic, a 20th century round Greek font family
fedora-packages:gfs-neohellenic-fonts/gf.description: The design of new Greek typefaces always followed the growing needs of the Classical Studies in the major European Universities. Furthermore, by the end of the 19th century bibliology had become an established section of Historical Studies, and, as John Bowman commented, the prevailing attitude was that Greek types should adhere to a lost idealized, yet undefined, Greekness of yore. Especially in Great Britain this tendency remained unchallenged in the first decades of the 20th century, both by Richard Proctor, curator of the incunabula section in the British Museum Library and his successor Victor Scholderer. In 1927, Scholderer, on behalf of the Society for the Promotion of Greek Studies, got involved in choosing and consulting the design and production of a Greek type called New Hellenic cut by the Lanston Monotype Corporation. He chose the revival of a round, and almost mono-line type which had first appeared in 1492 in the edition of Macrobius, ascribable to the printing shop of Giovanni Rosso (Joannes Rubeus) in Venice. New Hellenic was the only successful typeface in Great Britain after the introduction of Porson Greek well over a century before. The type, since to 1930’s, was also well received in Greece, albeit with a different design for Ksi and Omega. GFS digitized the typeface (1993-1994) funded by the Athens Archeological Society with the addition of a new set of epigraphical symbols. Later (2000) more weights were added (italic, bold and bold italic) as well as a Latin version.

fedora-packages:lutok/lutok.description: Lutok provides thin C++ wrappers around the Lua C API to ease the interaction between C++ and Lua. These wrappers make intensive use of RAII to prevent resource leakage, expose C++-friendly data types, report errors by means of exceptions and ensure that the Lua stack is always left untouched in the face of errors. The library also provides a small subset of miscellaneous utility functions built on top of the wrappers. Lutok focuses on providing a clean and safe C++ interface; the drawback is that it is not suitable for performance-critical environments. In order to implement error-safe C++ wrappers on top of a Lua C binary library, Lutok adds several layers or abstraction and error checking that go against the original spirit of the Lua C API and thus degrade performance.

This extension is required to maintain the full functionality of Y-Productive`s application. Install it to:

★ add a “Focus mode” option to your tasks in-app

★ develop a highly productive habit to concentrate on important goals and keep your focus as long as you need it
★ maintain the access to useful website’s features even if it’s blocked: just add the feature`s full address (sub-url) as a new entry and categorize it to “Productive” list.

Download Y-Productive productivity tracker by the following link:
 https://www.y-productive.com/ 
Like us on Facebook and follow new updates:
 https://www.facebook.com/yproductive/

firefox-addons:2847581.name: Ozon, Wildberries and Simaland customizer
firefox-addons:2847581.summary: Ozon, Wildberries and Simaland: sorting reviews by product by ascending rating, and other features
firefox-addons:2847581.description:
Marketplaces do not sort reviews by rating in product descriptions - you have to additionally press the sorting buttons. In catalogs, the “stars” under product images are not links to ratings - you have to open the product card. This is part of marketing: to remove bad reviews away and sell more goods, while it is the bad reviews that are the most objective. Reviews are embedded with annoying advertisements that make reading difficult.
This extension sorts reviews in ascending order of rating - from bad to good, and for catalogs it implements a link to reviews for "stars". Optimizes the interface: removes annoying advertising inserts, places the product description immediately below the image, collapses little-used distracting blocks such as “Similar products”, “Also recommended”, “Buy together” and moves them below, etc.
The extension is Open Source and hosted on GitHub.
Suitable for mobile versions of browsers and websites.
On mobile devices, extensions are supported by the following browsers: Yandex browser, Mozilla Firefox, Kiwi, Opera, Dolphin, Samsung Internet. Does not support Google Chrome extensions.
On mobile devices, marketplace applications will not allow reviews to be sorted by ascending rating by default. Instead, you can use a browser with this extension, where you can open the website of the corresponding marketplace. For ease of launch, browsers allow you to add a shortcut on the screen to the website of each marketplace, which will open in the browser. Mobile versions of marketplace sites are almost as good as apps in terms of functionality and convenience.

firefox-addons:3058952.description:
Every tool on toolz.dev, one keystroke from wherever you are.
Press Alt+T, type three letters, hit Enter. No aiming at a toolbar icon, no
tab full of bookmarks, no remembering which site had the JSON formatter.
RUNS IN THE POPUP, OFFLINE
Five tools work without opening a tab and without a network connection:
• Base64 encode and decode, Unicode-safe
 • JSON format and minify, with the parse error if there is one
 • URL encode and decode, both encodeURIComponent and encodeURI
 • SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashing
 • Case conversion: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT
Whatever you paste is transformed in the popup on your own machine. It is
never uploaded, never logged, and never leaves the browser.
FINDS THE REST
Search the whole catalogue by name, keyword or category, or browse 28
categories: PDF, image, data, CSS, SEO, security, converters, calculators and
more. Favorite the ones you use and they stay at the top.
Type "tz" in the address bar to search without opening the popup at all.
WHAT IT ASKS FOR
One permission: storage, to remember your favorites on this device.
No account. No host permissions, so it cannot read or change the pages you
visit. No content scripts. No analytics, no tracking, no profile. Your
favorites are stored on your device and are never sent anywhere.
Free, no signup, no account: https://toolz.dev

firefox-addons:2927490.description:
Enables AI agents to control browser features through a local-only connection . This add-on provides AI assistants with safe access to tab management, browsing history, page search, and webpage content via a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) connection.
 Security-focused design: The add-on does not support arbitrary scripting or web page modifications. bluejetty:00090593:ios.name: Speedometer GPS: Speed Monitor
bluejetty:00090593:ios.summary: Speedometer GPS: Speed Monitor is a high-precision GPS speedometer that integrates speed monitoring, trip recording, HUD head-up display, speeding reminder and other functions. It provides real-time and accurate speed tracking and navigat
bluejetty:00090593:ios.description:
Speedometer GPS: Speed Monitor is a high-precision GPS speedometer that integrates speed monitoring, trip recording, HUD head-up display, speeding reminder and other functions. It provides real-time and accurate speed tracking and navigation assistance for drivers, cyclists, runners and outdoor explorers. Whether it is daily commuting, long-distance travel, or racing competition, this Speedometer app is your ideal choice!
Core functions
Accurate GPS speed measurement
Relying on high-precision GPS technology, it displays the current speed, average speed, and maximum speed in real time to ensure accurate speed measurement. Supports kilometer/hour (km/h) and mile/hour (mph) two unit switching.
Smart speeding alarm
Set a personalized speed limit value. Once the speed is exceeded, the application will issue an alarm to remind you, effectively preventing speeding and helping you drive safely. And it supports 4 preset speed limits, which can be switched with a single click, allowing you to operate more safely while driving!
HUD head-up display mode
After enabling HUD mode, place the phone under the windshield to project the speed information onto the windshield, making night driving safer.
Driving data record
Automatically record detailed data such as travel time, driving distance, stay time, altitude, etc. Allowing you to easily view historical travel data or share it.
Built-in map
The built-in map can display the current location in real time and draw the driving trajectory to prevent getting lost.
Picture-in-Picture Mode (PiP)
Enable Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode to view speed information in real time while using other applications.
Suitable for scenarios such as navigation and music playback, so that speed measurement no longer affects other operations.
The window size and position can be adjusted to ensure the best visual experience while driving.
Altimeter & Altitude Measurement
Built-in accurate altitude measurement function, real-time monitoring of current altitude, suitable for mountain driving, cycling and outdoor adventures.
Speedometer helps you drive safely, accurately measure speed, and avoid speeding tickets! Download now to experience professional speed measurement service!
Free features:
The following core features are available without a subscription:
Real-time speed measurement
Remaining mileage statistics
Set maximum speed limit
Subscription features (premium features):
Unlock the full feature experience and obtain access through subscription:
Head-up display (HUD) mode
Picture-in-picture (PIP) mode
Map navigation integration
Driving data recording and statistics
Change speed dashboard style
Automatic renewal terms
Subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account. Payment will be charged to the account immediately after confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the renewal amount will be determined. Users can manage or cancel subscriptions in "Settings" > "Apple ID" > "Subscriptions". After the free trial (if any) ends, the system will automatically start the subscription according to the selected plan unless canceled in advance.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/duyou-privacy-policy
Terms: https://sites.google.com/view/duyou-terms

bluejetty:00200091:ios.name: Beadfall: Fidget Beads & ASMR
bluejetty:00200091:ios.summary:
A small handful of beads, held inside your watch.
Tilt your wrist and they fall. Hold still and they settle. Flick it and they climb the wall, break against it, and rain back down. None of this is animation. Nine hundred beads are simulate
bluejetty:00200091:ios.description:
A small handful of beads, held inside your watch.
Tilt your wrist and they fall. Hold still and they settle. Flick it and they climb the wall, break against it, and rain back down. None of this is animation. Nine hundred beads are simulated sixty times a second, pulled by the gravity your wrist is actually moving through.
There is nothing to achieve here. No score, no streaks, no levels, no timers, no notifications, no account, and nothing to buy. You paid once; the whole toy is yours.
It is a fidget toy for the thing you already wear. Something for your hands during a long call, a slow queue, the boring middle of the day. Watching the beads pour scratches the same itch as bubble wrap, an hourglass, a snow globe. Except this one lives on your wrist and answers every movement you make.
WHAT IT IS
• Nine hundred beads, solved on the watch in real time. Real physics, not a looping video
• Sixty frames a second
• Gravity from the watch's own motion sensor, so the beads answer your wrist rather than following a script
• A watch-face complication: one tap from the face, no hunting through the app grid
• Entirely standalone. No iPhone app required
WHAT IT ISN'T
• There is no network code in this app. Not disabled, not opt-out. Absent
• No analytics, no accounts, no ads, no tracking, no subscriptions
• Motion readings move the beads, then vanish. Nothing is stored, nothing is sent
WHO IT'S FOR
Anyone who kept a fidget toy in a desk drawer, pops bubble wrap slowly, or watches bead-pouring videos on loop. If tilting a little box of beads back and forth sounds like nothing, this is not your app. If it sounds like the best thing you'll do in your next meeting, it is.
Beadfall is small on purpose. It does one thing, does it honestly, and gets out of the way.

bluejetty:00166740:ios.summary: Arike is India's first vernacular dating app that is designed to bring Malayalis residing in and outside India closer for one common reason — finding long-lasting relationships. The word 'arike' translates to 'close-by' in Malayalam. So, th
bluejetty:00166740:ios.description:
Arike is India's first vernacular dating app that is designed to bring Malayalis residing in and outside India closer for one common reason — finding long-lasting relationships. The word 'arike' translates to 'close-by' in Malayalam. So, the app is designed to offer high-intent dating experience that is culturally aligned with Malayali needs. Arike's unique approach to appreciating sensitivities has made it one of the fastest-growing vernacular dating apps in the country. 
Features:
Setting Cultural Preferences: Arike appreciates the Malayali cultural nuances and choices that define Malayali ways of living. We have the preference features on the app that is tailor-made to make sure you find what you're looking for in a person. And to help you in breaking the ice, we host a gamut of Keralan pop culture references that you can use in your profile answers — from food to TV shows and cinema.
Send 'Notes': Arike 'Notes' serves as the best kind of conversation starter which lets users express their interest in someone you really like, by writing to them directly. For all we know, you are just an effort away from the right match.
Arike 'Premium': Arike 'Premium' is an in-app paid feature through which you can send more requests and notes, see who sent you requests and unlock more preferences. 
Arike 'Select': Arike 'Select' is our latest paid feature with everything you need to find your perfect match quickly. Get all the goodness of 'Premium', plus access profiles in the 'Select' tab with more preferences and send unlimited Notes. If you are looking to meet someone who finds the backwaters of Kerala equally romantic as you do, Arike is absolutely the dating app you should be on.
In-app Purchases: 
Arike Notes
Arike Premium
Arike Select
Notable Interview:
Hindustan Times: https://bit.ly/3ikeAlt 
---------------------------------------------
If you choose to purchase Arike Premium or Arike Select, payment will be charged to your Apple account. These subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription through the App Store settings post-purchase. Arike Premium comes in a 1-week pack for $3.99, a 1-month pack for $10.99, a 3-month pack for $17.49, and a 6-month pack for $28.99, while Arike Select comes in a 1-week pack for $9.99, a 1-month pack for $14.99, a 3-month pack for $24.99, and a 6-month pack for $34.99. Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US, and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of current subscriptions is allowed during the active subscription period.
For more information, please visit these links - 
Terms: https://www.arike.in/terms_conditions.html
Privacy: https://www.arike.in/privacy_policy.html
Support: https://arikeapp.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

bluejetty:00032771:ios.description:
Gear up for an electrifying Vehicle driving experience with Urban Street Car Driver. Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action of this realistic car driving simulator where every moment behind the wheel feels alive. Break through the bustling streets, conquer challenging traffic scenarios, and unleash the power of boost to dominate the urban roads.
Realistic Driving:
Step into the driver's seat of this cutting-edge car simulator and immerse yourself in a dynamic city environment teeming with lifelike traffic patterns and formidable obstacles. Test your truck driving skills in the immersive virtual cityscape and conquer every corner of the urban jungle. Whether you're a seasoned racer craving high-speed thrills or a casual gamer seeking adrenaline-pumping excitement, city car driving simulator guarantees hours of immersive gameplay and endless fun.
Unleash the Urban Power:
Engage in heart-pounding races where you can challenge rivals from across the globe. You can enjoy bus & jetski racing, car stunts, challenging parking levels, stunt crash missions along with various vehicles driving in this game. With customizable cars, intuitive control and a vast array of tracks to conquer, urban rush offers various possibilities for customization and excitement. So rev up your engines, tighten your grip, and brace yourself for the ride of a lifetime in this adrenaline-fueled driving game.
Navigate the Open world City:
Traversing the urban landscape of car driving amidst realistic day-night cycles and dynamic weather effects, each car drive offers a fresh and immersive experience. Experience the thrill of realistic car physics and dynamic drifting mechanics as you navigate the open world. Whether you're chasing the excitement of a police chase, urban rush invites you to explore the city like never before. Hit the gas and let the city streets become your playground in this ultimate car driving game.
Don't miss out the opportunity to experience the excitement of city street racing in one package. Try Street Racing Adventure and prepare to unleash your inner urban racer!

bluejetty:00137413:ios.name: L8R Cam - Vintage Film Camera
bluejetty:00137413:ios.summary:
Capture photos worth keeping. L8R creates warm, grainy, and cinematic photos that feel like memories.
Shoot on film
Choose a film stock and shoot. Every frame is captured in Bayer RAW, straight off the sensor with none of your phone's auto
bluejetty:00137413:ios.description:
Capture photos worth keeping. L8R creates warm, grainy, and cinematic photos that feel like memories.
Shoot on film
Choose a film stock and shoot. Every frame is captured in Bayer RAW, straight off the sensor with none of your phone's automatic processing. The film look is built on the real image, not a polished one. Shoot instantly and see every photo as you take it, or load a roll and let the anticipation build.
Real film, not a filter
Every film stock is built from a real LUT. True color science, not a one-tap preset. A grain engine tuned to each film's speed, split-tone color, and a subtle halation glow give every frame the texture and light of actual film, down to the way light blooms around the highlights.
The look
Golden hour warmth. Soft, hazy shadows. Grain that feels alive. Nine handcrafted films, each with its own character, from warm and nostalgic to cool and cinematic. Your everyday photos, but with soul.
Shoot a roll
For the full analog experience, load a roll and commit. Your shots stay hidden until you develop, then reveal all at once. That anticipation of not knowing exactly what you caught is the part every filter app skips. Worth the wait, every time.
Create your own films
The Film Lab lets you build your own film stock from scratch. Color, grain, and character, all yours.
Redevelop
Reprocess any photo with a different film or effect, anytime. Every photo saves to your library automatically.
L8R isn't about adding a filter. It's about making photos that feel like film.
*Subscription or purchase may be required for certain modes and features*
Privacy Policy: https://l8r.camera/privacy
Terms of Service: https://l8r.camera/terms

bluejetty:00182501:ios.name: Strava: Run, Bike, Walk
bluejetty:00182501:ios.summary:
*App Store Award Winner -Apple Watch App of the Year*
Strava makes fitness tracking social. We house your entire active journey in one spot – and you get to share it with friends. Here’s how:
• Record everything – runs, rides, hikes, yoga
bluejetty:00182501:ios.description:
*App Store Award Winner -Apple Watch App of the Year*
Strava makes fitness tracking social. We house your entire active journey in one spot – and you get to share it with friends. Here’s how:
• Record everything – runs, rides, hikes, yoga and over 50+ other sport types. Think of Strava as the homebase of your movement.
• See the full story of your strength training – Lifting in the gym weekly, doing HIIT workouts, and showing up to your group weight training classes? Use your favorite device or strength app and your exercises, sets, reps, weights and a muscle map show up automatically. Or start your strength journey today and see how quickly strength workouts become a key part of your active life.
• Discover anywhere – our Routes tool uses de-identified Strava data to intelligently recommend popular routes based on your preferences. You can also build your own.
• Uncover popular hiking Routes in your area, including local favorites, scenic trails, and long-distance climbs
• Build a support network – Strava’s about celebrating movement. Here you’ll find your community and cheer each other on.
• Train smarter – get data insights to understand your progress and see how you improve. Your Training Log is the record of all your workouts.
• Get more from your workout – Powered by AI, Athlete Intelligence turns workout data into into instant insights. Keeping you motivated and ready for the next workout – without the guesswork.
• Move safer – share your real-time location with loved ones while outdoors for an extra layer of safety.
• Sync your favorite apps and devices – Strava is compatible with thousands of them (Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin – you name it).
• Join and create challenges – join millions in monthly challenges to chase new goals, collect digital badges and stay accountable.
• Embrace the unfiltered – your feed on Strava is filled with real efforts from real people. That’s how we motivate each other.
• Whether you’re a world-class athlete or a total beginner, you belong here. Just record and go.
Strava includes both a free version and a subscription version with premium features.
Strava uses HealthKit to export your Strava activities into the Health app and to read heart rate and biometric data.
You can subscribe and pay on the App Store, using your Apple ID. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renew may be turned off after purchase by going to the ‘Manage Subscription’ page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost.
Terms of Service: https://www.strava.com/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.strava.com/legal/privacy

Immerse yourself in a pixelated warzone adventure where you take command as the ultimate hero. The battleground is alive with chaos, and your mission is clear: survive, shoot down enemies, and constantly upgrade your abilities to become an unstoppable force.

bluejetty:00062791:ios.name: Train Kit: Wild West
bluejetty:00062791:ios.summary:
Welcome to Train Kit: Wild West. Build a railroad, grab your cowboy hat and jump aboard! 
BUILD A RAILROAD
It's easy to build railroads by dragging track squares onto your world. Add straights, curves, tunnels, wooden bridges and switch
bluejetty:00062791:ios.description:
Welcome to Train Kit: Wild West. Build a railroad, grab your cowboy hat and jump aboard! 
BUILD A RAILROAD
It's easy to build railroads by dragging track squares onto your world. Add straights, curves, tunnels, wooden bridges and switching tracks. There are no rules and everything is done on the same screen; change or add to your track as the trains run around. Your worlds are saved automatically so you can come back to them at any time.
WILD WEST WORLDS
Choose a canyon to build in. Add some steam trains and then bring your Wild West world to life with town buildings, stations, oil wells, windpumps, cactuses and much more!
3D TRAIN DRIVER
Train Driver view allows you to get onboard your trains and take a journey through the world you have created in first person 3D. 
TRAIN KIT
A standalone game based on the much loved Train Kit. Included in the App Store best of 2016!
FEATURES
+ Add track tiles which snap together in a grid
+ Rocky tunnels and wooden bridges
+ Switching tracks allow your trains to take different routes by tapping the switch button.
+ Drop steam trains and carriages onto your railroad.
+ Mix locomotives and carriages to create your own unique trains
+ Simple train controls allow you to speed up, slow down or reverse your trains
+ Add scenery objects to your world
+ Switch trains in 3D Train driver view
REVIEWS FOR TRAIN KIT
“While recommended for ages 6-8, this kid-at-heart loves playing with Train Kit. The simple to use touch controls make it a joy to create train lines and diorama, then watch the trains run through your custom worlds, even in first person view.”
“This is a great little app. It is fun and simple to play. Almost like having one of those small wooden train sets. Easy assembly of the tracks and just drag objects to the water boundary to remove. This is a good game for little kids because there are no in app purchases, settings, feedback, connect Facebook, etc.”
ABOUT OUR APPS
Our range of Kit apps are designed to allow children to create fun immersive worlds to explore. We focus on open-ended creative play with no rules. This enables a stress-free gaming experience. We avoid distractions such as in app purchases, confusing settings and social media links.
PRIVACY
We do not collect user data within our apps

This character is perfect for rhythm-based players because it thrives on timing, accuracy, and building strong musical chains each session.

bluejetty:00182685:ios.description:
Following the worldwide success of its sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Pool 2026, probably one of the most realistic and playable pool games available on mobile devices. Boasting fully textured game environments and full 3D rigid body physics this game is the complete package for both casual and serious gamers.
The simple click and play interface allows you to pick up and play the game quickly, or alternatively for the more serious players the game includes cue ball control allowing you to perform more advanced shots including back spin, top spin, left spin (Left english), right spin (Right english) and ball swerve. 
So whether you want a simple easy and fun snooker game or a full on simulation this game is for you. 
Download Pro Pool 2026 now and try it for free, you will not be disappointed. 
System Requirements: 
∙ Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch. 
∙ Supports iOS 15.0 and above. 
∙ Utilizes Retina displays on compatible devices. 
∙ Game Center compatible. 
Game Features: 
∙ Localized to English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Canadian French and Mexican Spanish.
∙ Full High Def 3D textured environments. 
∙ Full 3D physics at 60 FPS. 
∙ Free online multiplayer games
∙ Free local network multiplayer games
∙ Practice: Fine tune your game by playing on your own with no rules. 
∙ Quick Play: Play a custom match against another friend, family member or computer opponent. 
∙ League: Participate in a league event over 7 rounds where the highest points total wins. 
∙ Tournament: Test your nerves in a 4 round knockout tournament event. 
∙ Configure up to 3 player profiles to keep track of all your statistics. 
∙ Each profile contains comprehensive statistics and progression history. 
∙ Select your handicap level with 5 levels of aiming and ball guide mark-ups. 
∙ Select your preferred post shot camera through your player’s profile. 
∙ Progress through the ranks from Rookie to Legend. Beware you can go down the ranks as well as up. 
∙ Play against 25 different computer opponents spread over 5 difficulty levels. 
∙ Fully customizable tables, choose from over 100 combinations of table finish effects and baize colors. 
∙ Play pool on regulation 7ft, 8ft and 9ft rectangular tables. 
∙ Test your skills on the non-regulation Casket, Clover, Hexagonal, L-Shaped and Square tables.
∙ Play US 8 Ball, US 9 Ball, US 10 Ball and Black Ball based on WPA rules. 
∙ Play World Eight Ball Pool based on WEPF rules.
∙ 14.1 Continuous pool based on WPA rules.
∙ Rotation Pool based on WPA rules.
∙ Bonus Chinese 8 Ball table.
∙ Fully featured ball control system allowing back spin, top spin, left spin (Left english), right spin (Right english) and swerve shots. 
∙ Choose from various camera views including 3D, Top Cushion and Overhead views. 
∙ 20+ game achievements to collect locally or via Game Center. 
∙ Take action photos and share them via Email or save them to your device. 
∙ In game tips and help.

bluejetty:00177646:ios.description:
Psst... Hear that? Zombies are nearby. Stay sharp and don't freak out! Shaky hands won't do you any good. Grip your weapon like your life depends on it and aim straight to keep those walking creeps at bay.
____________
Are you a fan of thrilling, heart-racing, and hair-raising zombie apocalypse games? If so, then you don't want to miss out on our Dead Raid: Zombie Shooter 3D. Our first-person shooter game is perfect for those seeking atmospheric and action-packed survival shooting games.
As the only survivor, you must fend off the hungry monsters that roam the corridors of the buildings and the streets of the city. These monsters were once ordinary folks, until they were turned into insatiable zombies. You can stop their brutal attacks in two ways — with your own flesh or by feeding them lead bullets (or arrows). The simple rule of the game is to kill zombies, move forward, and survive against this horde of the walking dead.
Be quick in this game, or your character will be devoured by growling zombies! You'll be nothing but a tasty morsel in the eyes of these walking creatures. Do you really want to turn into a snack for bloodthirsty monsters? Then pick your weapon wisely — choose what works best for you (you need to try all the options). As you progress from level to level, you'll gain access to a wider variety of weapons — pistols, shotguns, rifles, crossbows, and more. Choose a weapon that looks good to you - and dive into a real horror movie! Don't forget to upgrade your gun, as it can shoot faster and deadlier, which greatly increases your chances of survival.
We're smack in the middle of the apocalypse and forced to fight against the zombies in the fog. Of course, seeing these horrors, you'd want to be in a bunker or some other safe haven, but then it wouldn't be an action-survival horror story and shooter.
Mustard up your courage for this horror shooting game and go shoot some zombies! Aim like a real sniper, and don't forget to reload, as cartridges have a habit of running out at the most inconvenient moment. Your accurate shooting will feed the walking dead with bullets (or arrows) and discourage any desire to dine with you. If your accuracy leaves much to be desired, they'll have a feast, much to the delight of the zombies.
Firearms in your hands are great, but why not use your wits — another advantage you have over these crazy gluttons? Instead of wasting clip after clip, aim and detonate the fire extinguisher to take out as many undead as you can with one shot. If you run out of ammo and the zombie is close, shoot them in the leg. That way, they'll slow down, and you'll have time to reload.
The zombie hunt is on! Clear territories one by one to test yourself on new levels. Act fast and accurate — your life's on the line. Don't let your guard down or you'll end up as the next victim of the zombie apocalypse.
____________
All zombies in our shooter are strictly 18+, participating in the game voluntarily, and have given verbal consent to be shot.
Privacy Policy: https://aigames.ae/policy

bluejetty:00146840:ios.description:
Learn the things life actually tests you on — five minutes at a time.
Astra Trainer turns big topics into short, interactive lessons: read a little, answer a question, see why. Lesson by lesson it adds up to real understanding — of yourself, your relationships, your money and your work.
CHOOSE YOUR WORLD
• Psychology & Mind — habits, emotions, why you react before you think
• Love & Relationships — attachment styles, dating, communication, repair
• Business & Finance — how money really works, investing, markets
• Career & Leadership — negotiation, influence, office politics, presenting
• Marketing & Attention — hooks, personal brand, pricing, sales psychology
• Astrology & Tarot — the cards, your birth chart, numerology, runes, kabbalah
• Dogs — body language, puppy school, nutrition
HOW IT WORKS
• Five-minute lessons with quizzes that explain every answer
• A clear path through each course, so you always know what's next
• Repetition built in, so what you learn stays with you
• A certificate when you finish a course
MORE THAN LESSONS
• A daily tool in every world — Card of the Day, Emotion of the Day, Boss Talk, Red Flag or Fine? and more
• Daily quests and a streak worth keeping
• 300+ collectible cards — every card opens a short lesson
• A library of free public-domain classics
• A garden that grows as you learn
YOU NEVER LEARN ALONE
Join a small circle with one chat and one weekly goal, talk lessons through with other learners, send gifts to friends, and ask live tarot readers and experts.
START FREE
Your first lessons are free. A subscription unlocks every course in every world; lifetime access is also available. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them any time in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://astratarot.net/public/tos
Privacy Policy: https://astratarot.net/public/pp

bluejetty:00062332:ios.summary:

Beat the clock and answer as many spelling, vocabulary and grammar questions as you can in this 60-
bluejetty:00062332:ios.description:
What’s the difference between “in time” and “on time”? What do you call a person who cuts a man’s hair? What do you call an animal doctor? 
Beat the clock and answer as many spelling, vocabulary and grammar questions as you can in this 60-second quiz! 
Johnny Grammar’s Word Challenge is a quiz for English learners to test common vocabulary, spelling and grammar that appear in everyday English.
Main features: 
- 3 difficulty levels – Easy, Medium, Hard 
- 3 categories – Words, Grammar, Spelling 
- 10 topics that include Food & Restaurants, Travel, Idioms and Hobbies.
- Earn badges as you progress and share your score with others on the leaderboard!
- Compete with others on a global leaderboard
- Feedback is given for the wrong answers so that you know why they’re wrong.
Find even more exciting language activities at
https://www.britishcouncil.org/learnenglish
PERSONAL DATA AND PRIVACY
Your privacy is very important to us. We track how the app is used, such as which games are played but we only use this information to improve the app. We may occasionally send you a message about services from your local British Council centre. We detect your location based on your GPS position. Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life. Learn more about the British Council's privacy policy here: https://www.britishcouncil.org/organisation/transparency/policies/privacy
LEARN ENGLISH WITH THE BRITISH COUNCIL 
Learn English in our classrooms with the world’s English experts. We’ve been teaching English for more than 75 years and have helped more than 100 million people in 100 different countries improve their English skills and build their confidence. Visit www.britishcouncil.org/english to find out more information. 
ABOUT THE BRITISH COUNCIL’S ENGLISH LEARNING APPS 
The British Council creates top English learning apps for learners of all ages. You can download our apps to practise grammar, vocabulary and listening. Visit our website to see all our apps www.britishcouncil.org/mobilelearning.

bluejetty:00090628:ios.description:
FIFO Clock is a roster and shift tracking app designed specifically for FIFO workers. You can manage your roster, track your income, and plan your time off with tools built for your lifestyle.
Whether you work in mining, oil and gas, or construction, FIFO Clock helps you stay organised, prepared, and in control of your schedule. Using FIFO Clock as your roster planner allows you to track shifts and plan time off for yourself or coordinate with family and friends.
Key Features
Smart Roster Management
Easily enter your swing and let FIFO Clock automatically generate your fly in, fly out, and R&R schedule.
Interactive Calendar
View your entire roster in a clean, colour coded calendar. Instantly see day shifts, night shifts, and time off.
Forecast Your Earnings
Estimate your income based on your roster, and work days. Know what you are earning and how much tax to pay every year.
R&R Countdown Timer
Stay motivated with a real time countdown to your next break.
Compare Rosters & Sync with Friends
Connect with other rosters and compare rosters. Find overlapping R&R days and plan time off together.
Exclusive Offers & Discounts
Access exclusive deals available only to FIFO Clock users, with more added regularly.
FIFO Clock Pro
Upgrade to FIFO Clock Pro for advanced features:
• Unlimited rosters
• Ad free experience
• Export roster events to your iOS calendar
• Advanced income forecasting with hourly rates, penalty rates, and tax mode
• Custom day and night shift settings
• Early access to new features
• Exclusive Pro Widgets
• Exclusive Pro member discounts
Why FIFO Clock?
• Built for FIFO workers across Australia and beyond
• Designed to simplify complex rosters
• Helps balance work and personal life
• Clean, fast, and easy to use
Subscription Details
FIFO Clock offers free and Pro plans, with monthly and annual subscription options. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple account upon confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00033089:android.summary: With Credit Suisse TWINT, you can make convenient and secure payments with your smartphone at cash registers, in online shops, at parking meters, and in linked apps (mobile shops). With Credit Suisse TWINT, you can even transfer money to fr
bluejetty:00033089:android.description:
With Credit Suisse TWINT, you can make convenient and secure payments with your smartphone at cash registers, in online shops, at parking meters, and in linked apps (mobile shops). With Credit Suisse TWINT, you can even transfer money to friends in just a few clicks.
Store your customer loyalty cards digitally and benefit from personalized offers and vouchers. Outgoing payments are made directly from your account or credit card and received payments are credited directly to your stored account.
Credit Suisse TWINT functions:
- Send money to friends or request money from them.
- Pay online
- Pay at cash registers or parking meters.
- Store customer loyalty cards
- Benefit from digital coupons and stamp cards
Conditions for using Credit Suisse TWINT:
🇨🇭 Credit Suisse (Schweiz) AG client residing in Switzerland
🏦 Transaction account in Swiss francs
📝 Valid contract and access data for online banking
🔓 At least 12 years old
📱 Valid mobile phone number from a Swiss provider
Sending and requesting money:
1. Open Credit Suisse TWINT and select "Send and request" > "Send money" or "Request money."
2. Enter the amount and the mobile number of the relevant person and tap the "Send money" or "Request money" button.
Paying online:
1. Select TWINT as the payment method in the online shop.
2. A QR code or a five-digit numerical code will be displayed.
3. Open Credit Suisse TWINT and tap on the QR code icon.
4. Aim the camera at the QR code or enter the numerical code.
5. The amount to be debited will be displayed, and you can confirm the transaction.
Paying with a QR code at cash registers:
1. Open Credit Suisse TWINT and tap the QR code icon.
2. Aim the camera of your smartphone at the QR code shown to you.
3. The amount to be debited will be displayed, and you can confirm the transaction.
Paying at parking meters:
1. Open Credit Suisse TWINT and scan the QR code on the parking meter.
2. Now select the parking duration on your smartphone and confirm the payment.
3. The paid parking period can be canceled early at any point. You will be refunded the difference directly via Credit Suisse TWINT.
Credit Suisse TWINT will guide you intuitively through the registration process:
- Enter your current mobile phone number.
- Enter the activation code sent via text message to the mobile number you provided.
- Set a six-digit PIN (TWINT PIN) and, if desired and supported by your device, enable Fingerprint ID or Face Unlock.
- Now enter your login information for Credit Suisse online banking.
- In the next step, you will see the bank accounts (credit cards) that you can store on Credit Suisse TWINT. Select the desired account (credit card). This account (credit card) will be stored for use with all payments, as well as for sending and receiving money transfers.
- Now choose whether you wish to receive third-party offers and share your location so that Credit Suisse TWINT can notify you of exciting offers and discounts at any time.
Do you have any questions, or do you need help with Credit Suisse TWINT?
For further information, call our free 24-hour HELP Line at 0800 800 488.
Download Credit Suisse TWINT and register now to pay with your smartphone throughout Switzerland. We look forward to your ratings and reviews in Google Play Store.

bluejetty:00069658:ios.description:
Atrask Radio LT — Lietuvos radijas vienoje vietoje
Klausykis Lietuvos radijo, atrask naujas stotis, kurk mėgstamiausių sąrašą ir mėgaukis radiju visur — „iPhone“, „Apple Watch“ ir „CarPlay“.
• Tau: Kasdien atrask radijo stočių pagal rekomendacijas, paremtas tuo, ko klausaisi. Taip pat pasiekiama „Apple Watch“.
• My Top: Automatiškai sudaro tavo dažniausiai klausomų radijo stočių sąrašą, kad jos visada būtų po ranka.
• Radijo žadintuvas: Pradėk dieną su mėgstamu radiju. Nustatyk vienkartinį arba pasikartojantį žadintuvą ir pabusk klausydamasis pasirinktos radijo stoties „iOS 26“ ir naujesnėse versijose.
• Mėgstamos: Kurk ir tvarkyk mėgstamų radijo stočių sąrašą, kad galėtum jas greitai pasiekti. „Mėgstamos“ ir „My Top“ automatiškai sinchronizuojami tarp tavo „Apple“ įrenginių.
• Apple Watch: Naršyk radijo stotis, „Tau“, „My Top“ ir „Mėgstamas“ bei valdyk atkūrimą tiesiai nuo riešo.
• CarPlay: Saugiai klausykis mėgstamų radijo stočių kelyje su visapusiška „Apple CarPlay“ integracija.
• Listen On: Kai yra informacijos apie dainą, greitai rask ją „Apple Music“, „Spotify“, „YouTube Music“ arba „YouTube“.
• Dabar groja: Peržiūrėk dainos informaciją ir albumo viršelį bei mėgaukis animuota vizualizacija klausydamasis.
• Dalinkis tuo, ko klausaisi: Dalinkis dainomis naudodamas įrašams ir istorijoms skirtas korteles arba siųsk nuorodas į mėgstamas radijo stotis.
• Visada atnaujinta: Reguliariai atnaujinamas katalogas suteikia prieigą prie aktualių ir populiarių Lietuvos radijo stočių.
Radio LT galima nemokamai naudoti radijo stotims klausytis su reklamomis palaikoma sąsaja. „My Top“ ir kitos pagrindinės klausymo funkcijos prieinamos visiems. „Premium“ prenumerata yra neprivaloma — ji pašalina vaizdines reklamas ir atrakina papildomas funkcijas.
Premium
Pasirink „Premium“ ir naudokis visomis Radio LT galimybėmis: pašalink vaizdines reklamas, atrakink visas „CarPlay“ ir „Apple Watch“ funkcijas, perjunk stotis mygtukais „Ankstesnė“ ir „Kita“ automobilyje, ausinėse ar užrakintame ekrane, naudokis „Listen On“ be dienos limito ir valdyk atkūrimą naudodamas „Siri“ bei „Shortcuts“.
• Premium Individualus – 1 mėnuo – 1,99 EUR
• Premium Individualus – 1 metai – 14,99 EUR
• Premium Šeima – 1 metai – 17,99 EUR, su tomis pačiomis galimybėmis visai šeimai.
Išbandyk „Premium“ nemokamai ir mėgaukis Radio LT be vaizdinių reklamų bei su visomis „Premium“ funkcijomis.
Pastaba: Reikalingas interneto ryšys. Radio LT atkuria viešai prieinamas internetines radijo transliacijas tiesiai iš jų originalių šaltinių.
Naudojimo sąlygos: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privatumo politika: https://www.e-life.lv/radio_privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00116497:ios.description:
Trusted by thousands of patients, Lotus AI is the leading AI-powered infinite care app. Get real care from board-certified physicians trained at UCSF, Stanford, Harvard, UCLA, and other top medical institutions.
Lotus AI combines the power of AI with real physicians to deliver personalized healthcare, including prescriptions, lab orders, care plans, and health insights, all in one app.
Real Care, Not Just Information
-> Get prescriptions sent to any pharmacy
-> Order labs at 6,000+ test sites across the nation
-> Receive AI-guided care plans personalized to your health data
-> Message board-certified physicians for diagnoses, treatment, and non-urgent guidance
All Your Health Data in One Place
-> Connect clinical health records, insurance data, and wearable devices
-> Review and discuss your medical history, including labs, medications, immunizations, conditions, and procedures
Built With Physicians From Leading Institutions
-> Our medical team includes physicians from UCSF, Stanford Medicine, Harvard Medical School, UCLA Health, Sutter Health, and more
-> Every clinical recommendation is reviewed and validated by board-certified physicians
-> All medical information includes citations to primary sources
Your Privacy, Your Control
-> Choose exactly which health data to share
-> HIPAA compliant with all data encrypted in transit and at rest
See How Lotus AI Is Changing Lives
"Lotus discovered two diagnoses in my records that no one had ever told me about." - Nancy, Thousand Oaks, CA
"Lotus AI helped me figure out exactly what triggered my pulsatile tinnitus, and even how to stop it." - Trisha, Santa Rosa, CA
"After my brain aneurysm, Lotus AI brought all my records into one place and helped me prepare for every doctor visit." - Robert, Sacramento, CA
Important Information
-> Unless a message is explicitly marked as from a licensed physician, Lotus AI provides general health information and guidance, not medical diagnosis or treatment
-> Lotus AI is not a medical device and does not replace a qualified healthcare provider
-> Not intended for emergencies. If you believe you are experiencing a medical emergency, call 911

bluejetty:00040170:ios.description:
Step into the shadows of mystery! Unravel the secrets of the Asylum in this thrilling escape room game!
From the creators of the hit horror mystery Strange Case: The Alchemist comes the highly anticipated sequel, Strange Case 2: Asylum. Get ready for a spine-chilling room escape adventure like no other!
Take on the role of a fearless detective investigating the sinister mysteries of a strange mental hospital. Each locked door, hidden clue, and dark corner holds secrets that will challenge your skills and determination.
Solve Mind-Bending Room Escape Puzzles
Dive into the heart of this escape room game, packed with cryptic codes, locked doors, and intricate riddles. Use your detective instincts to unravel the asylum’s dark secrets, and find your way to the final exits.
Explore a Haunting Horror Mystery World
Immerse yourself in a creepy atmosphere where every shadow hides danger. The asylum is a maze of eerie corridors, mysterious characters, and chilling surprises. Each new room adds to the suspense as you piece together the story and unlock the truth behind the horrors.
Unlock Doors and Escape Before It’s Too Late
Your mission is clear: investigate the asylum, solve puzzles, and find the exits. But beware—every door you open could lead to new dangers. Will you survive this escape room challenge?
Why You’ll Love Strange Case 2: Asylum
- A captivating blend of escape room gameplay, horror themes, and mystery-solving.
- Locked doors and challenging puzzles to crack.
- An unforgettable offline room escape experience - no internet needed.
- No hidden fees or registrations - just install, play, and escape!
Can You Solve the Mystery and Escape the Asylum?
Download Strange Case 2: Asylum now and embark on a chilling horror room escape adventure. The exits are waiting - will you find your way out before it’s too late?

bluejetty:00128530:ios.description:
Achieve Your Fitness Goals with Our Full Body Workout App!
Take charge of your fitness journey with our easy-to-use and effective Full Body Workout app, designed specifically for women who want the freedom to work out from the comfort of their home. Whether you're new to fitness or looking to level up your routine, this app makes it easy to stay active without needing any gym equipment or weights.
Why Our App is Perfect for You
Life is busy, and finding time for the gym can be tough. That’s why our app lets you work out anywhere, anytime—whether it's at home, on a lunch break, or while traveling. Every workout is just 20 minutes long, so it’s simple to fit into your day, but still powerful enough to give you a full-body workout that helps you achieve real results.
Here’s What You’ll Get:
Quick and Effective Workouts: Each session is designed to be completed in just 20 minutes, with exercises that last only 30 seconds each. This allows you to efficiently work multiple muscle groups without spending hours working out. With just 20 minutes, you can experience the benefits of a full-body workout and feel great afterward.
Customizable Workouts: Your fitness goals are unique, and so are your preferences. Our app offers customizable workout routines that allow you to adjust exercises, intensity, and timing to suit your personal fitness journey. With this flexibility, you can make each session exactly what you need to stay motivated and achieve your goals.
Timed Rest Periods: To support muscle recovery, we’ve included two 1-minute rest periods in each workout. But the app also lets you modify these breaks—whether you want to extend your rest or skip it for a more intense session. It’s all up to you.
Ideal for At-Home Workouts
No gym? No problem! Our app is perfect for at-home workouts because it doesn’t require any equipment. The exercises are designed to be completed using just your body weight, making it a convenient and affordable way to stay fit without needing to leave your home.
How to Use for Best Results
We recommend using the app 2-3 times a week to strike the right balance between working out and muscle recovery. This way, you’ll maximize your results without risking overtraining. By staying consistent, you’ll feel stronger, more toned, and full of energy.
Don’t wait to take control of your fitness goals! Download the app today and start working out on your terms—anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00071210:ios.name: Athlytic: Fitness & Recovery
bluejetty:00071210:ios.summary:
Your Apple Watch collects thousands of data points a day. Athlytic turns them into one clear answer: how ready you are, how hard to go, and how to recover.
RECOVERY: Every morning Athlytic reads your overnight HRV and resting heart rate ag
bluejetty:00071210:ios.description:
Your Apple Watch collects thousands of data points a day. Athlytic turns them into one clear answer: how ready you are, how hard to go, and how to recover.
RECOVERY: Every morning Athlytic reads your overnight HRV and resting heart rate against your own baseline and tells you how recovered you are. On Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, Recovery uses Apple's new Recovery HRV.
EXERTION and TARGET EXERTION: Your cardiovascular load is tracked 24/7 and scored 0 to 10. Each day you get a Target Exertion range that fits your Recovery, so you know when to push and when to hold back.
WORKOUT SUGGESTIONS: Based on your target zone and the workouts you actually do, Athlytic suggests what to do today, for how long, and how hard. Build a structured workout, or import a plan from a screenshot, and send it to your Apple Watch with warm-up, repeats, rests, and cool-down.
ATHLYTIC AGE: One number for your fitness, built from your resting heart rate, VO2 max, sleep, body composition, steps, training minutes, and heart rate recovery. See which lever moves it most, then tap What if to try changes before you make them.

TARGET SLEEP: A nightly sleep goal and target bedtime built from today's Recovery, Exertion, and sleep debt.

bluejetty:00178250:ios.description:
Indian Rummy offers a seamless gaming interface that allows you to pick and sort cards with great ease. For an exciting gaming experience, try different variants of rummy on this offline rummy game and then you can stick with the one that suits you the best.
Rummy is a traditional Indian card game, It is easy to learn and offers a unique game experience every time you play it.
This thrilling card game is played in leisure time most often for user's entertainment.
People of India love to play Rummy games, timelessly with their Family & Friends, Indian Rummy is an offline, tricky game with super-smooth gameplay and classy graphics.
Rummy Game Rules:
Indian Rummy is played between 2 to 6 players and each player is dealt 13 cards. For 2 or 3 players, two 52-card decks (104 cards) and 4 jokers (wild cards) are used. For 4 to 6 players, three decks (156 cards) and 6 jokers are used.
The objective of the game is to arrange all 13 cards in sequences and/or sets.
A Sequence is 3 or more running cards of the same suit. eg:5 of Hearts 6 of Hearts 7 of Hearts.
A Set is 3 or more cards of the same face value. eg: 3 of Hearts 3 of Spades 3 of Club or 7 of Hearts 7 of Spades 7 of Club 7 of Diamond.
A Joker (randomly selected at the start of each game) can be used in place of any other card. eg: 5 of Hearts 3 of Spades 7 of Hearts is a sequence where 3 is the joker and is used in place of 6 of Hearts.
You can use one or more Jokers to complete/fill your sets and sequences.
A Pure Sequence is a sequence without a Joker. Exception - 5 of Hearts 6 of Hearts 7 of Hearts is a pure sequence even if 6 is the Joker.
Mandatory :- To finish the game, you must have at least two sequences, at least one of which must be pure.
The requirement of first life and second life makes Indian Rummy interesting and challenging.
Rummy Offline Game types:
Play Rummy however you want!
Classic Rummy: You can play the Points rummy game offline on Indian Rummy. This variant of the Indian rummy card game is played by 2 to 6 players, using 1 or 2 card decks.
Deals Rummy: Deals rummy is another version of the Indian rummy game, which is just like Points rummy. The only difference between the two is that there is more than one deal/round in each game of Deals rummy. The player with the highest number of chips at the end of the final deal wins the game.
Pool Rummy: Pool rummy is an exciting variation of the Indian rummy game. Players get eliminated from the table when their scores reach the limit of the maximum points in the pool: 101 points in 101 pool and 201 points in 201 pool.
Indian Rummy includes following awesome features
+ Highly appealing graphics.
+ Practice rummy games that allow you to sharpen your skills.
+ Multiple tables and rummy variants to choose from.
+ Superfast Rummy Game that occupies very little storage space.
+ Smooth controls and fluid gameplay.
+ Advanced AI that provides you with the most thrilling offline rummy game experience.
+ Daily Bonus, Hourly Bonus, Level up Bonus and many more.
+ Spinner and Luxury collections.
+ Enjoy mini games like scratch card, Hi-lo and 7 up/down.
+ Invite friends for great rummy experience and get up to 1000 chips
We hope you enjoy playing this Rummy (or, Rammy, Rami) whatever you call it in your language. Keep playing Indian Rummy!

A Sequence is 3 or more running cards of the same suit. eg:5 of Hearts 6 of Hearts 7 of Hearts.
A Set is 3 or more cards of the same face value. eg: 3 of Hearts 3 of Spades 3 of Club or 7 of Hearts 7 of Spades 7 of Club 7 of Diamond.
A Joker (randomly selected at the start of each game) can be used in place of any other card. eg: 5 of Hearts 3 of Spades 7 of Hearts is a sequence where 3 is the joker and is used in place of 6 of Hearts.
You can use one or more Jokers to complete/fill your sets and sequences.
A Pure Sequence is a sequence without a Joker. Exception - 5 of Hearts 6 of Hearts 7 of Hearts is a pure sequence even if 6 is the Joker.
Mandatory :- To finish the game, you must have at least two sequences, at least one of which must be pure.

The requirement of first life and second life makes Indian Rummy interesting and challenging.

Rummy Offline Game types:
Play Rummy however you want!

Classic Rummy: You can play the Points rummy game offline on Indian Rummy. This variant of the Indian rummy card game is played by 2 to 6 players, using 1 or 2 card decks.
Deals Rummy: Deals rummy is another version of the Indian rummy game, which is just like Points rummy. The only difference between the two is that there is more than one deal/round in each game of Deals rummy. The player with the highest number of chips at the end of the final deal wins the game.
Pool Rummy: Pool rummy is an exciting variation of the Indian rummy game. Players get eliminated from the table when their scores reach the limit of the maximum points in the pool: 101 points in 101 pool and 201 points in 201 pool.

Indian Rummy includes following awesome features

+ Highly appealing graphics.
+ Practice rummy games that allow you to sharpen your skills.
+ Multiple tables and rummy variants to choose from.
+ Superfast Rummy Game that occupies very little storage space.
+ Smooth controls and fluid gameplay.
+ Advanced AI that provides you with the most thrilling offline rummy game experience.
+ Daily Bonus, Hourly Bonus, Level up Bonus and many more.
+ Spinner and Luxury collections.
+ Enjoy mini games like scratch card, Hi-lo and 7 up/down.
+ Invite friends for great rummy experience and get up to 1000 chips

We hope you enjoy playing this Rummy (or, Rammy, Rami) whatever you call it in your language. Keep playing Indian Rummy!

bluejetty:00156919:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00156919:ios.description:
All the literature in your specialty, up to date every morning.
Read, ask, trace it back to the original publication.
Juisci is your clinical evidence reference. Built for healthcare professionals: physicians, pharmacists, veterinarians, residents, nurses. Every discipline.
Facing a publication, you always ask the same three questions. Juisci is built to answer them.
Is this my subject?
Two clinicians in the same specialty sometimes share almost no publications. Your specialty label says what you are, not the topics that come back week after week in your practice. We put them in front of you from the start: you keep the ones that are yours, the feed adjusts, then keeps sharpening.
Is this new to me?
What you read feeds what you are shown next. What you ask Juisci comes back into your feed. You pick up where you left off, instead of starting over on every visit.
Is this solid?
Every figure, every conclusion traces back to the original publication. Journal grade, study type, population, risk of bias, limitations, declared interests: what lets you judge is shown, not summarised.
What you get
- A daily feed, from your specialty to neighbouring disciplines
- Answers to your clinical questions, sourced down to the original publication
- Topic spaces to follow a subject alongside your peers
- Article, structured summary, audio, video, infographic: the format you want
- 10 languages
Our role and yours
Juisci concentrates the literature that matters and takes you back to every source. You verify. The decision stays yours. AI can make mistakes and never replaces your clinical judgement.
Privacy
No patient data. Data hosted in the European Union, GDPR compliant.
35,000 verified healthcare professionals use Juisci.
What matters, and why.

bluejetty:00063310:ios.description:
Do you know what day it is today? It is your birthday! Well… At least for the lovely elves that can make your sugary dream of having delicious cakes every day come true! And how can you complain? Everybody loves cakes!
The most fun clicker game you can find anywhere. Guaranteed!
You enter your kitchen and suddenly notice that it has been invaded… By cute little elves that love two things above all others: cooking and YOU! They live in your cabinet -- on your shelves -- and are always up to bake delightful cakes for your alleged birthday. Yummy! They love you, master!
Playing is easy! Fiercely tap or click the screen to give the elves a little helping hand to bake your cake, but also call dozens, hundreds or even thousands of new elves with special ingredients to help you with this tasty task. Each elf has a special skill that will help your cake reach new delicious heights. How many elves can you invite to the party in your cabinet?
Gather all the ingredients a real cake needs: butter, flour, egg, sugar, glaze, frosting, fruits, vanilla, brown sugar and lots of love!
HIGHLIGHTS
• Feel like a real master and own the elf colony you always dreamt of
• Brand new cakes every day, so tasty!
• Forget about other clickers: cakes are better than sushi, pizza or cookies and you know it!
• Lots of cute little elves including the Butter Elf, the Marshmallow Elf, the Chocolate Elf, the Sugar Elf and don’t forget the Overly Attached Elf
• Endless upgrades to increase your production
• Cookies are good, but cakes are delicious
• Fever Mode to make you double your score -- prepare yourself for a real chocolate rain
• Colorful and easy gameplay
Oh, and did we mention you can actually eat the cakes? Yes, you heard it right!
Download now Elf Cake Clicker and join to the most delicious fun you can have in a game.
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00145926:ios.description:
Ever reach for a calculator and the back of an envelope to work something out? That's what Soulver is for.
It's a natural-language notepad calculator: think through a problem line-by-line, using plain words and numbers. The answers appear alongside each line as you type.
Soulver isn't just a calculator app — it's the paper you'd scribble on to figure something out. Except this paper does the numbers for you, so you stay thinking at the level of your problem.
 20% of $1,480 | $296
 $100 in EUR | €86
 240 km in miles | 149 mi
 $1,200 + 15% tax | $1,380
 3 weeks from today | June 21
Because Soulver uses sheets (like Notes), you can explore different ideas: weigh options, change variables and watch everything update.
WHAT CAN SOULVER CALCULATE?
– Live currency conversions — 190 currencies, including crypto
– Percentages in plain language — "20% off $50", "$50 is what % of $200"
– Unit conversions — hundreds of units across length, weight, volume, data and more
– Dates & time — "days until Christmas", time intervals, clock and video-timecode math
– Time-zone conversions — "3pm New York to London"
– Sums & averages
– Financial functions — compound interest, mortgage repayments, hourly rates
It's the closest thing to an on-device universal calculator ever created.
DESIGNED FOR IPHONE
– A meticulously designed numeric keyboard that makes calculating fast
– Six specialised accessory keyboards — for currencies, percentages, dates & times, and variables
– Build your own custom keyboard with the buttons you reach for most
BEST-IN-CLASS ON IPAD
– Multiple windows, Slide Over & Split View — float Soulver alongside Notes or Safari
– Full Magic Keyboard support with dozens of keyboard shortcuts
– Scribble & Apple Pencil
– Find & replace, a line-styling palette and a powerful text editor
– Automation with URL schemes & Siri Shortcuts
POWER USER FEATURES
– Multi-word variables — "total cost = $750"
– Inline tokenized references to previous answers
– Subtotals, tags & trip planning
– Wolfram|Alpha integration
– Headings, comments, labels & dividers to structure long sheets
– Custom units and global variables in the definition sheet
SHARING & SYNC
– Sync your sheets with Soulver 4 for Mac via iCloud
– Export to PDF & plain text, or send beautiful HTML emails
– Share a calculation as an image — just take a screenshot
ONE TIME PURCHASE
Soulver is a one-time (non-subscription) purchase.
We've been refining and improving Soulver since 2005, and major paid updates average once every 7 years.
Try it free for 60 days, no commitment, no automatic charge.

bluejetty:00037667:ios.description:
