从远古文明到现代世界，历史地图带你穿越九千年的人类文明长河。滑动时间轴，看王朝更替、疆域变迁、城池兴废在地图上徐徐展开——这不是在看书，而是在亲历历史。
【核心功能】
年代穿梭
从公元前7000年到现代，滑动时间轴即可穿越任意年代。看大唐盛世的辽阔疆域，看罗马帝国的鼎盛版图，看蒙古铁骑横扫欧亚——千年历史，一滑即达。
全网找图
历史地图的搜索引擎。输入关键词，搜索全网历史地图图片，发现那些散落在互联网角落的珍贵古地图、战争态势图、疆域变迁图。
史书今日
每天为你翻开历史的这一页。今天发生过什么大事？谁在这一天改变了历史？用地图的视角重新阅读历史，让每一个日期都有画面感。
丰富图层
经纬度线、国家区域、都城位置、主要城市、关隘数据、世界山脉、世界河流、年代事件——多维度数据叠加，从不同角度理解历史地理。
多种底图
简易底图、暗色底图、道路底图、卫星底图，还有3D地形模式，用最适合的方式观察每一寸山河。
Apple Watch 遥控
抬腕即可控制地图！在手表上调整年代、切换图层，大屏看图小屏操控，历史探索更从容。
Mac 联动
支持 Handoff 跨设备续览，iPhone 上看到哪，Mac 上接着看。还支持远程控制，用手表操控 Mac 版地图。
安全加密
通信采用国密算法端到端加密，你的数据安全有保障。
【适合谁】
历史爱好者：用地图的视角重新理解历史
学生和教师：让历史课不再枯燥，地图让一切直观
旅行者：到访古城前，先看看它千年前的模样
地理迷：从疆域变迁中感受地缘政治的脉搏
历史不只是文字，更是山河。下载历史地图，开始你的时空之旅。

bluejetty:00068165:ios.name: Our Daily Bread
bluejetty:00068165:ios.summary: Stay connected to the life-changing power of His Word all day, every day! For more than 85 years, millions of people worldwide have found daily inspiration and biblical encouragement through the many resources of Our Daily Bread Ministries
bluejetty:00068165:ios.description:
Stay connected to the life-changing power of His Word all day, every day! For more than 85 years, millions of people worldwide have found daily inspiration and biblical encouragement through the many resources of Our Daily Bread Ministries (ODBM). And now it’s even easier to engage with the truths of the Bible while you’re on the go! With the Our Daily Bread App, you have constant access to a wide collection of biblical resources. You can save the content that speaks to you, and can keep track of your progress engaging with Scripture. From popular Our Daily Bread daily devotionals to trusted reading plans and other multimedia content, you’ll explore resources thoughtfully designed to help you go deeper into God’s Word and engage with the Bible beyond the app. Join generations of believers in Jesus from all walks of life growing closer to God—right from your mobile device! 
So what adventures await you on the Our Daily Bread App? 
Short, uplifting daily devotions that work with your schedule. 
*Every morning, you’ll find the new Our Daily Bread devotion front and center on the app homepage, ready for you to read or listen to. 
*Each daily devotional includes trusted content from Our Daily Bread Ministries, a global, donor-supported nonprofit with a more than 85-year history of making the life-changing wisdom of the Bible understandable and accessible to all. 
*What’s included in our daily devotions? You’ll be invited to read, reflect on, and respond to the truths of Scripture through a short encouragement infused with biblical insights that draw you closer to God, a thoughtful reflection question, and a guided prayer related to the devotional. 
*Found a specific devotion that you want to keep in a safe spot? Or have a monthly goal of having devotional time every morning? Keep track of your progress with reading streaks and bookmarking! 
*More of a night owl? No problem! Our in-app Evening Meditations podcast releases new daily episodes so you can refocus your heart and mind on the goodness of God as your head hits the pillow. 
*We get it—life is busy. Schedule reading reminders so you never forget to set aside time for biblical reflection. 
*Daily audio reading of the devotional so you can listen on the go. 
*20+ different languages so you can read or listen to the Bible in your first language. 
An in-app Bible so you can go directly to the source of truth. 
*Was there a passage or story from Scripture that stood out in the daily devotion that you’d like to dig into? Bounce back-and-forth between the devotional and Bible without leaving the app. 
*Choose your favorite Bible translation! We offer Scripture in 20+ languages and multiple Bible translations like the NIV, KJV, ESV, and NLT. 
*Looking for an easier way to read the Bible in a year? We’ve put the “Bible in a Year” plan included in the Our Daily Bread devotional right on the app homepage! 
Reading plans that connect God’s Word to all areas of life. 
*Customize your devotional experience by choosing the topics and Bible reading plans that speak to important holidays, faith topics, and seasons of life. 
*Find plans inspired by your favorite Our Daily Bread Ministries content: My Utmost for His Highest devotions, Holy Land tours with Jack Beck, Our Daily Bread Publishing book excerpts, and more! 
*Sometimes we need more than just words for a story to come alive. That’s why we’ve also included interactive multimedia elements such as short videos and audio clips within some of our reading plans! 
*Most reading plans include 1-day to 10-day formats. 
Download the Our Daily Bread App today to join us in committing ourselves to Scripture and Bible engagement for life.

From popular Our Daily Bread daily devotionals to trusted reading plans and other multimedia content, you’ll explore resources thoughtfully designed to help you go deeper into God’s Word and engage with the Bible beyond the app. Join generations of believers in Jesus from all walks of life growing closer to God—right from your mobile device!  

So what adventures await you on the Our Daily Bread App? 

Short, uplifting daily devotions that work with your schedule.  

*Every morning, you’ll find the new Our Daily Bread devotion front and center on the app homepage, ready for you to read or listen to. 
*Each daily devotional includes trusted content from Our Daily Bread Ministries, a global, donor-supported nonprofit with a more than 85-year history of making the life-changing wisdom of the Bible understandable and accessible to all.  
*What’s included in our daily devotions? You’ll be invited to read, reflect on, and respond to the truths of Scripture through a short encouragement infused with biblical insights that draw you closer to God, a thoughtful reflection question, and a guided prayer related to the devotional. 
*Found a specific devotion that you want to keep in a safe spot? Or have a monthly goal of having devotional time every morning? Keep track of your progress with reading streaks and bookmarking! 
*More of a night owl? No problem! Our in-app Evening Meditations podcast releases new daily episodes so you can refocus your heart and mind on the goodness of God as your head hits the pillow.  
*We get it—life is busy. Schedule reading reminders so you never forget to set aside time for biblical reflection.  
*Daily audio reading of the devotional so you can listen on the go. 
*20+ different languages so you can read or listen to the Bible in your first language.

*Was there a passage or story from Scripture that stood out in the daily devotion that you’d like to dig into? Bounce back-and-forth between the devotional and Bible without leaving the app.

*Customize your devotional experience by choosing the topics and Bible reading plans that speak to important holidays, faith topics, and seasons of life.  
*Find plans inspired by your favorite Our Daily Bread Ministries content: My Utmost for His Highest devotions, Holy Land tours with Jack Beck, Our Daily Bread Publishing book excerpts, and more! 
*Sometimes we need more than just words for a story to come alive. That’s why we’ve also included interactive multimedia elements such as short videos and audio clips within some of our reading plans! 
*Most reading plans include 1-day to 10-day formats.  

Download the Our Daily Bread App today to join us in committing ourselves to Scripture and Bible engagement for life.

bluejetty:00157009:ios.summary: Magnifier offers convenient tools for users who are blind or have low vision to get more information about physical objects and scenes around them. On Apple Intelligence-capable devices, users can ask Magnifier questions about their visual
bluejetty:00157009:ios.description:
Magnifier offers convenient tools for users who are blind or have low vision to get more information about physical objects and scenes around them. On Apple Intelligence-capable devices, users can ask Magnifier questions about their visual surroundings.
Features
* Enlarge nearby objects or text so you can view them more easily.
* Adjust image brightness, modify contrast, apply color filters, turn on flashlight, or freeze one or more frames to view objects or text around you.
* View and interact with a high contrast, large text interface optimized for low vision users.
* Frame documents and drag corners to adjust perspective and view the document text in a format adapted for easier reading through Accessibility Reader.
* Describe your surroundings including people, furniture and text from signs.
* Use Apple Intelligence on supported devices to get rich detailed descriptions and ask questions about what the camera sees.
* Use the built-in LiDAR Scanner on supported devices to understand your relative distance to people nearby, locate a door and hear about its attributes, and get help navigating to an unoccupied seat.

iMemories gives you cloud-based access to all your family videos and photos from any device. 
Are your precious family memories scattered across phones, tablets, computers, discs and external hard drives? 
With iMemories, your entire collection of family videos and photos is in one place and always with you – organized and ready to watch in brilliant clarity. Your family memories are stored safely in the iMemories Cloud and are always at your fingertips to enjoy on your iPhone, iPad, PC, Mac and select Smart TVs. 
--iMemories makes all your family memories instantly accessible, from anywhere 
--Unlimited viewing and sharing of your videos and photos – from any decade 
--Unlimited cloud storage – add as many videos and photos as you like 
--No limits on video length, photo file size or number of clips and images 
--Your videos and photos are stored and preserved in high resolution 
--Made for families – a safe, private & clean environment, free of advertising 
This free application lets you: 
--Instantly view your videos and photos in vivid clarity, including full length HD videos 
--Easily share your favorite memories via email, text, Facebook or Twitter 
--Effortlessly upload the videos and photos recorded with your phone’s camera 
--Download videos and photos from the cloud to your phone – for off-line viewing 
--Play full screen photo slideshows – turns your phone or tablet into a photo frame 
--And much, much more... 
And it gets even better. Have old camcorder videotapes from the 80s and 90s? Or home movies films and slides from the 60s and 70s? iMemories will professionally “digitize” your family’s analog videotapes, movie films, photos and slides from any past decade and add them to your iMemories account. bluejetty:00030471:ios.name: Creality Scan
bluejetty:00030471:ios.summary: Creality Scan is the official mobile app built for the Creality 3D scanning ecosystem. It brings device connectivity, real-time scanning, model processing, project management, export, and sharing together on your smartphone—freeing you from
bluejetty:00030471:ios.description:
Creality Scan is the official mobile app built for the Creality 3D scanning ecosystem. It brings device connectivity, real-time scanning, model processing, project management, export, and sharing together on your smartphone—freeing you from the limits of a fixed workstation and giving you a complete, seamless 3D scanning workflow wherever you go.
Connect with Your Creality 3D Scanner
Connect with a wide range of Creality 3D scanners. With convenient mobile connectivity, you can quickly create scanning projects and check your scanner’s status, model, firmware version, and calibration information directly in the app.
Scan Anywhere with Clear, Guided Workflows
Choose the scanning mode that best suits your scanner and the object you are capturing. Preview your model in real time on your smartphone and keep track of scanning progress as you work. Creality Scan makes complex 3D data capture more intuitive and easier to control—whether you’re in the studio or on the go.
Powerful Mobile Post-Processing
Once scanning is complete, use the built-in tools to process and merge your scans, generate meshes, and optimize your models—all directly on your mobile device. With color scanning enabled, you can also generate RGB color textures for a more realistic representation of the object’s shape, details, and colors.
Manage, Export, and Share with Ease
View and manage your scanning projects in one place. Completed models can be exported in popular formats including PLY, STL, OBJ, and ASC, then shared to social media or storage apps on your phone. You can also transfer projects to your computer and continue working with them for 3D printing, reverse engineering, digital modeling, and other professional workflows.
Whether you’re in the studio, working on-site, or scanning on the move, Creality Scan puts professional 3D scanning capabilities in the palm of your hand.
*Compatibility
Creality Scan requires a compatible Creality 3D scanner. Some scanners require accessories such as a wireless handle or Wi-Fi Scan Bridge for mobile connectivity. Supported scanning modes and features vary by device. Please refer to Creality’s official compatibility information for details.

Hudle, India's Leading Sports Community Platform: Book sports venues near you, track your performance, compete with people of your skill level and always have someone to play with in Hudle Squad, all in one app. With 4000+ venues in 110+ cities and 40+ sports, Hudle is where India comes to play.
Whether you're booking a badminton court, a football turf, a cricket ground, a pickleball court, or a padel court, Hudle makes sports venue booking near you fast, simple, and reliable.
BOOK SPORTS VENUES INSTANTLY
Find and book badminton courts, football turfs, cricket grounds, tennis courts, padel courts, pickleball courts, swimming pools, and 40+ other sports near you. Check real-time slot availability and confirm your booking in seconds.
JOIN HUDLE SQUAD
Can't get the group together? Recently shifted to a new city and have no one to play with? Join a Squad near you and get playing with people that match your skill level, create connections, and be a regular.
PLAY MORE, PAY LESS
Play regularly, then why pay full price? Reserve your court across multiple days in a single booking and unlock subsidised passes. Perfect for regular players who want consistency without the recurring hassle (or cost) of single bookings.
TRACK & IMPROVE YOUR PERFORMANCE WITH VISION & GRIP
Hudle's GRIP rating follows your progress as a player over time and is a DUPR equivalent rating system for racquet sports in India. Hudle Vision gives you AI-powered stats like MVP, heatmaps, and distance covered, and auto-generated highlights of your best moments on court that you can share on the 'gram.
SPLIT PAYMENT FEATURE
So no one's stuck chasing anyone for their share after the booking is done.
WHY PLAYERS CHOOSE HUDLE
- 4000+ verified venues across 110+ cities and 40+ sports like badminton, football, cricket, tennis, padel, pickleball & more
- Real-time slot booking with instant confirmation
- Subsidised multi-day passes to play more for less
- GRIP rating to track skill progress and find fair matches
- Hudle Vision - AI insights, heatmaps & highlights for Padel
- Split payments & community play with 20L+ players
- Trusted by India's largest sports community
Download Hudle and book your next game in under a minute.
Hudle up, India. See you at play!

bluejetty:00061752:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00061752:ios.description:
YOUR DIGITAL MEMORY. VISUALIZED.
TheBrain is the unique knowledge app that helps you capture everything — ideas, notes, web pages, files, photos — and connect it all the way you naturally think. Stop hunting through folders, tabs, and search bars. Start seeing your knowledge as a living network you can navigate with a tap.
Described by the Wall Street Journal as "Software that thinks like you do" and MacLife as "the most compelling mind mapping adaptation we've encountered." Winner of KMWorld's Trendsetting Products award.
WHY THEBRAIN?
Traditional notes apps trap your ideas in folders, tags, or endless lists. TheBrain lets every piece of information connect to anything else — so the right idea finds you the moment you need it. It's note-taking, mind mapping, file management, and AI rolled into one beautiful experience that works the same on every device.
KEY FEATURES
CEREBRO — TALK TO YOUR BRAIN WITH AI
Our built-in agentic AI assistant. Ask Cerebro anything — and let it create new thoughts and notes, surface exactly what you need, summarize long documents, suggest meaningful links, or just have a conversation about what you know. It can do anything you can do — only faster.
DYNAMIC THOUGHT NETWORK
Move beyond conventional mind maps and folders. TheBrain's animated visualization shows your ideas, their context, and the relationships between them — at any scale. Tap a thought, and the entire network reorganizes around it.
NETWORKED NOTES
Rich notes shown in context with automatic backlinks and concept discovery. Hybrid WYSIWYG + Markdown writing, powerful tables, resizable images, math, and folding — all the modern editor essentials.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Attach web pages, PDFs, photos, and documents to any thought. Link people, projects, files, and ideas in a single living workspace.
POWERFUL SEARCH
Find any note, file, web page, or idea in seconds. Every match appears in the context of your thought network, so you instantly see how it relates to everything else you know.
SEAMLESS SYNC ACROSS DEVICES
Your brain is always with you. Mobile, Mac, Windows, Linux, and web stay in sync — even with large brains. Smart Sync downloads attachments on demand, keeping your brain fast and lightweight on every device.
INFINITE SCALE
Effortlessly handles hundreds of thousands of items and many gigabytes of data — without slowing down.
COLLABORATE AND SHARE
Publish your brain online for the world, or sync thoughts privately with your team. Great for shared knowledge bases, project planning, and team research.
====================================
WAYS TO USE THEBRAIN
• Build your second brain — a living reflection of how you think, ready when you need it.
• Manage everything in your life: projects, people, goals, files, and ideas in one place.
• Capture interesting articles, videos, and references so they're activated when you need them.
• Organize trips, travel, and major life events with all the right context at hand.
• Power your research — go deeper on any concept and see how it connects to everything else.
• Turn goals into action by linking them with the resources needed to achieve them.
• Build a knowledge base that sparks new ideas and breakthroughs.
• Link people, projects, and information for a smarter view of your business.
• Create topic brains around your passions, hobbies, and special interests.
• Plan personal projects like home renovations, weddings, or major purchases.
GET STARTED IN MINUTES
Start with a single thought — your name, a project, an idea you want to explore. Add a few connections. Within minutes you'll understand why people have trusted TheBrain for over two decades.
For the best experience, install TheBrain on your phone, tablet, and computer. Our iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, and other mobile clients all sync seamlessly — your best thinking is always with you.

bluejetty:00146909:ios.summary:
pop.in is the place to go when you want to hang out and play games with people around the world, or chill with friends wherever you are.
Play Spades, Hearts, Euchre, Crazy Eights, Dominoes, Liar's Dice, Crossword, Pop Quiz trivia and more,
bluejetty:00146909:ios.description:
pop.in is the place to go when you want to hang out and play games with people around the world, or chill with friends wherever you are.
Play Spades, Hearts, Euchre, Crazy Eights, Dominoes, Liar's Dice, Crossword, Pop Quiz trivia and more, and join daily competitive and social events where you can top the leaderboards.
Feeling social? All of our games allow you to play on voice or video chat -- it's up to you! And yes, it's free :)
• SPADES - The classic team-based card game. Team up and try using telepathy to communicate with your partner without alerting your opponents. Get ready to take tricks, but be sure not to take too many bags!
• HEARTS - The classic card game where you can break hearts, and shoot the moon! Hearts is a fan favorite for a reason.
• EUCHRE - Pick trump, go alone and euchre your opponents. The classic partner card game, played live.
• CRAZY EIGHTS - Match the suit or the number, and drop an eight to change everything. Quick to learn, loud to play.
• LIAR'S DICE - Are you good at bluffing? Liar's Dice is all about deception and deduction, made popular in the Pirates of the Caribbean movie. You might also know it by the name Dudo, Cachito, Perudo or Dadinho, we call it Liar's Dice :)
• DOMINOES - Play the most classic game of all time with friends or against the community!
• CO-OP CROSSWORD - Our live, co-op crossword is a brand new take on your classic crossword puzzle. Solve challenging puzzles with friends, in real time! New crossword puzzles every day, and special Sunday crosswords!
• POP QUIZ - Prove your knowledge with our take on trivia.
• QUICK GAMES - Checkers, Mini Chess, Flood Fight, Pile Rush, Snakes & Ladders, Minefield and more.
NOBODY FREE? THE REGULARS ARE.
pop.in's regulars are bots with a personality, and they fill any empty seat so a game starts the moment you arrive.
LIVE, SOCIAL, FUN.
ALL of our games are live and interactive, designed for real, human gameplay: team up in Spades, bluff your way to victory in Liar's Dice, shoot the moon in Hearts, and solve puzzles together in Crossword.
Questions? Comments? We're here to chat.
support@pop.in

The 717 Parking app, powered by ParkMobile, provides a convenient way to pay for parking in Tampa, St. Petersburg, and Clearwater, Florida, using your mobile device. Registering is free and takes less than two minutes to join. The 717 Parking app takes the stress out of parking. No more searching for coins. No worries about an out-of-service parking meter. With the 717 Parking app, starting your parking session takes just a few seconds. You can use the 717 Parking app in over 500 other cities across the country, including Boston, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, Chicago, Miami, New Orleans, Dallas, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Pittsburgh, Philadelphia, and more.
Why Use the 717 Parking app?
• Skip the meter and easily pay for parking from your mobile device
• Extend your parking duration remotely from the app

bluejetty:00004844:ios.description:
Idleable dungeon RPG adventure free to play console game. A large number of equipment, suits, genre suits, pets, mounts, skins, artifacts are waiting for you to obtain. Constantly changing real 3D scenes, combined with rougelike elements, random maps, random monsters. Random bosses are waiting for you to challenge. In prehistoric times, man defeated the monsters and sealed them in the dark castle. The power of the seal has weakened and the evil is gaining strength. As the savior, you will step into the sealed grounds to banish the monsters once and for all!

• Tons of Missions and Achievements
• Addictive dungeon crawling experience 
• Daily Login & Arena awards

• Plenty of skills to choose from
• The Talent system lets you play your way! Barbarian, Rogue, Magic User, etc.
• Attribute combinations help you grow in the direction YOU choose
Awesome equipment system
• You can pick up dozens of different looks and abilities
• Armor and Weapon strengthening, forging and gem-setting are all available
• Unique Recast system helps you push the limit
Immersive gaming experience 
• Manage multiple ore mines to accumulate resources
• Shops have random surprises every day
• Dynamic Pet system: Lots of pets with individual attacks, unique leveling system and more
• PVP Arena challenge, compete globally with other players! Battle your way to the top!
Join the thousands who crawl endless dungeons for valuable loot every day! Be the greatest! Kill the
strongest monsters and get the greatest rewards!

bluejetty:00073765:ios.description:
Get the skinny on your next car with Bumper's VIN lookup or vehicle model search. Take advantage of all of Bumper's features, including:
ACCIDENT AND SALVAGE RECORDS - If it seems too good to be true, it might be. Find out if the great deal you found is really a lemon in disguise.
MARKET VALUES - We analyze millions of vehicle sales records to help make sure you're getting a good ride, not being taken for one.
THEFT REPORTS - Not only can theft bring down a vehicle's value, purchasing stolen goods can also get you in hot water with the fuzz.
WEB AND APP INTEGRATION - Bumper is more than an app. It's more than a website. It's an app AND a website. Get the same great report features whether you're at home or on the go.
RECALLS - Unresolved factory recalls can put you and your family in danger. We'll try to help ensure there's nothing hiding beneath the surface.
EQUIPMENT SPECIFICATIONS - Need a certain amount of cargo space? Is a sunroof on your bucket list? Dig into the nitty-gritty of a vehicle to make sure it meets your needs.
OPTICAL CHARACTER RECOGNITION - Life moves fast, but cars move even faster. Instead of hurrying to jot down the vehicle plate number of a vehicle, use the app's OCR to initiate a search with your phone's camera.
BUMPER REWARDS- Access thousands in vehicle-related savings. As a Bumper member, you can take advantage of benefits and perks that can help you save time and money throughout your car buying, owning, and selling journey.
And so much more. Whether you're buying, selling or researching a car you already own, Bumper has something for you. The days of paying for individual vehicle reports are in the rearview mirror.
The Bumper Difference
At Bumper, we are on a mission to bring vehicle history reports and ownership up to speed with modern times. A vehicle is one of the most expensive purchases you'll likely make, and you deserve to have access to the same tools and information the pros use to make the right decisions.
FAIR PRICING—If you’ve ever purchased a vehicle history report, you might have experienced sticker shock. According to J.D. Power, car buyers spend a minimum of three months researching vehicles before a purchase. At an average of $30 a report, you could spend upwards of hundreds of dollars simply researching. With Bumper, we offer reports at an affordable rate. With those extra savings, why not put it towards a down payment or even upgrades?
ACCURATE DATA: Our vehicle records come from government agencies, insurance providers, car industry sources and more. From accidents and salvage records to vehicle specifications and market value, if a record exists, we'll do our best to find it so you have reliable, up-to-date information.
AHEAD OF THE CURVE: Until now, running a vehicle history report was not easy. Introducing: Bumper. Go ahead, set up alerts, and be the first to know when something changes with a vehicle you're monitoring. Or check vehicle reports on mobile or desktop - it's the same great intuitive experience.
View Terms of Use: https://www.bumper.com/terms/
View Privacy Policy: https://www.bumper.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00081935:ios.description:
Your daily oracle for wisdom, fate, and clarity — powered by the ancient Book of Changes.
I Ching Cast Fortune Teller blends the 3,000-year-old Chinese wisdom of the I Ching (Book of Changes) with a modern, intuitive app — for anyone looking for answers to life's biggest questions: love, career, fate, and personal growth.
HOW IT WORKS
• Ask your question and cast the three coins — following the traditional I Ching method
• Receive your personal hexagram, complete with changing lines
• Read your personalized interpretation — clear and grounded in everyday life
• Save your readings in "My Book" and track your journey over time
• Ask your oracle a new question every day
WHY I CHING CAST FORTUNE TELLER
For over 3,000 years, the Book of Changes has been considered the key to unlocking the mysteries of fate and nature. Chinese legend credits its origins to the sage Fu Xi, who encoded the forces of Yin and Yang, light and dark, into a system of 64 hexagrams.
This app makes that ancient wisdom accessible — a daily oracle for fortune telling and divination drawn straight from the Book of Changes. Whether you're seeking wisdom for a difficult decision, curious about your fate, or just need a bit of clarity today, I Ching Cast Fortune Teller is with you with daily readings and personal answers.
PREMIUM READINGS
Unlock deeper, more detailed interpretations and get full access to personal guidance — for the moments when you need more than a quick answer.
Whether you're new to the I Ching or you've spent years with fortune telling and divination: I Ching Cast Fortune Teller is your daily tool for wisdom, clarity, and self-knowledge.

• Skin Creator & Maker – Build your own unique skins with an easy-to-use editor. Create an avatar that reflects your personality.

bluejetty:00135452:ios.description:
► DO YOU SPEAK EMOJI?
Show off your skills as an emoji interpreter in this supremely fun and frenetic puzzle game where you have to pick the right set of emojis to express the phrase, saying or movie title that’s written or illustrated above. Solve endless emoji puzzles by matching the right emojis in the right order and sharpen your logic, word association and visual perception skills with hundreds of short, colorful and often hilarious levels of brain-teasing entertainment. Emoji Guess Puzzle is a simple-in-concept but endlessly challenging and amusing puzzle game for smart players of all ages.
► DON’T REPRESS YOUR EMOJIS!
• Emojinal intelligence: The simple concept of Emoji Guess Puzzle is easy to grasp, but the range of variations, tricky wordplay, and huge choice of emojis will give you plenty to puzzle over and hours of entertainment as you improve your verbal reasoning and visual cognition skills.
• Mixed emojis: There are hundreds upon hundreds of different emoji puzzles already in the game, and many more to come in updates, so you’ll never run out of riddles ready for guessing and fun phrases to translate into your best fluent emoji.
• Emojinal support: Can’t guess the right answer first try? There’s support at hand in the form of cheeky, helpful hints to prompt you in the right direction and help you understand your emojis better. Plus, you’ll get multiple tries to put your emojis in order, or the satisfaction of getting all the stars when you’re right first time.
• Whirlwind of emojis: As well as popular phrases and memes, you’ll find puzzles with superheroes, movie titles, and loads of other cultural references to keep you guessing and test your logic.
• Sweet emoji: Cute graphics, popping sound design, and a constantly cheerful soundtrack make emoji puzzles even more fun and relaxing to solve as you guess your way from one addictive brain-teaser to the next.
► EVERY PICTURE TELLS A STORY…
…and there’s nothing you can’t say in pictures, as you’ll soon find out in this visually attractive and mentally rewarding picture puzzle game that exercises your logic, lateral thinking and visual cognition with simple but highly satisfying visual riddles that are guaranteed to challenge and entertain. Engage your brain, get a grip on your emojis, and get ready to solve a never-ending string of pictorial riddles in this fun, unusual puzzle game that will entertain kids and adults for hours and hours. Download Emoji Guess Puzzle now and dive into a game that’s the perfect outlet for your emojis.

OVERVIEW
Shopping your faves just got faster and easier. Not a Rue La La Member? No problem. It’s free and you can join quickly right from our award-winning app. With exclusive sales, delivery alerts, order tracking, and Boutique reminders, you’ll never miss a stylish beat. 
TOP FEATURES
+ Exclusive sales: Get special access to app-only sales. (Make sure you have push notifications enabled to stay up to date. For information on how to turn push on, visit https://now.ruelala.com/turn-push-notifications/.)
+ Shipping perks: Get 30 days of unlimited shipping after you make your first purchase.
+ Delivery alerts: Track all of your orders and get real-time notifications when they arrive. 
+ Easy checkout: Check out in just one tap. Also, add new credit cards with our easy-to-use credit card scanning functionality.
+ Boutique reminders: Add upcoming sales to your device calendar so you don’t miss out. (App-only feature.)
+ Shop by category: Filter sales to shop by brand, color, and size. Sort them to shop by best sellers or price.
+ Syncing across devices: Add a product to your bag on one device and your cart stays with you on all of your other devices. (Perfect for shopping in bed on your iPad or on your iPhone while on your way to a meeting.)
+ Social sharing: Show your friends those sought-after heels you just bought via Pinterest, Facebook, Twitter, email, or SMS. They’ll thank you for it.

+ Men: Trending shoes, dress shirts, dress pants, sport coats, colorful swimwear, and more for your closet. Trending luxe marketplace brands include Brooks Brothers, Cole Haan, and many more. 
+ Kids: Shoes, shirts, pants, dresses, skirts, swimwear, and more for their closet. 
+ Accessories: Trending jewelry, watches, luggage, socks, gadgets, and more must-haves. Trending luxe marketplace brands include PANDORA Jewelry, Ray-Ban, and many more.
+ Home: Furniture, luxe bedding, bath musts, sheets and towels, kitchenware, cooking essentials, and more trending décor.
+ Travel: Trending, super luxe vacation destinations and packages for a steal.
HAVE QUESTIONS? 
Email mobilehelp@cs.ruelala.com or contact a Rue La La Concierge at ruelala.com/help and we’ll be happy to help make your experience better.

Rue La La’s iPhone app was featured by Apple as one of the Best New Apps.

Welcome to your very own Pokémon café!
Pokémon Café ReMix is a refreshing puzzle game you play alongside Pokémon in which you mix, link, and blast away icons and gimmicks!
The customers and café staff are all Pokémon! As the owner of the café, you will work with Pokémon to serve customers by preparing drinks and dishes through simple puzzles in which you mix around icons.
■ Refreshing puzzles!
Complete fun cooking puzzle in which you mix around icons and link them together!
As the owner of the café, you’ll take on puzzles with the help of your staff Pokémon.
Utilize each Pokémon’s specialty and uniqueness and aim for three-star offerings!
■ A wide cast of Pokémon appears! You can even enjoy switching their outfits!
Pokémon you befriend will join your staff and help you out at the café.
Liven up your café by dressing up your staff Pokémon!
As you raise your staff Pokémon’s levels, they’ll be able to wear different colored outfits. Special outfits for certain Pokémon will regularly be released as well!
Recruit all sorts of Pokémon, raise their levels, and create your very own café!
Now's your chance to become a café owner, work together with Pokémon, and create a Pokémon café that's unique to you!

bluejetty:00153850:ios.description:
Welcome to Sand Blast, a fresh and relaxing twist on classic block puzzle games!
Drop, match, and blast colorful blocks in this satisfying sand puzzle game. Fill lines with the same color sand to clear them and keep the grid under control!
Whether you're into relaxing brain games, casual offline fun, or smart logic challenges, Sand Blast delivers a fresh experience you can enjoy anytime, anywhere – no Wi-Fi or internet required.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE SAND BLAST
• Relaxing & Strategic: Enjoy a smooth sandbox experience where blocks dissolve into colorful sand in a calming puzzle space.
• No Wi-Fi, No Internet Needed: Play anytime, anywhere. One of the best offline games for no-connection moments.
• Color Match + Logic: Merge blocks, match colors, and trigger combo streaks while sharpening your brain.
• Top Puzzle Experience: Fans of top games like Block Blast or Tetris will love this sand puzzle twist.
FEATURES OF SAND BLAST
• Block Puzzle Meets Sand Puzzle: A hybrid of match color, sand puzzle, and logic game mechanics.
• Brain Teasers & Fun Games: Perfect for fans of brain games, fun games, and satisfying challenges.
• Creative Sandbox Gameplay: Merge tiles, plan ahead, and play your way in this sandbox puzzle adventure.
• Streaks & Combos: Maintain combos and streaks to blast rows and clear the board.
• Free & Offline: Enjoy one of the best free games and offline games on iOS – no internet required.
• Inspired by the Best: A unique blend of block puzzles, flowing sand mechanics, and tetris-style gameplay, influenced by top puzzle games.
• Optimized for Everyone: Smooth and lightweight. Fun for casual and serious puzzle players.
HIGHLIGHTS
• Tetris-Style Gameplay: Enjoy the familiar joy of block-dropping action, reimagined for today’s puzzle fans.
• Puzzle Mastery: Outsmart the game with strategic moves to clear lines and rack up points.
• Block Games Redefined: The classic block blast experience gets a fresh upgrade.
• Brain-Boosting Adventure: Stimulates cognitive skills and sharpens your problem-solving.
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop 3 block shapes onto the board.
• Blocks dissolve into colorful sand and settle into place.
• Fill a row with the same color to clear it and earn points.
• Use logic to maintain space and trigger bigger combos.
• Clear multiple rows in a streak to boost your score.
PRO TIPS FOR PUZZLE MASTERS
• Use logic game skills to keep the grid clear.
• Match colors strategically to create combo chains.
• Stay in a streak to maximize your score.
• Mix match game strategies with sandbox creativity to last longer.
• Love Block Blast or Tetris? You’ll feel right at home.
WHAT MAKES SAND BLAST SPECIAL
Whether you're building sandcastles, playing in a sandbox, or stacking merge tiles, every round feels fresh.
This is more than just a block puzzle – it’s a relaxing, visual, and strategic experience perfect for offline and free game lovers.
Inspired by classics and built for modern players, Sand Blast is your go-to puzzle game when you want to relax, think, and win.
NO WI-FI? NO INTERNET? NO PROBLEM.
Play offline anytime. No connection needed – just pure puzzle fun on the go.
CONNECT WITH THE SQUARE TEAM
Facebook: InspiredSquare
Twitter: @InspiredSquare
Instagram: @squareinspired
We love feedback! Rate Sand Blast and let the Square Team know what you'd like to see next.
Privacy Policy: 
http://www.inspiredsquare.com/games/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Use:
http://www.inspiredsquare.com/games/terms_service.html
Sand Blast™ is a trademark of Inspired Square. All rights reserved.
ENJOY,
INSPIRED SQUARE TEAM

Enter amounts, swap currencies and check favorite rates on Apple Watch. Sync currencies and rates with your iPhone, or refresh directly over Wi-Fi or cellular. Convert offline with saved rates and see the rate date beside your result. Requires watchOS 10 or later.
【The Best Partner for Global Travel】Unleash a new world with our app, a meticulously designed currency conversion software. Imagine having over 130 different currencies updated in real-time, all at your fingertips. No matter where you are in the world, everything is just a light tap away.
【Abundance of Features】Not just currency conversion, we also provide conversion for dozens of measurement units, making your travel and shopping around the world more carefree. 【Accurate Gold and Precious Metal Prices】Want to keep up with the latest prices of gold, platinum, and palladium? Our app is your personal gem expert, providing real-time global gold and precious metal price information, allowing you to stay ahead of the market when investing in jewels.
【Support for Global Currencies】Whether you're on a business trip, global travel, or overseas shopping, this app will be your personal assistant, helping you easily deal with currency issues around the world.
【Connecting to the Global Hot Digital Currency】The latest version even adds support for Bitcoin, connecting you to the hot global digital currency trend. Whether you're a digital currency investor or an interested novice, we will provide you with the latest, most accurate Bitcoin information.
Make global travel and investment easier, more convenient

Experience the convenience of round-the-clock customer service.
The JAMS Cloud app allows you to do the following :
• Setup and manage Autopay
• Make a one-time payment
• Sign the out-of-work list
• Update your skills and/or certifications
• View and download your dispatch report
• Update your contact information
• Receive reminders about membership payments
• Submit your termination
• View your employment and hours history
• View important notices from the union
• Request a detailer stamp
• Log your detailer stamp usage
• View elective contributions and submit requests to change them
Please click on the More option in the app, click on Rate the App, or Contact Us to give us feedback so we can continue to make improvements.

bluejetty:00030180:ios.description: For anyone who has ever gazed up at the night sky and wondered about the mysteries of the universe, witnessing the International Space Station pass overhead can be an awe-inspiring moment. The Spot the Station mobile app is designed to notify users when the space station is visible overhead from their location. It aims to broaden access and awareness of the station and NASA globally, by providing users with an opportunity to experience the wonder of the space station firsthand. The realization that there are human beings living and working in that tiny dot, orbiting the Earth at a mind-boggling speed of 17,500 miles per hour, is breathtaking. The app includes several helpful features including: 1. 2D & 3D real-time location views of the station 2. Upcoming Sighting Lists with visibility data 3. Augmented Reality (AR) view with compass and trajectory lines embedded into the camera view 4. Up-to-date NASA space station Resources & Blog 5. Privacy Settings 6. Push Notifications when the station is approaching your location.

bluejetty:00013709:ios.summary: Smith’s Bible Dictionary app is a must have on your gadget if you desire to study the Word of God deeper and gain different perspectives. Smith’s Bible Dictionary offers information on people, places, tradition and practices, history, geogr
bluejetty:00013709:ios.description:
Smith’s Bible Dictionary app is a must have on your gadget if you desire to study the Word of God deeper and gain different perspectives. Smith’s Bible Dictionary offers information on people, places, tradition and practices, history, geography and textual content of the Bible which is really useful for studying the Scriptures.
This Smith's Bible Dictionary is completely offline and does not require internet to work. There is also KJV Bible on this app which comes with audio and this is not a monologue. If you love to listen to the Bible on the go, then this Bible offline will be of great help to you.
Written by Dr. William Smith, Smith’s Bible Dictionary was originally written in 1884 and its use and popularity remains worldwide until today making it a trustworthy material. Its original name was “A Dictionary of the Bible” containing more than four thousand entries which was now named after Smith. He was taught in the classical literature and was proficient in Lain and Greek. He then proceeded to study lexicography or dictionary-making.
The Word of God is an important part of our daily walk as followers of the Lord Jesus Christ. And reading it daily is for the transformation and renewal of strength of your body, soul and spirit protecting you against the works of the devil and of the flesh. The Word of God is a fountain of life, full of God’s promises to all His children. It serves as our hope, our light and our daily communication to the Father. 
And in the light of reading and studying the Word of God, there are aids to help you understand the Bible better such as Bible commentaries and dictionaries written by other theologians and lexicographers.
A Bible dictionary is helpful for someone who wants to understand terminologies used in the Bible or if you are searching for specific words, characters, places, and objects. Smith’s Bible Dictionary app will help you search for words and know their meaning in a convenient and better way of studying the Bible.
Smith’s Bible Dictionary has more than 4,500 subjects and all its entries are properly defined, analyzed along with its corresponding Scripture references.
To select a specific term you should click on the letter and there are several definitions that are below which can help you greatly.
Download Smith’s Bible Dictionary app now and enjoy a deeper study, reflection, and meditation of God’s Word for a deeper communication and fellowship with Holy Spirit.

bluejetty:00121661:ios.summary: Cast to Roku from iPhone or iPad with the ultimate Roku Remote + Screen Mirroring App developed by AirBeamTV. Use your phone as a remote and easily enjoy your favorite content on the big screen in record time! Control your Roku directly fro
bluejetty:00121661:ios.description:
Cast to Roku from iPhone or iPad with the ultimate Roku Remote + Screen Mirroring App developed by AirBeamTV. Use your phone as a remote and easily enjoy your favorite content on the big screen in record time! Control your Roku directly from your iPhone or iPad — navigate channels, adjust volume, or play and pause with ease.
WHY AREN'T MY APPS WORKING ON ROKU?
Recently, Roku updated its default settings, which may block mobile apps from connecting to the device.
Follow these steps to fix the issue:
Open Roku’s System Settings:
On your Roku remote, go to the Settings menu and select System.
Adjust Network Access:
Navigate to Advanced System Settings
Then go to Control by Mobile Apps
Select Network Access.
Enable Access:
Set the option to Enabled or Permissive to allow mobile apps to connect.
ADVANTAGES:
Seamless Mirroring: Instantly mirror your iPhone or iPad screen to your Roku device.
Cast with Ease: Stream videos, photos, presentations, and more directly to your Roku.
Built-in Remote Control: Use your iPhone or iPad as a Roku remote — change channels, control playback, and navigate the Roku interface.
High-Quality Streaming: Enjoy HD mirroring with low latency and clear audio.
User-Friendly Interface: Easy setup and intuitive controls for all users.
Reliable & Secure: Strong connection and safe data transmission.
Mirror the screen and audio of your iPhone or iPad to any Roku Streaming Player, Roku Stick, or Roku TV (Hisense, TCL, Insignia, JVC, RCA, Westinghouse, Philips, Sanyo, Hitachi, Magnavox, Element, Onn, Sharp). You can mirror any app from your device to the TV.
HOW IT WORKS:
Connect your iPhone or iPad to the same Wi-Fi network as your Roku. Avoid using VLANs, VPNs, or subnets.
Open the Mirror for Roku app. It will detect nearby Roku devices. Select your Roku.
The first time, your Roku will show the Mirror for Roku install screen. Choose "Add Channel" to install the receiver.
Enable notifications. We only use them to inform you if your Roku is connected properly.
Tap "Start Mirroring" to begin. You can then open any app, and your screen will continue to mirror.
To stop mirroring: tap the red bar on your device or go back to the app and select "Stop Mirroring."
DRM NOTICE:
Some apps block screen mirroring. Developers can choose to disable mirroring. Apps like Netflix, Disney+, and AppleTV+ do not support this.
ENJOY ALL FEATURES:
The

bluejetty:00033390:ios.name: TIDE: Sleep, Focus, Meditation
bluejetty:00033390:ios.summary:
Find your quiet in the sounds of nature.
TIDE pairs immersive nature sounds with a calm, minimalist design. Create your own mix of rain, ocean waves, and forest sounds, then make it part of your bedtime routine, a focused work session, or
bluejetty:00033390:ios.description:
Find your quiet in the sounds of nature.
TIDE pairs immersive nature sounds with a calm, minimalist design. Create your own mix of rain, ocean waves, and forest sounds, then make it part of your bedtime routine, a focused work session, or a moment of meditation.
Unwind with nature sounds
Listen to rain, ocean waves, forests, and crackling fires. Use nature sounds and white noise to create a relaxing atmosphere at bedtime or a calmer space for work. Combine sounds to make your own mix, play them alongside your favorite music, and listen offline.
Get to know your sleep
Track your sleep and record snoring and sleep talking. Review sleep duration, stages, scores, and reports to understand your nightly patterns. Heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) data offer another way to reflect on your overnight rest.
Ease into rest and wake up gently
Set a sleep timer for bedtime or a nap timer for a daytime break. Choose nature-inspired alarms for a gentler start to the morning.
Build a focus routine
Use the Pomodoro technique to alternate focused work with regular breaks. Choose a countdown or open-ended timer for studying, working, or reading, and pair your session with nature sounds. Review your focus time and sessions to see how your routine develops.
Make room for meditation
Explore guided meditations in English for winding down at night, starting your morning, or taking a break during a stressful day. Practice mindful breathing, body scans, and awareness of thoughts and feelings. Audio languages vary by content.
Take a breathing break
Follow balanced, 4-7-8, and box breathing guides. Take a few moments to slow down, pay attention to your breath, and return to the present.
Bring calm to your wrist
Use TIDE on Apple Watch to view heart rate, HRV, and other health data. Practice in the Meditation Room and follow changes in your heart rate during a session.
Small details for everyday moments
Discover daily quotes and photos, and revisit earlier entries in the calendar. Review your focus and meditation sessions in clear reports, and share a moment with a thoughtfully designed card.
Designed for your Apple devices
Optimized for iOS 27 and iPhone Duo. Enjoy TIDE’s minimalist design with Liquid Glass, StandBy, Dynamic Island, Live Activities, and Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets. Connect with Apple Health through HealthKit and start sessions with Siri Shortcuts.
Subscription information
TIDE includes free content, with additional content available through TIDE Plus. Available subscription plans, prices, and any trial offer are shown on the in-app purchase screen.
Your Apple Account is charged when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. listings.name: TIDE: Sleep, Focus, Meditation
listings.description:
Find your quiet in the sounds of nature.

TIDE pairs immersive nature sounds with a calm, minimalist design. Create your own mix of rain, ocean waves, and forest sounds, then make it part of your bedtime routine, a focused work session, or a moment of meditation.

Unwind with nature sounds
Listen to rain, ocean waves, forests, and crackling fires. Use nature sounds and white noise to create a relaxing atmosphere at bedtime or a calmer space for work. Combine sounds to make your own mix, play them alongside your favorite music, and listen offline.

Get to know your sleep
Track your sleep and record snoring and sleep talking. Review sleep duration, stages, scores, and reports to understand your nightly patterns. Heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) data offer another way to reflect on your overnight rest.

Ease into rest and wake up gently
Set a sleep timer for bedtime or a nap timer for a daytime break. Choose nature-inspired alarms for a gentler start to the morning.

Build a focus routine
Use the Pomodoro technique to alternate focused work with regular breaks. Choose a countdown or open-ended timer for studying, working, or reading, and pair your session with nature sounds. Review your focus time and sessions to see how your routine develops.

Make room for meditation
Explore guided meditations in English for winding down at night, starting your morning, or taking a break during a stressful day. Practice mindful breathing, body scans, and awareness of thoughts and feelings. Audio languages vary by content.

Take a breathing break
Follow balanced, 4-7-8, and box breathing guides. Take a few moments to slow down, pay attention to your breath, and return to the present.

Bring calm to your wrist
Use TIDE on Apple Watch to view heart rate, HRV, and other health data. Practice in the Meditation Room and follow changes in your heart rate during a session.

Small details for everyday moments
Discover daily quotes and photos, and revisit earlier entries in the calendar. Review your focus and meditation sessions in clear reports, and share a moment with a thoughtfully designed card.

Designed for your Apple devices
Optimized for iOS 27 and iPhone Duo. Enjoy TIDE’s minimalist design with Liquid Glass, StandBy, Dynamic Island, Live Activities, and Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets. Connect with Apple Health through HealthKit and start sessions with Siri Shortcuts.

TIDE includes free content, with additional content available through TIDE Plus. Available subscription plans, prices, and any trial offer are shown on the in-app purchase screen.

Each unique game promotes instant and effective relief while remaining entirely accessible and customizable. As you play, you can explore easy to grasp mechanics as well as a wealth of additional features to fine-tune your relaxation.

bluejetty:00185915:ios.description:
Play the LITE Games version of the popular board game Backgammon now for free on your iPhone and iPad with offline and online multiplayer mode.
Features:
- Play for free without limitations 
- Play against a variety of unique computer opponents with different play styles
- Compete online against opponents from all over the world
- Challenge your friends and family on the same device
- Climb to the top of the online highscore leaderboard 
Backgammon, also known as Tavla, is a two players board game that involves a combination of strategy and luck, due to rolling dice. The goal is to remove all of one’s own playing pieces from the board before the opponent can do the same. While the dice can determine the outcome of a single game, strategy is what separates the good and the better players over a series of games. 
Learn the game, work on your tactics and unlock amazing achievements. Experience thrilling matches through the global online matchmaking or hone your skills versus the computer. Challenge your friends and family offline or online regardless of what phone or operating system they use through our great multiplayer modes – as long as the game is available on their phone you can play together!
Play Backgammon now for free!
With the right strategy, tactics and observation skills you will eventually find yourself amongst the top players of the LITE Games community and earn yourself a spot in the global leaderboards. Can you make it?
The Backgammon board game is offered in high quality localization in the following languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish & Russian.
The game is perfect for fans of Checkers, Othello or Mills and offers a strategic challenge for beginners as well as experienced veterans.
Join in and get yourself a top spot in our player community. The 10 best players will be proudly displayed each week on https://www.lite.games/games/Backgammon/
_________________
FAQ:
Why did you change the game?
The former version was no longer compatible with iOS 11 (it wouldn't start or crash in most cases). The code base of the former version was too old to just be updated which is why we needed to rebuild the game from scratch. We used this opportunity to also implement a multiplayer mode and update the graphics.
How can I play the former / old version of Backgammon? 
You can only play the old version if you don't update the game and use a device that uses iOS 10.3.3 or lower. 
Where is the "Undo" button?
After your first move, there will be a circular arrow pointing to the left, at the bottom right of the board. Tapping the arrow will undo your move.

listings.description:
Play the LITE Games version of the popular board game Backgammon now for free on your iPhone and iPad with offline and online multiplayer mode.

Features:
- Play for free without limitations 
- Play against a variety of unique computer opponents with different play styles
- Compete online against opponents from all over the world
- Challenge your friends and family on the same device
- Climb to the top of the online highscore leaderboard 

Backgammon, also known as Tavla, is a two players board game that involves a combination of strategy and luck, due to rolling dice. The goal is to remove all of one’s own playing pieces from the board before the opponent can do the same. While the dice can determine the outcome of a single game, strategy is what separates the good and the better players over a series of games.  

Learn the game, work on your tactics and unlock amazing achievements. Experience thrilling matches through the global online matchmaking or hone your skills versus the computer. Challenge your friends and family offline or online regardless of what phone or operating system they use through our great multiplayer modes – as long as the game is available on their phone you can play together!

Play Backgammon now for free!

With the right strategy, tactics and observation skills you will eventually find yourself amongst the top players of the LITE Games community and earn yourself a spot in the global leaderboards. Can you make it?

The Backgammon board game is offered in high quality localization in the following languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish & Russian.

The game is perfect for fans of Checkers, Othello or Mills and offers a strategic challenge for beginners as well as experienced veterans.

Join in and get yourself a top spot in our player community. The 10 best players will be proudly displayed each week on https://www.lite.games/games/Backgammon/

FAQ:

Why did you change the game?
The former version was no longer compatible with iOS 11 (it wouldn't start or crash in most cases). The code base of the former version was too old to just be updated which is why we needed to rebuild the game from scratch. We used this opportunity to also implement a multiplayer mode and update the graphics.

How can I play the former / old version of Backgammon? 
You can only play the old version if you don't update the game and use a device that uses iOS 10.3.3 or lower. 

Where is the "Undo" button?
After your first move, there will be a circular arrow pointing to the left, at the bottom right of the board. Tapping the arrow will undo your move.

bluejetty:00182457:ios.description:
Snapchat is a fast and fun way to share the moment with your friends and family
SNAP 
• Snapchat opens right to the Camera — just tap to take a photo, or press and hold for video.
• Express yourself with Lenses, Filters, Bitmoji and more! 
• Try out new Lenses daily created by the Snapchat community!
CHAT 
• Stay in touch with friends through live messaging, or share your day with Group Stories.
• Video Chat with up to 16 friends at once — you can even use Lenses and Filters when chatting!
• Express yourself with Friendmojis — exclusive Bitmoji made just for you and a friend.
STORIES
• Watch friends' Stories to see their day unfold.
• See Stories from the Snapchat community that are based on your interests.
• Discover breaking news and exclusive Original Shows.
SPOTLIGHT
• Spotlight showcases the best of Snapchat!
• Submit your own Snaps or sit back, relax, and watch.
• Pick your favorites and share them with friends.
MAP 
• Share your location with your best friends or go off the grid with Ghost Mode.
• See what your friends are up to on your most personal map when they share their location with you. 
• Explore live Stories from the community nearby or across the world!
MEMORIES 
• Save unlimited photos and videos of all your favorite moments.
• Edit and send old moments to friends or save them to your Camera Roll.
• Create Stories from your favorite Memories to share with friends and family.
FRIENDSHIP PROFILE 
• Every friendship has its own special profile to see the moments you’ve saved together.
• Discover new things you have in common with Charms — see how long you’ve been friends, your astrological compatibility, your Bitmoji fashion sense, and more!
• Friendship Profiles are just between you and a friend, so you can bond over what makes your friendship special.
Happy Snapping!
• • •
Please note: Snapchatters can always capture or save your messages by taking a screenshot, using a camera, or otherwise. Be mindful of what you Snap!
For a full description of our privacy practices, please see our Privacy Center.

Color By Pixel: Pixel art coloring by numbers is an absorbing and therapeutic game. Color solo or become part of an online painting collective, all helping to create a pixel art masterpiece turning grey areas into flourishing vibrant color. To indulge the competitive element, there are stars to collect and leaderboards letting you know exactly how many pixels you and your fellow artists have colored. 
There are 3 modes:
1) Multiplayer – Color with others as a collective.
2) Single Player – Relax and color at your own speed.
3) Friends & Family – Private coloring with friends & family only.
Top Free Color By Pixel Features
-----------------------
● Millions of pixels to color
● Access to unique coloring tools such as the Lighting Finger coloring
● Large masterpieces created by professional pixel artists
● Multiplayer coloring online
● Range of art styles
● Unlock artworks & improve tools as you earn rewards
● Beautifully designed paint by number interface
● Leaderboard tracking pixels colored by all artists
● Share completed masterpiece to your socials
● Dazzling animation effects

- Access to premium only content
- Magic finger recharge reduced

bluejetty:00099721:ios.description:
Cheater Buster AI helps you uncover the truth faster. Ask questions in plain English, run image-based lookups, and get clear, structured results from public sources — all in one private, easy-to-use app.
What you can do
Smart text search — ask a question or type a phrase to reveal concise results with links for deeper reading.
Image lookup — upload a photo or screenshot to check visually similar results and related pages.
Quick actions — open sources in the browser, copy details, share findings, or save items for later.
Search history — your full session history is saved locally so you can revisit and continue any query.
Helpful filters — refine by recency and source type to reach the right information faster.
Privacy first — clear history in one tap; no account required. We only query publicly available information and do not claim affiliation with any third-party sites.
How it works
Enter a question (or paste a link/photo).
Tap Search to get instant results.
Refine with filters, save what matters, and share.
Cheater Buster AI Pro
Unlock more with an optional subscription: extended history, faster processing, batch image lookups, and priority support.

bluejetty:00019391:ios.description:
Help Santa with a makeover for Christmas! Santa and the friends need you to look their best at the Hair Salon & the Christmas Salon!!
Featuring fun levels with Santa, Reindeer, Gingerbread, Puppy, Ice Princess, Elf and More!
Level 1: Ho-Ho-Ho! Merry Christmas! Come help Santa clean-up at the spa! Brush, Shave, Cut and Style Santa's Hair!
Level 2: Give Santa a hair salon makeover with fun new hair colors! Choose the best new style as you color the beard and put in green contacts to finish the look!
Level 3: Build a Snow Friend!! Do make-up and don't forget to add the carrot nose or top hat!
Level 4: Do make-up & face-painting on the magic winter Ice Princess!!
Level 5: Give the Christmas helper a fashionable holiday design! This will look so good for Christmas!

bluejetty:00075990:ios.description:
Chapka is the travel insurance specialist. With the Chapka app, get reimbursed for your emergency medical expenses in case of illness or accident during your trips and stays abroad.
Chapka insures all types of travelers, whether they are going on holiday or planning a long trip such as a round-the-world journey. Chapka is known as the French specialist for the Working Holiday Visa (WHV) program, which allows young people to live abroad, particularly in Australia, Canada, and New Zealand. 
Chapka also provides insurance for international students, au pair stays, and volunteer programs. Chapka has a strong reputation in the United States, and its insurance contracts are recognized by the majority of North American universities.
With the Chapka app, manage your insurance from A to Z easily and quickly.
• You can subscribe to your insurance policy directly from the Chapka app.
• You have access to all information related to your insurance: your contract, coverage amounts, exclusions, emergency contacts, and the status of your compensation claims.
• You can contact the assistance team for free 24/7 if you have an accident abroad, in case of hospitalization for more than 24 hours, a death in your family, etc.
• You can have a medical teleconsultation 7 days a week with a French-speaking doctor via the Chapka app.
• You can report claims, send your invoices, and track your reimbursement requests directly through the Chapka app.
In short, the Chapka app is an essential and indispensable tool if you're traveling abroad.

bluejetty:00096594:ios.summary:

Fight anime-style bosses with real push-ups, squats and planks. Your camera coun
bluejetty:00096594:ios.description:
Monarch is a leveling workout RPG. Clear a new workout quest every day, earn XP, and climb the hunter ranks from E to SSS while you get stronger in real life.
Fight anime-style bosses with real push-ups, squats and planks. Your camera counts every rep, and every rep deals damage.
BOSS MODE
• Battle gate bosses with your iPhone camera
• Push-ups, squats, planks, lunges, jumping jacks and more, counted automatically
• 20 original bosses that scale with your rank
• Manage stamina, chain combos and earn freeze windows to rest
• Win to claim XP and share your victory card
• Camera processing stays on your iPhone. Video never leaves your device
DAILY QUESTS AND LEVELING
• A fresh workout quest every day, with a 24-hour time limit
• Earn XP and level up like an RPG character
• Climb 8 ranks: E → D → C → B → A → S → SS → SSS
• Keep your streak alive for bonus rewards
• Sync workouts, active calories and body metrics with Apple Health
WORKOUTS FOR YOUR SETUP
• Quests adapt to the equipment you have: bodyweight at home, bands, dumbbells or a full gym
• Programs for every fitness level, from beginner to advanced
• Target chest, arms, legs or core
• Difficulty grows as you rank up
GUILDS AND LEADERBOARDS
• Create or join a guild of up to 10 hunters
• Compete in monthly guild rankings
• Global leaderboards
• Share your progress with your party
PROGRESS TRACKING
• Stats dashboard and weekly calendar
• XP and level history
• Achievement badges
Whether you start at E-Rank or chase SSS, Monarch turns every workout into a quest. Start leveling today.
*BOSS MODE, LOGGING WORKOUTS AND JOINING GUILDS REQUIRE A SUBSCRIPTION
HEALTH DISCLAIMER
Monarch is a fitness and nutrition tracking app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice and before making major changes to your diet or exercise routine.

bluejetty:00179435:ios.name: Livly Island - Adopt Cute Pets
bluejetty:00179435:ios.summary:
Are you ready to start your new, carefree life with your pet livly?
Livlies, mysterious yet adorable little critters born from alchemy, are waiting for you! Help the Livly Reboot Laboratory research these unusual tiny creatures by adopting
bluejetty:00179435:ios.description:
Are you ready to start your new, carefree life with your pet livly?
Livlies, mysterious yet adorable little critters born from alchemy, are waiting for you! Help the Livly Reboot Laboratory research these unusual tiny creatures by adopting one of over 70 livly species. Care for them by feeding them yummy bugs, keeping them nice and clean, and having fun together on your very own island! 
Don't forget to design the island they live on with thousands of fun items, and express your style by dressing up your avatar! How you live with your new livly pets is totally up to you!
Look After Your Livlies
Livlies aren't just your ordinary cute pets. Their bodies change color when they eat bugs. Feed your pets as part of your research and turn them into the colors of your choice. The best part is that livlies poop jewels which you can use to buy things at the shop!
Dress Up Your Avatar
Dress up and pick a cute outfit for your avatar! Perhaps you'll want to coordinate your avatar with your livly's appearance or maybe even match the style of your island. From gothic fashion to the latest in kawaii, find your style!
Decorate Your Island
Think of the island where your avatar and livlies reside as a blank canvas. You can fill it with many items of your choice and decorate it in whatever style you please!
Grow Life-Changing Fruit
Water the island trees with a magical elixir and they will bear fruit that can be used to make a transformation compound called Neobelmin. Use this potion on your livlies to see how they transform!
Help Out at the Lab
You can get a part-time job at the lab and earn rewards that can be used to buy items. Turn your livly research hobby into a rewarding venture!
Livly Island is recommended for anyone who:
- Loves cute animals.
- Loves creatures that look or act a little different.
- Wants a pet but can't have one.
- Wants to own an unusual pet.
- Likes miniature things and tabletop gardens.
- Enjoys fashion and creating avatars.
- Likes a slightly dark, gothic style.
- Just wants a relaxing hobby.
Terms and Conditions: https://livlyinfo-global.com/rules/
Privacy Policy: https://livlyinfo-global.com/policy/

A new free to play version of Spirit Legends: Change that many players will like! This version has no plot differences with the original object finding games adventure, and its main feature is that you can play the entire hidden objects mystery games quest FOR FREE!
Congratulations, you've passed the exams with excellent marks along with the hidden object games, so welcome to the Academy of Monster Hunters! It is your first day here, but things are already going haywire! In these adventure games, it’s a trial by fire when a mysterious masked man declares war on Monster Hunters Academy on your first day! Dangerous monsters roam the halls, and nobody is safe, not even your mother, Professor Helen Lyngren. But who is this masked madman, and what caused his hatred of spirits and those who cooperate with them? Learn that in the new search and find games Spirit Legends: Time for Change Collector’s Edition!
· SAVE EVERYONE FROM AN ANCIENT EVIL IN THE BONUS GAME!
It’s your first mission of the Monster Hunters Order of the seek and find games! You don’t even have your own Bestiary yet, so it’ll be a test of your courage and wit! 
· DECORATE THE HEAD OF THE ACADEMY’S STUDY!
Find all the sapphires to furnish the study of the Monster Hunters Academy Head with the beautiful and useful items. In these hidden objects, she’ll be really excited!
· EXAMINE SPECIAL MAGICAL INVENTIONS AND COLLECT GEODES TO LEARN ABOUT THE SPIRITS!
Learn more about the spirits, highlights hidden pictures and their relations. Among them you’ll find those you met before! And the unusual magic devices will tell you how exactly human and spirits collaborate with each other.
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS, VIDEOS, CONCEPT ART, AND MORE!
Replay your favorite finding objects game and puzzles, download wallpapers and concept arts and enjoy many other bonuses, which you won’t have in a standard version!
Download one of the most amazing free hidden object games – Spirit Legends: Change! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

bluejetty:00036208:ios.description:
Alarm notification app for Falun Dafa practitioners to FZN (send forth righteous thought) daily at pre-determined time.
This app will play the 15min "Gong" music at 5:55am, 11:55am, 5:55pm, 11:55pm (Beijing time, GMT +8) regardless of which timezone your IOS device is set to. The "Gong" music is a 15 minutes audio, starting with a "Gong" sound, which repeats every 5 minutes for a total of 4 times. Between each "Gong" sound, there will be silence. For user in different time zone, the FZN Gong notification will remains in Beijing time, hence a convenience for Dafa practitioners that travels a lot.
NOTES:
* When using the app for the first time, please click “Allow Notifications” or the alarm would be deactivated. If one misses the step to allow notifications, one can still enable it by going to “Settings> FZN-Gong> Notifications> Allow Notifications.”
* The app can be closed (and remained closed) after opening it for the first time.
* version 1.0.1 adds support for IOS 16; if there is still issue on IOS 16, delete the app and re-install again.
* version 2.0.0 adds support for IOS 17,18.

bluejetty:00066088:ios.summary: Pop, blast and smash your way through the most relaxing bubble shooter on iOS. Classic Bubble Shooter 2026 brings you the timeless aim-and-match-3 puzzle with crisp graphics, smooth controls and hundreds of colorful levels designed to chill
bluejetty:00066088:ios.description:
Pop, blast and smash your way through the most relaxing bubble shooter on iOS. Classic Bubble Shooter 2026 brings you the timeless aim-and-match-3 puzzle with crisp graphics, smooth controls and hundreds of colorful levels designed to chill you out and sharpen your mind at the same time.
Ready to start the action? Aim, match and smash all the balls in this relaxing color-matching adventure. Simple to learn, hard to put down — perfect for the whole family.
HOW TO PLAY
- Aim the bubble cannon at the bubbles above
- Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to pop them
- Clear all bubbles on the screen to win the level
- Earn up to 3 stars per level based on your score
- Use power-ups and boosters to crack the trickiest puzzles
- Release the baby dragons by matching 3 bubbles
FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE
- 600+ magic levels — and hundreds more arriving in free updates
- Powerful boosters and special power-up bubbles
- Long, helpful aim line — pinpoint every shot
- Smooth, satisfying physics and animations
- Beautiful, vibrant graphics
- Calming sound effects, perfect for stress relief
- Designed for iPhone and iPad, any screen size
- 100% offline — no Wi-Fi needed, play anywhere
- Free to play, with optional No Ads upgrade
RELAXING AND BRAIN-FRIENDLY
Bubble Shooter is more than just a fun game. It's a small daily dose of focus that helps you unwind, sharpen your aim and keep your brain young and active. Play during a coffee break, on the bus, on a flight — anywhere. Five minutes or two hours, Classic Bubble Shooter 2026 fits any moment.
A REAL BRAIN WORKOUT IN DISGUISE
Don't be fooled by the cute graphics. Later levels demand strategy: angle your shots off the walls, plan two moves ahead, and use your boosters wisely. The best bubble pop players learn to see the chains before they shoot.
PERFECT FOR FANS OF
- Bubble shooter, bubble pop and bubble blast games
- Match 3 puzzles like Candy Crush and similar
- Color-matching arcade games
- Relaxing, stress-relief puzzle games
- Brain training and focus games
- Family-friendly puzzle adventures
If you love any of these, Classic Bubble Shooter 2026 is the perfect addition to your puzzle game collection.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Free to play, fully offline, and refreshingly ad-light. If you want to play without interruptions, the optional No Ads upgrade is one of the most affordable in the category.
We read every review and feature request. Reach out anytime through the in-game settings menu or via the email on our App Store page.
Aim. Match. Pop. Keep your brain young — one bubble at a time.
