bluejetty:00148489:ios.description:
Effortless File Sharing Made Simple
Sharing files, photos, and documents between your iPhone and any computer has never been easier. With QR File Transfer, you can securely transfer your files in just a few simple steps— no login or complicated setup required.
How It Works:
Upload Your Files: Use the app to quickly upload the files you want to share.
Scan the QR Code: Open a browser on your PC or any device and visit ios2web.com.
Instant Access: Scan the QR code displayed on the website, and instantly access your files.
Why Choose QR File Transfer?
– No Account Required:
Skip the hassle of creating accounts or remembering passwords. Just scan and go!
– Secure and Private:
We prioritize your privacy. Files are shared directly and securely between your devices.
– Universal Access:
Works with any computer or device — Windows PCs, public computers, or even tablets.
– Supports All Popular File Types: QR File Transfer makes sharing all types of files seamless.
Photos and Images: JPG, PNG, GIF, HEIC, BMP, TIFF, WEBP
Videos: MOV, MP4, AVI, MKV, FLV, WMV, 3GP, M4V
Audio: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC
Documents: PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, TXT, RTF, ODT, CSV
Archives: ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZ, ISO, DMG
If you encounter a file format that is not supported, please let us know by contacting our team.
– Easy-to-Use Interface: Designed for simplicity so anyone can share files with ease.
– No Cables, No Limits: Enjoy a wireless file-sharing experience without the need for USB drives or adapters.
Perfect For:
– Quickly sharing work documents between your iPhone and office computers.
– Uploading personal files to access on a friend’s laptop or public computer.
– Sharing photos, videos, and memories with family and friends without email or messaging limitations.
Getting Started is Easy:
Download QR File Transfer from the App Store.
Install and open the app on your iPhone.
Upload files, visit ios2web.com on any computer, and scan the QR code to transfer your files instantly.
Common Use Cases:
Question:
How can I quickly send files from my phone to a school computer without needing to log in?
Answer:
To send files from your phone to a school computer without logging in, you can use QR File Transfer:
Open the app on your phone and upload the files you want to share.
On the school computer, visit ios2web.com in a browser.
Scan the QR code shown on the website using the app.
Your files will be instantly accessible on the computer.
Question:
How can I quickly send files from a school computer to my phone without needing to log in?
Answer:
To transfer files from a school computer to your phone, use QR File Transfer:
On the computer, go to ios2web.com in a browser and upload the files.
Open the app on your phone and scan the QR code displayed on the website.
The files will be instantly downloaded to your phone.
Why Users Love It:
"No frills, no logins — just quick file sharing when I need it."
"A lifesaver when working on public computers."
"So simple, even my parents figured it out!"
Download QR File Transfer Today
Simplify file sharing and enjoy the freedom to transfer your files anywhere, anytime. Whether you're at work, at home, or on the go, QR File Transfer is the easiest way to keep your files accessible without compromising security or convenience.
– A Great Alternative to Popular Apps:
QR File Transfer is an excellent alternative to apps like Shareit: Transfer, Share Files, Zapya - File Sharing, WeTransfer: Transfer Files, Xender: File Share, Share Music, Send Anywhere - File Transfer, and Transfer my data - MobileTrans, File Transfer - Snapdrop, Copy my data - Smart Transfer, AirDroid - File Transfer&Share, Air Transfer,

Dive into a world where suits are replace
bluejetty:00097131:ios.description:
Solitaire Word Match is a unique blend of classic solitaire strategy and modern word puzzles. Experience a fresh take on free puzzle games that will test your vocabulary, logic, and planning skills.
Dive into a world where suits are replaced by topics, and numbers are replaced by words. Just like in classic Klondike or Spider games, you start with a board of stacked cards. However, to clear the board in Solitaire Word Match, you must use your brain to find connections.
HOW TO PLAY Instead of stacking King to Ace, you stack words by meaning.
- Analyze the Board: Look at the available word cards and the target categories.
- Sort & Stack: Move word cards onto the correct category piles.
- Manage Your Moves: Think like a solitaire pro to uncover hidden cards and manage your stacks wisely to clear the field.
It is like a word association game meets a sorting puzzle. A true mind game that challenges your memory and strategic thinking.
WHY PLAY SOLITAIRE WORD MATCH? Need a brain-boosting break? This free offline word game is perfect for fans of logic puzzles, trivia, and card games.
- Strategy Matters: Don't just click. Analyze the layout and think several steps ahead.
- The Goal: Win by sorting every word into its correct category foundation.
- The Challenge: Watch your move count. If you run out of moves or valid plays, the game ends.
Whether you are a casual player looking to relax or a word puzzle expert seeking a challenge, Solitaire Word Match keeps your mind sharp anywhere you go.
GAME FEATURES
- Creative Twist: The best mechanics of solitaire card games combined with word associations.
- Brain Training: Expand your vocabulary and improve your logic skills.
- Challenging Levels: Hundreds of puzzles with increasing complexity.
- Satisfying Gameplay: Perfect for players who love organizing and sorting games.
- No WiFi Needed: Enjoy this full game experience offline, anytime.
If you love word search, crosswords, or classic patience games, this is your next addiction. It connects the fun of identifying categories with the satisfaction of clearing a solitaire board.
Ready to stack, sort, and solve? Download Solitaire Word Match now and start your logic journey today.

bluejetty:00091443:ios.description:
Listen to more than 55,000 radio channels worldwide.
The Radio Live application includes radio channels from 158 different countries. In other words, it covers all countries where radio broadcasting is available.
With the Radio Live application, you can easily find the station you want among more than 55,000 radio stations. You can search by genre, language, country, and many other criteria.
Radio Live is #1 among all radio applications. It makes listening easier with its simple interface and advanced player.
Thousands of Radio Stations
Radio Live allows you to discover more than 55,000 stations worldwide with powerful search capabilities, such as searching by genre, country, language, rankings, or any keyword. If you like apps such as TuneIn Radio, RadioApp, iHeart, myTuner, Simple Radio, Radio FM, FM Radio App, or Radio Garden Live, you will love Radio Live even more. Download the Radio Live App and play 55,000+ radio stations on your iPhone and iPad.
Features:
- Easily access any radio station you want. Popular stations are listed on the homepage.
- Browse radio stations by genre. The Radio Live app features over 100 genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-hop, R&B, Electronic, Country, Talk, Oldies, Classical, Dance, 80s, 90s, Jazz, and many more.
- Choose your favorite radio stations for quick access next time.
- Search by any keyword or choose from suggested stations.
- Browse through the most-listened-to stations in any country, or select a station from worldwide rankings.
- If you're wondering what song is playing, simply use Shazam to identify it.
- If there's a broadcast you'd like to listen to later, tap the record button to save it to your device.
- Automatically stop music playback after a certain time with the Sleep Timer feature.
- Use the Reminder feature to receive notifications at your chosen times so you never miss your favorite radio program.
Note:
If you subscribe through Apple, your payment will be charged to your App Store Account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal can be managed by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

This is a placement simulation idle game, which is FREE, easy, and relaxed. Even offline, you
bluejetty:00029249:android.description:
Welcome to the world of Idle Garbage Tycoon – the game where garbage is your ticket to becoming the ultimate tycoon in the realm of idle gaming!
This is a placement simulation idle game, which is FREE, easy, and relaxed. Even offline, you can earn cash and gold. The portrait control mode makes it easy to dive in wherever you are.
Garbage is no longer just rubbish here; it's a wealth full of value. With your management, your factory cleans up the streets filled with trash, recycles waste, and then disposes of it in a safe way, contributing to environmental protection.
FEATURES
🗑️ Trash Transformed
Witness the magic as trash turns into treasure with just a tap! Manage an automated recycling system that continues to generate money even when you're not playing. Every piece of garbage holds the potential for profit.
🏭 Workshop Upgrades
The efficiency of your factory's workshop determines how much money you can earn. This casual game requires a bit of strategy: upgrade the transfer or the landfill, which one will get more money?
💡 Labor Cooperative
Properly recycling a piece of garbage requires a precise division of labor and cooperation among employees. Recruiting the right employees will greatly increase your factory's efficiency.
🚜 Various Trucks
Each type of truck has its own use. You need to continuously expand your fleet to increase the operational efficiency of your factory.
If you're a fan of idle, puzzle, and mini games, then you definitely shouldn't miss out on this waste recycling factory-themed game. This game is both casual and involves a bit of strategy, all while embodying our initial intention towards environmental protection.
Download now and dive into the world where your quest from waste to wealth begins with each tap – solidify your position as the ultimate garbage tycoon!

bluejetty:00178774:ios.name: The Amazing Claw Machine
bluejetty:00178774:ios.summary:
The Amazing Claw Machine - Crane Grabber, Teddy Picker, Candy Crane.
We've all played those toy crane grabbing machines at the arcades, and usually walked away dejected with no toys and no money either !
No more, now you can play The Amaz
bluejetty:00178774:ios.description:
The Amazing Claw Machine - Crane Grabber, Teddy Picker, Candy Crane.
We've all played those toy crane grabbing machines at the arcades, and usually walked away dejected with no toys and no money either !
No more, now you can play The Amazing Claw Machine on your phone or tablet. It won't cost you a penny and you can practice and tune your skills because this game is physics based and in 3d.
Take into consideration claw angle, swing rate and rotation. Look around the machine using the swipe button, then carefully time your grab and with luck you'll be a winner. The game doesn't cheat, it wont just pick up a gift if it touches it, no the claw has to grab the items just right. As we said before its physics based, and as challenging as the real thing. 
There are plenty of toys to collect and also a "REFILL" button on the settings screen if you want a new set of toys. Refill is also useful if the chute gets clogged up with too many toys!
So download The Amazing Claw Machine, have a good practice then get off to the arcade and clean out the real thing :-)

Clients Particuliers*, Professionnels* et Banque Privée, avec l'application Mes Comptes de BNP Paribas, accédez à votre banque et à ses services à tout moment.
COMPTES ET ASSURANCES
Tous vos comptes et contrats d’assurance sont accessibles
bluejetty:00014427:ios.description:
Clients Particuliers*, Professionnels* et Banque Privée, avec l'application Mes Comptes de BNP Paribas, accédez à votre banque et à ses services à tout moment.
COMPTES ET ASSURANCES
Tous vos comptes et contrats d’assurance sont accessibles au même endroit.
Vous avez aussi la possibilité d’ajouter les comptes bancaires de vos autres.
Gérez votre budget en visualisant vos dépenses et recettes grâce à la catégorisation des opérations.
ACCUEIL PERSONNALISABLE
Personnalisez votre écran d’accueil selon vos préférences.
Gardez une vue d'ensemble de toutes vos finances grâce au widget « Synthèse des comptes ».
Suivez en un coup d’œil vos dépenses et vos recettes du mois avec le widget « Budget ».
Surveillez vos gains en cashback grâce au widget « Mes Extras ».
Visualisez votre impact environnemental avec le widget « Empreinte carbone ».
CARTE BANCAIRE
Prenez le contrôle de votre carte bancaire avec la fonctionnalité de pilotage.
Affichez le code de votre carte bancaire.
Opposez votre carte bancaire en un geste.
Adaptez les plafonds de paiements et de retraits de vos cartes bancaires.
Contrôlez les paiements en ligne.
Activez ou désactivez votre carte Visa dans les zones géographiques de votre choix.
VIREMENTS
Effectuez des virements bancaires en toute simplicité et en toute sécurité.
Ajoutez des bénéficiaires depuis votre mobile.
Effectuez des virements instantanés** (en moins de 20 secondes).
Réalisez vos virements internationaux en profitant de taux de change en temps réel et de frais avantageux.
PAIEMENT MOBILE
Payez avec votre smartphone à l’aide d’Apple Pay.
Créez des cagnottes sans frais avec Lyf Pay.
Envoyer, recevez et demandez de l’argent instantanément avec un simple numéro de téléphone ou e-mail grâce à Wero.
Effectuez des paiements sécurisés en ligne et transférez de l'argent avec PayPal.
RIB ET CHÈQUES
Consultez et partagez facilement votre RIB.
Commandez vos chéquiers.
SÉCURITÉ
Restez informé avec nos notifications pour suivre les opérations importantes sur vos comptes.
Renforcez la sécurité de vos transactions en les validant grâce à votre Clé Digitale.
OFFRES ET SERVICES
Découvrez l’ensemble de nos produits et services bancaires et souscrivez directement aux offres qui répondent à vos besoins.
Améliorez votre compréhension des questions financières et d'autres sujets grâce à la fonctionnalité « Avis d’experts".
Profitez de la rubrique « Astuces » pour maîtriser les fonctionnalités de l’application.
CONTACT ET ASSISTANCE
Bénéficiez d'une assistance bancaire immédiate pour trouver une solution de façon autonome.
Besoin d’aide ? Contactez un conseiller par chat, téléphone ou messagerie sécurisée.
Retrouvez les informations de votre agence.
Localisez aussi les agences et distributeurs de BNP Paribas en France et à l'étranger.
DOCUMENTS
Accédez à vos documents, relevés, contrats, directement depuis l’application.
PARAMETRAGE ET PERSONNALISATION
Personnalisez vos notifications pour rester informé et suivre efficacement l'activité de votre compte.
Suivez le solde de votre compte bancaire sans avoir besoin de vous identifier en activant l’affichage du solde et de la météo.
Personnalisez vos libellés de compte, votre photo de profil et gérez vos informations personnelles.

The Beauty of Eastern Zen 
E
bluejetty:00024665:ios.description:
3D Escape Game: Chinese Room is a Chinese-style escape room game. You’ll find yourself in a variety of mysterious, challenging rooms inspired by Chinese culture, where you’ll uncover secrets and solve puzzles.
The Beauty of Eastern Zen 
Each scene pays homage to traditional Chinese Zen aesthetics, with serene lighting, minimalist lines, and gentle colors. This design enhances the puzzle-solving process, creating a tranquil, focused experience. We aim to visually convey a Zen ambiance, immersing you in a peaceful, ancient Chinese courtyard, where you can savor the unique cultural charm.
Exquisite 3D Graphics 
Through detailed textures, soft lighting, and realistic physics, we strive to provide a visually captivating experience that deepens immersion. From carved stone details to lattice window designs, every element reveals a meticulous attention to detail, transporting you to an authentic ancient Chinese world.
Balanced Puzzle Design 
Throughout the game, you’ll encounter a series of classic puzzles and mini-games. Neither too simple nor too overwhelming, the difficulty is carefully calibrated to offer a sense of achievement and the joy of exploration as you work your way through each challenge.
50 room escape game developer's 3D game “3D Escape: Chinese Room”

bluejetty:00160497:ios.summary:

On one single easy to use screen, you can browse, search, discover and shop for anything to everything in a m
bluejetty:00160497:ios.description:
Botit is a one stop instant shopping app featuring all your favorite local and global brands with same-hour to same-day delivery.
On one single easy to use screen, you can browse, search, discover and shop for anything to everything in a matter of seconds including:
- Food & Groceries
- Fashion
- Health and Nutrition
- Beauty
- Electronics
- Home and Garden
- Pharmacies
- Pet Care
- Kids
- Sports 
- Gifts
- Entertainment & More!
WRITE A LIST 
Write a list of items you want - a burger, a phone charger, a pair of sneakers, Panadol, maybe even a canoe (?!) and all available options from all the best brands will instantly appear on an easy-to-use single screen allowing you to quickly browse, buy and have everything delivered in the same day.
DISCOVER BRANDS 
Tell us what you’re in the mood for – a new dress for a wedding this weekend? Something healthy to eat? A kid’s gift for a birthday party? Prompt the category and browse from hundreds of the best brands all on one screen. It’s easy to compare, buy and have everything delivered same day.
SINGLE SCREEN COMPARISON
Whatever you want will pop up on a single screen so you really can compare apples to oranges (and jeans to fridges) literally. Then click to buy and have it delivered same day.
INSTANT BROWSING
Type a list, record speech or search and compare. Botit makes ordering anything faster and easier than ever.
EMPOWERING INDEPENDENT BRANDS 
As well as iconic international brands, Botit list a huge variety of independent retailers so you can discover and shop the best local products.
AI POWERED
Botit is first artificial intelligence powered e-commerce app in Egypt. No concierge, no middle men, Botit understand your order and delivers directly to your door.
SAME HOUR TO SAME DAY DELIVERY
All orders across all categories can be delivered between the same hour to the same day depending on the item. Live tracking allows you to monitor where your order is at any time.

bluejetty:00174763:ios.description:
AdGuard VPN hides your real IP address and location, encrypts your traffic, and protects your data online. Be sure your data is safe: we have a strict no-logging policy.
Why we're proud of AdGuard VPN:
- Proprietary VPN protocol
We have developed our own AdGuard VPN protocol. It’s fast, secure, and works reliably even on slow or problematic networks.
- Website exclusions
Decide where AdGuard VPN should be on: everywhere except for certain websites or on selected websites only.
- 85+ locations
Choose the location that best meets your needs — we have servers from America to Australia.
- Up to 10 devices simultaneously
Log in to your AdGuard account on any of your devices — with a subscription, you can use your VPN on 10 devices simultaneously.
- Safe and secure browsing
AdGuard VPN securely encrypts your traffic — purchase online or use public Wi-Fi networks, and be sure your personal data is safe.
- No-logging policy
We don’t collect or share your personal data with anyone. Neither we nor your Internet service provider know what you’re doing online.

The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID settings.

bluejetty:00150395:ios.description:
Meds, talk therapy, or self-care not quite getting you there? Achieve your breakthrough with clinician-prescribed, guided psychedelic experiences to help combat anxiety or depression.
Our science-backed programs are designed by leading psychiatrists and facilitated by caring, expert guides.
Ready to join thousands of others who’ve improved their lives with Mindbloom? Go to mindbloom.com to take our brief assessment and begin your healing journey today!
INCLUDED IN OUR INITIAL PROGRAM, THE BASICS
- 6 At-home Ketamine Treatments
- 1 Bloombox (Premium At-home Care Kit)
- 2 Psychiatric Clinician Consults
- 3 Guide Sessions (1 Prep / 2 Integration)
- Unlimited Group Integration Sessions
- Unlimited Messaging
HOW MINDBLOOM WORKS
- Take our brief assessment to see if you’re a fit
- Book your video consult with a Mindbloom clinician
- Meet with your Mindbloom Guide to set your intentions
- Relax and enjoy your healing journey in the comfort of your home
- Meet with your Mindbloom guide to integrate your experience
- Continue building on your progress
IS MINDBLOOM EFFECTIVE?
Yes! Over 90% of clients report improvement in depressive symptoms and over 92% of clients report improvement in anxiety symptoms after two sessions.*
*Clients with moderate to severe depression or anxiety who report improvement in symptoms after two sessions (1+ points on PHQ-9)
See important safety information at: https://www.mindbloom.com/safety-information
CONNECT WITH US!
We’re always happy to connect and receive feedback.
Email us: support@mindbloom.com
Check out our website: mindbloom.com
Follow us on Twitter: twitter.com/mymindbloom

bluejetty:00019350:ios.name: Pro Snooker 2026
bluejetty:00019350:ios.summary: Following the worldwide success of its sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Snooker 2026, probably one of the most realistic and playable snooker and pool games available on mobile devices. Boasting fully textured game environments and
bluejetty:00019350:ios.description:
Following the worldwide success of its sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Snooker 2026, probably one of the most realistic and playable snooker and pool games available on mobile devices. Boasting fully textured game environments and full 3D rigid body physics this game is the complete package for both casual and serious gamers.
The simple click and play interface allows you to pick up and play the game quickly, or alternatively for the more serious players the game includes cue ball control allowing you to perform more advanced shots including back spin, top spin, left spin (Left english), right spin (Right english) and ball swerve. 
So whether you want a simple easy and fun snooker game or a full on simulation this game is for you. 
Download Pro Snooker 2026 now and try it for free, you will not be disappointed. 
System Requirements: 
∙ Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch. 
∙ Supports iOS 15.0 and above. 
∙ Utilizes Retina displays on compatible devices. 
∙ Game Center compatible. 
Game Features: 
∙ Localized to English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Canadian French and Mexican Spanish.
∙ Full High Def 3D textured environments. 
∙ Full 3D physics at 60 FPS.
∙ Free online multiplayer games
∙ Free local network multiplayer games
∙ Practice: Fine tune your game by playing on your own with no rules. 
∙ Quick Play: Play a custom match against another friend, family member or computer opponent. 
∙ League: Participate in a league event over 7 rounds where the highest points total wins. 
∙ Tournament: Test your nerves in a 4 round knockout tournament event. 
∙ Configure up to 3 player profiles to keep track of all your statistics. 
∙ Each profile contains comprehensive statistics and progression history. 
∙ Select your handicap level with 5 levels of aiming and ball guide mark-ups. 
∙ Select your preferred post shot camera through your player’s profile. 
∙ Progress through the ranks from Rookie to Legend. Beware you can go down the ranks as well as up. 
∙ Play against 25 different computer opponents spread over 5 difficulty levels. 
∙ Fully customizable tables, choose from over 100 combinations of table finish effects and baize colors. 
∙ Play snooker on regulation 10ft and 12ft rectangular tables. 
∙ Test your skills on the non-regulation Casket, Clover, Hexagonal, L-Shaped and Square tables.
∙ Play 6 Red Ball Snooker, 10 Red Ball Snooker and 15 Red Ball Snooker based on WPBAS rules. 
∙ Play US 10 Ball and Black Ball pool based on WPA rules. 
∙ Play World Eight Ball Pool based on WEPF rules.
∙ 14.1 Continuous pool based on WPA rules.
∙ Bonus 8ft snooker table for pool games.
∙ Bonus 9ft Pool table. 
∙ Bonus Chinese 8 Ball table.
∙ Fully featured ball control system allowing back spin, top spin, left spin (Left english), right spin (Right english) and swerve shots. 
∙ Choose from various camera views including 3D, Top Cushion and Overhead views. 
∙ 20+ game achievements to collect locally or via Game Center. 
∙ Take action photos and share them via Email or save them to your device. 
∙ In game tips and help.

bluejetty:00055681:android:0.name: Firefox Focus: No Fuss Browser
bluejetty:00055681:android:0.summary: Effortless, companion browser for your super quick, private searches.
bluejetty:00055681:android:0.description:
Use Firefox Focus for everything you want to keep separate from your main browser — for all those get in get out and forget about it moments. No tabs, no fuss, no muss. Block ads and online trackers too. One tap, and your browsing history is completely destroyed. 
Blocking distracting ads also means faster page loads which means Focus gets you where you want to go a lot faster. Firefox Focus is the perfect get in/get out, search and destroy, I’m on a mission that’s none-of-your-business — web browser. 
NEW DISTRACTION-FREE DESIGN
When you open Focus, you just get the awesome bar and the keyboard for super quick searching. That’s it. No recent history, no past sites, no open tabs, no ads, no distractions. Just a simple, minimal design with menus that make sense. 
ONE TAP TO DELETE HISTORY
Erase your history, passwords and cookies with just a tap of the trash button. 
CREATE SHORTCUTS
Pin up to four shortcuts on your home screen. Get to your favorite site even quicker without typing anything. 
FASTER BROWSING WITH AD BLOCKING & TRACKING PROTECTION
Firefox Focus blocks many ads you’d normally see on web pages so you get much faster page load speeds, which means you get to the stuff you want a lot faster. Focus also blocks a wide range of trackers by default, including social trackers and those sticky ones that come from things like Facebook ads.
BACKED BY A NON-PROFIT
Firefox Focus is backed by Mozilla, the non-profit that fights for your rights on the web, so you can trust it not to sell your data.
LEARN MORE ABOUT FIREFOX WEB BROWSER:
- Read about Firefox permissions: http://mzl.la/Permissions
- Learn more about what’s up at Mozilla: https://blog.mozilla.org
ABOUT MOZILLA
Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe open and free is better than closed and controlled. We build products like Firefox to promote choice and transparency and give people more control over their lives online. Learn more at https://www.mozilla.org.
Privacy Policy: http://www.mozilla.org/legal/privacy/firefox.html

bluejetty:00170112:ios.description:
Flare is the ultimate app for groups.
Flare keeps your group connected, organized, and engaged—all in one app. Whether you’re running a student organization, campus council, alumni network, or a national community, Flare makes communication effortless and events unforgettable.
Why Flare?
Tired of juggling endless group chats, scattered files, and disorganized calendars? Flare brings everything together: messages, events, attendance, photos, polls, points and more. With privacy controls and high‑quality features, it’s the smarter way to manage your community.
Key Features & Benefits:
▶ Events & Attendance – Create and share events with details, RSVPs, and reminders. Track attendance with QR codes, passcodes, geolocation, or ticketing.
▶ Group Chats & Announcements – Keep everyone in the loop with customizable chats and a dedicated announcement wall. Optional message approval gives admins control when needed.
▶ Albums & Highlights – Upload high‑quality photos (up to 5000px), save your favorite photos, and share approved highlights.
▶ Engagement Tools – Polls, points system, birthday reminders, and alumni engagement.
▶ Payments Made Easy – Sell tickets or collect payments with Venmo integration.
▶ Seamless Organization – Share files, manage rosters, connect with alumni, and build lasting group connections.
Built for Privacy & Control:
- Protect your chats with screenshot blocking and admin notifications
- Admin can delete messages and suspend members
- Settings to approve messages, highlights, and membership requests.
Join 500,000+ users already using Flare to simplify communication and boost engagement!

bluejetty:00141447:ios.description:
Tile Scenery: Match Puzzle is an engaging and visually captivating casual game that invites players into a vibrant world of tile-matching fun. With its charming graphics and intuitive gameplay, this puzzle game offers a delightful experience for players of all ages.

One app – all your services! We’ve made it even easier for residential customers to sign in and manage your Spectrum account with My Spectrum App.
Pay Your Spectrum Bill
• Pay your bill for Spectrum Mobile, Internet, TV and Home Phone.
• Enroll in Auto Pay: Never miss a billing due date.
• Schedule one-time payments: Control how and when your Spectrum payment is sent.
• Sign-up for paperless billing.
• Find statements: Review previous billing statements and service history.
Do You Speak Spanish? 
• Toggle your language preferences from English to Spanish right in the app.
Manage Mobile Services
• Check your Spectrum Mobile data usage and manage your plans.
• Add and activate your new Mobile line. 
Stay Informed
• Get billing, equipment, activation and outage notifications right on the home screen.
• Upgrade to Advanced WiFi and receive our best-in-class Security Suite.
• Troubleshoot your WiFi and internet connections with our enhanced dual Speed Test.
• Find your nearest Spectrum Store.

• Conveniently manage your streaming subscriptions in one place.

Simplified Support
• Self-install your modem, router and other devices without making an appointment.
• Chat with us in app, including live Spectrum customer service. 
• Track your technician in the app.
• Quickly search and find answers with our newly designed support section.
Tell Us What You Think
• Share feedback about your app experience – we read every comment.
• We love suggestions about the My Spectrum App – we use customer feedback when we plan our updates.
Discover Our Other Apps
• Spectrum TV: Stream movie and TV favorites right from your phone.
• Spectrum Sports: Never miss a game when you’re on the go.
• Spectrum News: Local news, weather, events and more.
• Spectrum Enterprise: For when your office means business.

bluejetty:00115505:ios.description:
United Bank Digital is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with United Bank Digital:
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the United Bank Digital app, you must be enrolled as a United Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00180846:ios.description:
Dịch tiếng Anh sang tiếng Việt, phát âm US và UK chuẩn, dịch văn bản Anh Việt - Việt Anh offline.
Hơn 400.000 từ Anh Việt, 150.000 từ Việt Anh, phát âm giọng Anh Mỹ và Anh Anh chuẩn.
Đặc biệt phần mềm cho phép bạn tra chéo bất kỳ từ tiếng Anh nào trong phần mềm bằng cách chạm vào bất kỳ từ nào cần tra.
Phần mềm còn tích hợp thêm những chức năng hỗ trợ học tiếng Anh, luyện từ vựng.
Chức năng chính:
* Tra từ Anh Việt offline
* Dịch văn bản offline
* Dịch chữ trong hình ảnh
* Tra từ bằng giọng nói
* Đăng nhập để backup (sao lưu) từ của bạn phòng khi điện thoại bị mất hay đổi điện thoại.
* Tích hợp chức năng nhắc nhở học từ vựng hàng ngày cực hay.
Tài khoản VIP có những chức năng sau:
* Cho phép tạo thư mục để học và quản lý từ của bạn tốt hơn.
* Có các gói từ vựng luyện thi chất lượng cao: giải nghĩa chi tiết, ví dụ cụ thể, hình ảnh chuẩn xác, có bài tập trắc nghiệm riêng.
* Có hình ảnh minh hoạ cho từ vựng.
-----
Điều khoản đăng ký tự động gia hạn:
* Bạn có thể hủy đăng ký bất kỳ lúc nào bằng cách tắt tính năng tự động gia hạn thông qua cài đặt tài khoản iTunes của mình. Việc này phải được thực hiện 24 giờ trước khi kết thúc thời gian đăng ký để tránh bị tính phí. Việc hủy bỏ sẽ có hiệu lực ngay ngày sau ngày cuối cùng của thời hạn đăng ký hiện tại và bạn sẽ xuống thành sử dụng Miễn phí.
* Tài khoản sẽ bị trừ tiền gia hạn trong vòng 24 giờ trước thời điểm kết thúc giai đoạn hiện tại và xác định chi phí gia hạn.
-----
Điều khoản Dịch vụ: https://tienganhkala.com/terms.html

Speak with confidence. Get better with every conversation.
Meet Speeko, your AI speech coach. Whether you’re preparing for a big presentation, practicing for a job interview, or simply want to sound more confident in everyday conversations, Speeko helps you become a better communicator.
Get personalized feedback, practice real conversations, and build your speaking skills one step at a time.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH SPEEKO
- Get instant speech feedback: Discover how you speak with AI-powered feedback on your pace, filler words, tone, pauses, and more. Learn what you’re doing well and where you can improve.
- Practice real conversations: Build confidence with Convos, our interactive AI roleplays. Practice job interviews, difficult conversations, small talk, and more in a safe space where you can try again and learn as you go.
- Learn with bite-sized lessons: Explore personalized lessons, guided exercises, and courses designed to help you speak clearly, confidently, and effectively.
- Prepare for important moments: Rehearse presentations, speeches, interviews, and meetings with tools that help you organize your thoughts and deliver your message.
- Build a daily speaking habit: Warm up your voice, practice new skills, and make progress with just a few minutes a day.
COACHING BACKED BY EXPERTS
Speeko combines AI-powered feedback with communication training developed by speaking experts, including renowned voice coach Roger Love.
Join hundreds of thousands of people who have used Speeko to become better communicators.
Download Speeko for free and start finding your voice today.

bluejetty:00030742:ios.description:
Welcome to the Macrofit App.
Home to the most diverse portfolio of athletes for fitness and sport specific training.
We work with professional athletes and trainers in the following sports: Surfing, Skiing, Basketball, Boxing, Golf, Calisthenics, Tennis, Rock Climbing, Yoga, Pilates, Running, Volleyball, and more. We also have programs for resistance training, weight-loss, and meditation.
Our roster of athlete instructors include:
John Collinson - Pro Big Mountain Skier
Nick Symmonds - 2x Olympic Runner
Koa Smith - Pro Surfer
Alex Puccio - Pro Rock Climber, 11x National Bouldering Champion
Tony Jeffries - Olympic Medalist Boxer
Tori Boggs - 30x Grand World Jump Rope Champion
Dr. Jen Esquer - Doctor of Physical Therapy
Daniel Rama - International Yoga Instructor and Teacher
Streat Hoerner - 2x CrossFit Games Athlete
Our members get access to all of our programs as well as our professionally curated nutrition options with options such paleo, keto, intermittent fasting, vegan and more. Track your macros, log your workouts, and use many other features to help you reach your goals.
Our most popular programs include:
*Project Calisthenics
Learn from one of the world’s top calisthenics athletes and physiotherapists, Simon Ata. Train for skills like the handstand pushup, planche, backlever, OAPU, and more.
*Surfer Fit
Train like a professional surfer. This program is all bodyweight and designed to build you the strength, mobility, and cardio needed to boost your surfing game.
*Skier Fit
John Collinson is a professional big mountain skier and known for his dedicated approach to fitness. Use just your bodyweight to get yourself in shape for the ski season.
*Jiu Jitsu Fit
Pro BJJ athlete JT Torres uses fun, dynamic exercises to not only build cardio and strength but to also get your body more familiar with BJJ movements.
*Mobility for Calisthenics
Doc Jen is not only a renowned doctor of physical therapy, but also an ex-calisthenics athlete. She prepared the perfect mobility program for all calisthenics athletes to further their skills.
*Fit Yogasthenics
Yogasthenics is a fusion of yoga, calisthenics, and holistic functional movement. This program is similar to a yoga class but with a twist that’s meant to challenge your inner athlete.
++many more
The Macrofit App features:
1) Workout programs by sport and fitness pros:
 -Track your progress day to day
 -View full tutorials on every exercise of every program
 -Track your progress by logging workouts, images, and more
 -Compare and compete on the leaderboard
2) Thousands of recipes and meal plans:
 -Choose from our database of over 3.2M recipes sorted to your dietary needs
 -Variety of meal plans and challenges to get you to your goal
 -Calculate, set and track your macros
3) Challenges
 -Challenge a friend to a variety of fitness challenges
 -Challenge and compete against your favorite athlete
4) Innovative Hardware
 -Our top-tier team of engineers is always working on the next innovative design for home or sport specific training.
 -Check out the Fit! Home Gym. It’s the most versatile and compact bodyweight gym.
Integrate with HealthKit to keep track of your steps, mileage, and flights of stairs to measure your progress each week.
Customize your workouts with the Macrofit AI coach - tens of thousands of exercise videos available.
———
Learn more at http://www.macrofit.co

https://www.joinfitapp.com/terms.html

TimelyCare is an all-in-one solution that provides 24/7, easily accessible, private, and direct mental health and medical services to foster student success and improve the health and well-being of campus communities through equitable access to care.
Based on an academic institution’s subscription to TimelyCare’s services, enrolled users can access virtual visits via the app or website with a nationwide network of care providers, including but not limited to doctors, counselors, nurse practitioners, health coaches, and success coaches. All visits are 100% confidential and secure.
The platform’s services include scheduled mental health counseling, on-demand emotional support, on-demand and scheduled medical care, psychiatric care, health coaching, on-demand or scheduled student success coaching, basic needs assistance, faculty and staff guidance, peer support, and self-care content.
TimelyCare’s digital self-care includes a community for peer-to-peer support, self-care content on topics like stress, anxiety and relationships, success courses to help students navigate common academic, financial and career challenges, and self-care journeys designed to help users navigate the unique health challenges they face and achieve better health and well-being.

bluejetty:00076660:ios.description:
Caliber is a science-based strength training app that combines resistance training, cardio, nutrition, and habit formation to help you build muscle, lose weight, and improve your overall fitness - for good.
TRAIN YOUR WAY
• Free Version. Create and track unlimited workouts, access 800+ exercises, and train solo or with friends.
• Caliber Plus. Maximize your results with coach-designed training plans, personalized progress tracking, nutrition targets and more.
• Premium Coaching. Get 1-on-1 guidance from an elite-level personal trainer with a fully customized training and nutrition plan, in-app chat + video messaging with your coach and weekly progress reviews to keep you on track.
CALIBER FEATURES (FREE VERSION)
• Personalized Workouts. Create and track an unlimited number of workouts tailored to your goals. No gym required.
• Detailed Exercise Tutorials. Learn proper form with step-by-step videos and pro tips from Caliber coaches.
• Workout Circles. Train with friends and family in private workout chats. When you hit a personal best, it's shared with the group.
• Apple Health Integration. Sync your cardio, nutrition, steps and body stats from your wearable or connected device.
• Connect to AI. Sync your training data with ChatGPT and Claude for personalized insights and training analysis.
UNLOCK MORE WITH CALIBER PLUS (OPTIONAL UPGRADE)
• Coach-Designed Training Plans. Choose from 120+ structured plans tailored to your goals, experience level and schedule.
• Strength Score. Measure how strong you are relative to your potential for your age and gender.
• Strength Balance. Improve your posture and mobility by optimizing your training across key muscle groups.
• Caliber Lessons. Gain expert insights on training and nutrition to accelerate your progress.
• Advanced Training Features. Get personalized nutrition targets, create custom exercises and supersets, swap exercises, upload progress photos, and more.
PREMIUM COACHING (OPTIONAL UPGRADE)
• Work with an Elite-Level Coach. Train 1-on-1 with a dedicated coach to achieve your full potential in the gym and beyond. Caliber coaches are highly vetted, accredited personal trainers among the top 1% in their field.
• Fully Personalized Plan. Your coach will design a training and nutrition program just for you based on your goals, experience and lifestyle.
• Daily Motivation & Expert Guidance. Stay on track with in-app messaging, video form reviews, and individualized guidance.
• Weekly Progress Reviews. Get in-depth analysis from your coach to optimize your training.
• Fast Response Times. Your coach is available 24/7, typically replying within a few hours.
• Guaranteed Results. On average, Caliber members improve their body composition by 20% or more within 12 weeks. If you don't see results, we'll refund the cost of the program.
SEE WHAT OUR MEMBERS SAY

Assemble a wide variety of brick buildings and scenes in this classic constructor game. Start as a baby builder and level your way up to increasingly complex construction sets. This relaxing and satisfying game is sure to bring you back to the imagination and fun of your childhood! 
Flex your creativity and exercise your brain with enjoyable construction puzzles. Writer’s block or mental block? Bust through it like a ton of bricks with this BLOCKbuster building game! 
► BUILD YOUR WORLD BRICK BY BRICK
Follow the simple on-screen guide to create your own brick masterpieces in the form of detailed 3D models! Find the right piece and simply tap to add it to your build. The colorful pieces and lively scenes make this building game a hoot for builders of all ages! 
In Construction Set, you never have to worry about losing a piece or prying bricks apart and hurting your fingers, because it’s all virtual! Get hands-on fun without the clutter or accidentally stepping on toys. Ouch! 
► GAME FEATURES:
• Dozens of sets and over 200 different interlocking parts. From human figures to intricate vehicles, this constructor game has it all! 
• With entertaining construction sets like the Statue of Liberty, a battlefield, a medieval castle, ancient Rome, and the inside of a spaceship, you’ll never get bored! Build a pizza delivery boy holding up the Tower of Pisa and dive into trending and topical sets like an election debate scene.
• The clear instructions and 3D models ensure you never get stuck. Just find the part you need and plug it into place!
• Thanks to the easy-to-use interface, anyone can be an architect! Plus, this game’s stunning graphics and smooth animations bring the building experience to life.
• This satisfying game recreates the joy of assembling real-life construction sets, from cutting open the box and ripping open the bags to putting together the blocks and arranging the finished scenes. The optional vibration setting even replicates the “click” of real blocks snapping together! Why snap when you can just tap? 
• Complete a set to unlock special gold packages so you can add new elements with more difficult builds. You never know what you’re going to find inside! 
Whether you’re looking for a workout for your mind or yearning for a sense of nostalgia and childish wonder, block off some time to relax and then hit the bricks with this building game! Download Construction Set now and start building! 
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00143950:ios.summary:
Food delivery service from grocery stores, cafes and restaurants
You can order both burgers and steaks, as well as products from grocery stores. Free delivery for your first order!
ALL NEARBY GROCERIES AND RESTAURANTS IN ONE APP
Get your
bluejetty:00143950:ios.description:
Food delivery service from grocery stores, cafes and restaurants
You can order both burgers and steaks, as well as products from grocery stores. Free delivery for your first order!
ALL NEARBY GROCERIES AND RESTAURANTS IN ONE APP
Get your groceries delivered from both popular stores and local markets. And for those who don't want to cook, you can find your favorite dishes from cafes and restaurants. In Yandex Eats, you can order a cooked pizza or ingredients for it.
ORDER FAST DELIVERY TO YOUR ADDRESS
Enter the delivery address — we will find the nearest store or restaurant to you and deliver the order as quickly as possible. On average food is delivered in 32 minutes after placing an order — even faster than you would get ready to go shopping.
TRACK YOUR ORDER 
In the app, you can find out the status of the order and the location of the courier.
USE FILTERS TO FIND EVERYTHING YOU NEED
With filters you can find a specific cuisine or dish with one click. “Burgers”, “Sushi”, “Pizza” — Yandex Eats has sets for every occasion.
DISCOUNTS AND SPECIAL OFFERS EVERY DAY 
In the app, you can place an order profitably: for example, get free delivery or a dish as a gift. In the section “Promotions” we collect the best offers from shops and restaurants every day.
Yandex Eats is an information service. Delivery zones, delivery times, and restaurant offers are limited. To learn more, go to eda.yandex. Fast delivery: the average order delivery time is 32 minutes according to data from January 18 to January 25, 2022.

bluejetty:00159457:ios.description:
Do you want to send files from WhatsApp to cloud storage services like Dropbox, Google Photos, Cloud Drive, or OneDrive? Do you want to move your media out of WhatsApp and into a more secure space, such as pCloud, Terabox, or your Cloud storage? Are you running low on device storage due to WhatsApp media files?
This app is a simple and effective tool for content transfer to cloud storage platforms, including Google Photos, OneDrive, and Dropbox. Whether you’re looking to copy my data or transfer my data for backup, cloud sharing, or privacy reasons, this is a must-have solution. It’s especially helpful for users who aim to reduce local data usage and instead rely on a cloud drive for secure storage and mobile transfer.
The app makes it easy to get media and other files from various apps—not just WhatsApp—and send them to cloud services via a straightforward copy and paste method. It supports data transfer to cloud storage platforms like Dropbox and OneDrive, keeping your content secure and accessible. It’s perfect for anyone needing to manage their storage, share files through My Cloud Home, or shift entirely using services like Apple's Move to iOS.
FEATURES
· Free up device space by transferring multiple files to a cloud drive
· Store files in cloud storage instead of on your device
· Keep your data protected with
· Make files private and off your local device
· Access files from any device using OneDrive or Dropbox
· Just link your preferred cloud account (Dropbox) once for seamless use
ADVANCED FEATURES
· Requires minimal setup for content transfer
· No device storage needed—copy/paste handled in memory
· Supports clipboard-based transfer method
· Works with iPhone, iPod Touch, iPad
· Handles multiple file types: images, videos, PDFs, audio, and more
· Fully supports mixed media content
· Built-in folder view for upload verification on platforms like Dropbox
CLOUD PLATFORMS SUPPORTED
· Dropbox / Drop box
· Google Photos / Google Drive
· OneDrive / One drive / One drive app
· Terabox
· pCloud
· My Cloud Home
SUPPORTED FILE TYPES
· Images and photos
· Videos and audio
· Plain and rich text
· PDFs and HTML
· Other standard media types
AN IDEAL SOLUTION FOR USERS NEEDING:
· WhatsApp to Dropbox (WhatsApp2Dropbox)
· WhatsApp to Google Drive (WhatsApp2GoogleDrive)
· WhatsApp to OneDrive (WhatsApp2OneDrive)
· WhatsApp to pCloud or Terabox
· WhatsApp to Cloud Drive (WhatsApp2CloudDrive)
· Copy my data or transfer my data to the iCloud app
· Move to iOS or Apple Move to iOS solutions for mobile transfer
· Easy content transfer between multiple cloud storage systems

bluejetty:00094749:ios.name: get Adulting
bluejetty:00094749:ios.summary: Finally, an app that is actually all-in-one, teaches you, and respects your privacy!! Get Adulting keeps your health, car, pets, family, bills, mental health, home, to-dos, daily habits, and more in one calm and customizable space with buil
bluejetty:00094749:ios.description:
Finally, an app that is actually all-in-one, teaches you, and respects your privacy!! Get Adulting keeps your health, car, pets, family, bills, mental health, home, to-dos, daily habits, and more in one calm and customizable space with built-in, offline education. No AI, no ads, no tracking - just simple, thoughtful tools and reminders that help you navigate adulthood (+ you can change the app color, sync with your calendar & partner, and use widgets)!
Keep Track of Your Health:
Get reminders for checkups, track prescriptions, store doctor info/visits, vaccines, track BP, blood pressure, etc., and jot down personal health notes - all in one secure and convenient place (your data never leaves your phone). 
Never Miss a Deadline:
Get clear reminders on upcoming car maintenance, emissions, or registration renewals. Plus, built-in education on car care that helps keep both you and your ride safe on the road!
Pet Care Made Easy:
Store pet details (microchip number, birthday, etc.), track pet food, store vet info, add pet reminders, and more!
Plus, a bunch of extra sections including:
- My Family: track info, meds, allergies, vaccines, doctors, reminders, and more for your family members, all offline!
- My Budget: offline bill management with bill reminders
- Mental Health: Breathing animations, digital fidgets, resources, and focus timers designed to help with ADHD and neurodivergence, sensory regulation, and daily overwhelm!
- Adulting Tasks: pre-made reminders for pesky 'adulting' tasks such as weekly toweling washing, cleaning out your fridge, and others!
- Daily Tasks: Custom tasks that reset daily at midnight - perfect for tasks like drinking water, journaling, etc!
- Reminders, To-Dos, and Lists & Notes: standard reminders, a to-do list for ongoing to-dos, plus standard lists & notes!
- To-Do Spin Wheel: let the wheel decide for you! 
- Women's Health: track your cycle offline with reminders, last pap smear, and see helpful education.
- Recipes: save your favorite recipes, utilize the recipe adjuster, or access conversion charts and cooking basics! + Spin Wheel!
- Solitaire: No ads, no pop-ups - just a free, endless game for you to keep your brain sharp!
The best part? All data is stored locally so data never leaves your device!! Want to sync with a partner or have back-up? Enable the optional Sync in App Settings for an additional low monthly cost.
PLUS, the app is fully customizable!! 
- Customize your Home: See your sections in Space, Duck Pond, or Pushpin Board - all yours to customize!!
- Change App Theme: Update app color, background, font, seasonal themes, and more!
- Enable Dark Mode: match system settings or keep enabled (plus fully customize!)
- Turn On/Off Sections: Don't have a pet? Turn off the 'My Pets' section. Don't care about Recipes? Turn it off and never see it again - it's your choice!
Unlock All Features: Only $2.99USD / year (or $14.99USD lifetime) after a 7‑day free trial. Purchase required to access all features. Two hour preview available with no sign up required!
Hi!! My name is Breanna and I created this app from my own experiences of feeling lost trying to navigate adulthood since there is no guide to being an adult and you are left to rely on the adults in your life or the education you seek out yourself. I was struck by executive dysfunction and wanted something that actually helped me (+ was accessible). That's what led to my idea for my app! Get Adulting is THE guide to adulthood. The work isn't left on you to know what to do, you just follow the templated app! I hope you love it!
Get Adulting is available globally, with an optional 'Outside of the US' button to hide US info. More international updates & languages coming!

Privacy Policy: https://www.getadulting.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.getadulting.com/terms-of-use
Contact: https://www.getadulting.com/contact
Get Adulting® | Hype Digital LLC

bluejetty:00095491:ios.name: NaukNauk: Bring Fandom to Life
bluejetty:00095491:ios.summary: Rediscover the spark! NaukNauk is the playground built for adult fans who believe imagination shouldn't just be remembered, it should shape your everyday life. If your passion for comics, anime, games, movies, collectibles, and beloved char
bluejetty:00095491:ios.description:
Rediscover the spark! NaukNauk is the playground built for adult fans who believe imagination shouldn't just be remembered, it should shape your everyday life. If your passion for comics, anime, games, movies, collectibles, and beloved characters is a core part of who you are, you've finally found your dedicated home.
Stop scattering your fandom across platforms not designed for it! NaukNauk is your central hub to celebrate, connect, and magically bring your fandom to life.
UNBOX YOUR FANDOM WITH NAUKNAUK:
COLLECT: Showcase & Organize What You Love
- Your Digital Museum: Create beautiful, personalized "digital shelves" to display your physical and digital collectibles. Let your collection shine!
- Master Your Collection: Easily manage what you own, track items on your wishlist, and add personal stories or notes to your treasured pieces.
- Discover Epic Finds: Explore vast databases tied to your favorite fandoms. Uncover new items, artists, or series you might have missed.
CONNECT: Join a Vibrant Community of Fans
- Find Your People: Dive into dedicated hubs focused on specific fandoms, characters, creators, or types of collections. Connect with others who share your specific interests and enthusiasm.
- Share Authentically: Post your latest unboxings, display your setups, share nostalgic memories, discuss fan theories, or showcase creative projects in a truly supportive environment.
- Build Real Connections: Follow fellow fans whose collections or posts inspire you. Comment, share tips, discuss the latest news, and forge genuine friendships built on shared joy and passion.
ANIMATE: Make Your Fandom LIVE!
- Static to Spectacular: Upload a static image of your favorite fandom character or figure.
- Watch the Magic Happen: Our unique technology generates a short video, making your character come alive!
- See Them Move: Witness your figures move, jump, smile, or even cry right from your photo.
- Share the Wonder: Create and share these incredible animated moments with the NaukNauk community or your friends!
WHY CHOOSE NAUKNAUK?
NaukNauk is more than just an app – it's a community celebrating the power of imagination and fandom in adult life. We are dedicated to:
- Celebrating Lifelong Fandom: Championing the passions you cherish, no matter when your fan journey began.
- Fostering Authentic Connection: Providing a safe, inclusive, and positive space designed for genuine interaction between enthusiasts.
- Promoting Joyful Self-Expression: Empowering you to share what brings you joy, freely and enthusiastically, including unique animated creations.
- Making Imagination Interactive: Offering innovative tools like Animate to literally bring elements of your beloved fandoms to life.
Ready to truly "unbox your fandom," connect with a thriving community, and see your favorite characters move?
Download NaukNauk today and start animating your imagination!
Term of use: https://www.nauknauk.io/terms

bluejetty:00061994:ios.summary: This is a cake cooking game that all kids love. Its 3D graphics and simple operation make you feel like you're baking real cakes! Come and run your own cake shop! Become a cake maker and bake sweet cakes! Create interesting stories at the c
bluejetty:00061994:ios.description:
This is a cake cooking game that all kids love. Its 3D graphics and simple operation make you feel like you're baking real cakes! Come and run your own cake shop! Become a cake maker and bake sweet cakes! Create interesting stories at the cake shop and build your own bakery empire! 
CAKE BAKING
At the cake shop, you can find all kinds of cake baking tools, ingredients and cake recipes, including baking pans, mixers, milk, chocolate sauce and more! You can make holiday cakes, strawberry cakes, cream cakes, doughnuts and any cake you like here! 
CREATIVE DECORATION
You can use colorful tablecloths, chairs, cups, teapots and other items to decorate your cake shop into more than 20 styles, which will add more fun and surprises to your cake shop story! Come and have a try! How would you decorate the cake tasting area?
CAKE SHARING
After making a cake, you can invite your friends over and share the freshly baked cake or other dessert with them. The happy times you spend with your friends will become your unforgettable memories!
Come to Little Panda's Cake Shop! Bake cakes, doughnuts and other desserts! Let's create a big bakery empire!
FEATURES:
- 7 types of desserts: pudding, strawberry cake, cream cake,doughnut and more;
- 20+ kinds of ingredients: egg, flour, butter, cheese and more;
- A variety of cake baking tools: shaped baking pans, oven, beaters, and more;
- A fun cake baking game;
- Build your own bakery empire!
About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 600 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have released over 200 children's apps, over 2500 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations, over 9000 stories of various themes spanning the Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields.
—————
Contact us: ser@babybus.com
Visit us: https://app.babybus.com

Los Angeles Transit makes getting around LA easier with live stop times, real-time vehicle tracking, and interactive route maps for Metro, Metrolink, and DASH / Commuter Express, plus many local transit agencies across the region. Check upcoming departures, find nearby stops, and get reliable transit info whether you’re commuting downtown, heading to school, or catching a ride across the city.

The app also includes support for major systems like Orange County Transportation Authority (OCTA), Long Beach Transit (LBT), Big Blue Bus, Foothill Transit, and more — all in one place.

Whether you’re riding in Downtown LA, Hollywood, Santa Monica, Pasadena, Long Beach, Glendale, Burbank, Culver City, or to and from LAX, Los Angeles Transit helps you get there on time.

bluejetty:00080151:ios.description:
******************
FREE FULL GAME
NO ADS
*****************
FOOTBALL WORLD MASTER IS BACK WITH AN ARRAY OF NEW FEATURES
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
Purchase clubs and national teams from around the world.
Recruit the best players and develop them.
Invest your money in transfers, staff members, training facilities, and stadiums to advance the team.
Lead your clubs to the top of world football or sell them and pocket the jackpot.
Manage multiple clubs simultaneously to multiply your earnings.
The road will be long but your goal is within reach: to win the most prestigious trophies and become THE MASTER OF WORLD FOOTBALL!
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
NEW FEATURE: PLAYERS
Consult detailed information and statistics of your club's players, track their performances, and make the right decisions regarding player purchases, sales, and contract renewals.
NEW CLUB ACQUISITION SYSTEM
Don't wait for a club to be put up for sale to try to buy it. You can now contact all the clubs in the game and negotiate their selling price if your reputation is high enough.
NEW CLUB SUPERVISION SYSTEM
Interested in a club but lacking information about its actual level and financial situation? Conduct a supervision and receive all this information.
NEW EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS
Now compete in the three major European club competitions: The Champions League, The Europa League, and the Europa Conference League.
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
YOU'RE THE BOSS
Your role isn't to train the team. Your role is to make decisions:
Change coaches or provide them with the means to improve.
Accept or reject transfers and contract renewals.
Choose your sports director, marketing director, and fitness coach.
Listen to your staff's advice and accept or reject their requests.
Invest your money to improve the training facilities to advance the club in the long term.
Set ticket prices for your stadium and build a larger one.
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
CARE FOR YOUR REPUTATION
You'll sometimes have to choose between financial profitability and the sporting future of your clubs. Between your personal interest and that of the supporters. Between your wealth and your popularity. It will take talent, great business acumen, and perfect communication to become rich and popular.
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
A COMPLETE SIMULATION
Over 200 competitions in 82 countries.
1800 clubs and 82 national teams.
National and international competitions from 5 continents.
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
BUY AT THE RIGHT TIME, SELL AT THE RIGHT PRICE
Winning trophies will earn you money, but nothing is more profitable than selling a club after advancing it.
- - - - - - - - - - - - -
YOUR CLUBS' POPULARITY WILL DEFINE YOURS
The fervor of the supporters is a central element of the game. If you make decisions solely to improve the profitability of your clubs, your popularity will decrease, and your stadiums will empty. But if you give a club the means to win trophies, you'll become the idol of the city.

bluejetty:00185290:ios.summary:

Kingdom Rush Origins is the third installment of the award-winning Kingdom Rush saga, loved by millions and earning accolades from gamers an
bluejetty:00185290:ios.description:
Unleash the power of the elves with brand new towers and troops - welcome to Kingdom Rush Origins!
Kingdom Rush Origins is the third installment of the award-winning Kingdom Rush saga, loved by millions and earning accolades from gamers and critics around the globe.
Take a trip back to the beginning, before Vez’nan ever thought to threaten the kingdom with the gem of power, and experience even more of the lightning-fast, exceptionally captivating gameplay that made the franchise a cornerstone of essential tower defense games.
In this exciting prequel, command your elven army and defend mystical lands from sea serpents, evil sorcerers, and wave after wave of gnoll tribesman, all with the help of brand-spankin’ new towers, heroes, and spells to fend off every last baddie.
Kingdom Rush Origins packs in a treasure trove of new content and features while keeping the signature look that millions have come to love.
Re-enter in the world of Kingdom Rush: visit mysterious elven forests, magical faery realms and even floating ruins of an ancient metropolis in this amazing tower defense game!
Build awesome powerful towers
- Unleash the power of the elves with brand new towers and troops! Elf Archers, Mystic Mages, Stone Druids and the Elven Infantry make up the backbone of your army.
- Discover 8 new specialized tower upgrades with over 18 abilities! Vanquish your enemies with elven marksmen, runed bears, magic-wielding wizards, and even giant animated trees. Execute your strategy with the unique abilities and special power of every tower!
Train audacious and legendary heroes!
- Master and upgrade 16 legendary heroes and their awesome powers and spells!
- Rain lightning, summon reinforcements, and use each hero’s unique power to obliterate scores of enemies!
Fight hordes of enemies in epic battles!
- Take up arms against 30 new enemy types and engage in epic boss battles! Face hordes of Gnolls, giant spiders, and the terrible Twilight army. Set up your strategy and go get them!
- Plan your strategy to deal with intense boss fights
More fantastic content!
- Immerse yourself in hours of gameplay with over 70 achievements, with three difficulty modes for the newbs and veterans alike. Explore the realm and get them all!
- Play different game modes - Classic, Iron, and Heroic - and prove your mettle as a master tactician.
- Get new-and-improved equipment using your hard earned gems in a revamped Gnome shop.
- Study your enemies and your towers with an in-game encyclopedia.
- No internet? No problem! Play it offline. Play the most addicting tower defense game even offline!
-----------------------------------------------------
Praise for the Kingdom Rush series: Google’s Editor’s Choice Award, IGN Editor's Choice, Slide To Play Must Have, GameInformer Gold Award, 148 Apps Editor's Choice, Jay is Games Game of the Year, Pocket Gamer Gold Award, CNET Editor’s Choice Award, Gamezebo 4.5/5, Touch Arcade 4.5/5, Venturebeat 94/100.

bluejetty:00136707:ios.description:
TalkTT is an app which lets you buy phone numbers from 80+ countries to make/receive calls or send/receive sms, or buy phone plans from 30+ countries, or buy eSIMs from 150+ countries to go Internet with local network without roaming fee.
FEATURES
- Make phone calls or send text messages on your iPhone/iPad to any international destination
- Buy DID phone numbers from 80+ countries or regions to make/receive calls or send.receive text messages.
- Buy phone plans from 30+ countries or regions to make/receive calls or send/receive text messages.
- Buy Special Offer phone numbers from popular countries like USA/Canada/UK/Belgium/Australia/Brazil etc.
- Buy eSIMs from 150+ countries or regions to go Internet with local network to avoid roaming cost. 
- Voice Mail will be provided automatically once you have DID phone numbers with us.
- Support many advanced features like Caller ID/Call Forward/Call Block/SMS Delivery Status/Phone Number Lookup/Phone Number Recover etc.
- Select regular contacts from the contact list to make a call or send SMS.
- Check history call records from Recent Calls.
- Choose your favorite voice prompt language from Settings.
- Choose your favorite rate plan from Standard/Premium/Gold/Direct plans.
- Choose auto prefix to format your local calls automatically.
Auto Detection for calling number:
Before each call has been sent out, our system will check the number you dial and give you alert if we find the number doesn't seem to be a valid number according to your auto prefix setting and give you options to continue calling or cancel it to change.
If you have any questions about using our app, you can open our app, then go to "Settings"->"Contact Us" to send one message to us. Our support will help you in the first place. Thanks.

Each day you’re presented with a new country or territory shape and have to guess its name in 6 tries. With each guess, you will receive a hint - the direction (North, East, South, or West), the distance, and the proximity from your guess to the target location.

bluejetty:00135650:ios.description:
Ever wanted to recreate curry house style meals in your own kitchen? Or want to learn how to cook popular Chinese, Thai, Mexican dishes and more? Look no further!
The Curry Guy app features over 300 recipes (over 25 of which are free of charge). Each of these recipes includes illustrated step-by-step instructions, designed to keep things simple in the kitchen.
The Indian restaurant style recipes are the result of years of travelling up and down the UK, visiting countless restaurants and learning the tricks of the trade from some of the best chefs in the industry. From chicken tikka masala to lamb vindaloo, onion bhajis to tandoori chicken, you are certain to find the curry house style recipes you love.
In addition, the app features other popular curried or spiced dishes from around the world.
I hope you enjoy using the app. I am always available to answer any questions on Twitter (@TheCurryGuy) or Facebook (/TheCurryGuy)
Happy cooking!
Dan (The Curry Guy)

• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00089042:ios.description:

Whodunit?™ is a collection of short, story-driven mysteries you can solve in minutes.

* Each case is designed to be solved in 5 to 10 minutes
* New cases are being added constantly

BUILT FOR THINKERS
There are no timers, no lives, and no forced mechanics. 
Every case can be solved using the information provided. The only question is whether you can piece it together.
Can you solve the case, or will the killer walk free?

bluejetty:00119206:ios.description:
Millions of professionals trust HiHello to create, share, scan, and manage business cards and contacts — all in one place. Whether you're at a conference, closing a deal, or building your network, HiHello is the digital business card app built to replace paper cards for good.
AI BUSINESS CARD SCANNER
Transform paper business cards into contacts instantly with HiHello's AI-powered business card scanner.
• Scan single cards or entire stacks in bulk.
• Edge detection and auto-capture provide maximum speed and accuracy.
DIGITAL BUSINESS CARD MAKER
Create multiple free digital business cards — one for work, one for personal, one for every side of your life.
• Design stunning virtual business cards with customizable designs, colors, fonts, branding, and layouts.
• Add unlimited content, including video, links, social media, payment apps, PDFs, and more.
EFFORTLESS SHARING
Share your card with anyone, anywhere — no app required on their end.
• Share via QR code, link, email, SMS, NFC, Apple Wallet, Apple Watch, Siri, lock screen widget, social media, AirDrop, and more.
• Track views, saves, and contacts with built-in analytics.
SMART CONTACT MANAGER & ADDRESS BOOK
Enrich contacts with professional information so every connection is more complete from day one.
• Organize everyone you meet with notes, tags, and automated sorting — your contacts, your virtual Rolodex.
• Manage your full contact list in one smart address book, then export contacts to your phone, CRM, or favorite contact manager.
EMAIL SIGNATURES
Create a professional email signature linked to your digital business card in seconds.
• Compatible with Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and more.
EMAIL SIGNATURE MANAGEMENT FOR TEAMS
Take control of every employee email signature from one centralized platform — no chasing down employees or manual updates.
• Deploy and update customizable signatures, marketing banners, and legal disclaimers across your entire organization in minutes.
• Compatible with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
LEAD CAPTURE FOR EVENTS & CONFERENCES
Share your card instantly — even offline, no Wi-Fi required.
• Scan business cards and badges to capture leads on the spot with HiHello's AI-powered business card scanner.
• Auto-tag contacts by event so every lead is organized from the moment you scan.
VIRTUAL BACKGROUNDS
Stay on brand in every meeting with custom virtual backgrounds linked to your digital business card.
• Upload your own or choose from our library of professional backgrounds.
TEAMS & ENTERPRISE
Manage employee digital business cards, email signatures, virtual backgrounds, and team branding from a single platform.
• Integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, Zapier, webhooks, SSO, Active Directory, and more.
• SOC 2 Type 2 certified and compliant with EU GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA, and Australian Privacy Act requirements.
ABOUT HIHELLO
HiHello is changing how everyone — from individual professionals to enterprise companies — manages their business cards, contacts, and professional relationships.
It starts with a digital business card built to be customizable, easy to share, and secure. Cut the cost of paper cards, reduce waste, and unlock your network. Millions of professionals worldwide trust HiHello — and we're just getting started.

bluejetty:00165913:ios.description:
Introducing HealthTrack: Your Ultimate Wellness Companion
Take control of your health and well-being with HealthTrack, the all-in-one iOS app designed to help you monitor and optimize your daily wellness routine. Whether you're looking to track your body temperature, monitor your heart rate, or stay informed about how weather affects your well-being, HealthTrack has got you covered.
Key Features:
1. Body Temperature Tracking: Keep a close eye on your body temperature with HealthTrack's easy-to-use temperature tracking feature. Simply input your temperature readings, and HealthTrack will create a comprehensive record to help you monitor any changes over time.
2. Apple Health Integration: Seamlessly sync your temperature data with Apple Health, ensuring that all your health information is stored in one convenient location. This integration allows you to view your temperature trends alongside other health metrics, providing a holistic view of your well-being.
3. Heart Rate Monitoring: Utilize the power of your iPhone's camera to measure your heart rate accurately. HealthTrack uses advanced technology to analyze subtle changes in your fingertip's color to estimate your heart rate, providing you with real-time insights into your cardiovascular health.
4. Weather and Well-being: Wondering how the weather will impact your well-being today? HealthTrack's weather integration feature provides personalized advice based on your health data and local weather conditions. Stay ahead of potential triggers like migraines or allergies and make informed decisions to optimize your day.
5. Valuable Health Articles: Stay informed and educated on various health topics with HealthTrack's curated collection of valuable articles. From nutrition tips to exercise routines, our experts provide you with the latest insights and advice to help you lead a healthier lifestyle.
6. Guided Meditations: Take a moment to unwind and relax with HealthTrack's guided meditation sessions. Choose from a variety of mindfulness exercises tailored to your preferences and needs, helping you reduce stress, improve focus, and promote overall well-being.
7. Customizable Widgets: Keep important health information at your fingertips with HealthTrack's customizable widgets. Add widgets to your iPhone's main screen, displaying vital metrics like heart rate, temperature, and personalized wellness advice, ensuring you never miss a beat when it comes to your health.
Premium subscription starts at USD 3.99 per week. Check the app for exact pricing in your region. The subscription allows users to add unlimited readings, check heart rate, set widgets, sync data with Apple Health, access care wellness content.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation and will automatically renew at the selected duration/price, unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours before the current period ends.
Renewal charges occur within 24 hours prior to the current period's end, specifying the cost.
Unused free trial periods, if offered, are forfeited upon subscription purchase.
Manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your iTunes Account Settings. Refunds won't be given for any unused term.
Please note that HealthTrack is not intended to replace professional medical advice. Always consult with a healthcare professional for personalized guidance and treatment.

bluejetty:00126443:ios.summary: RenoPlan helps anyone -- whether home contractors, interior designers, sales reps, architects, DIYers -- to quickly and accurately measure residential homes or office buildings to create floor plans and project estimates. The app can handl
bluejetty:00126443:ios.description:
RenoPlan helps anyone -- whether home contractors, interior designers, sales reps, architects, DIYers -- to quickly and accurately measure residential homes or office buildings to create floor plans and project estimates. The app can handle just about measuring jobs, like room drawings, doors, windows, kitchen countertops/cabinets, tubs, and showers.
RenoPlan makes it easy for your renovation, remodeling and restoration projects. As you create your plan, the app automatically calculates floor, wall areas and perimeters of room areas so as to estimate product usages. This can mean big savings for your projects.
It is handy to create estimates and invoices with attached floor plan diagrams and photos, so professionals like contractors can win a job and get client signatures on the spot. And when the job is done, send an invoice to the client to get paid faster. 
RenoPlan leverages your device's powerful AR (ARKit) and LiDAR capabilities to measure room in seconds, which will be very handy in the accuracy-insensitive scenarios.
For professional projects, RenoPlan is integrated with Leica Disto, Bosch, and DeWalt laser meters, capable of measuring room quickly and accurately. With the app, you can also markup and attach site measurements and photos, which can be included in a professional report.
Supported laser models:
- Leica Disto D1, D2, E7100i
- Bosch GLM 50C, 100C, 120C, 150C, 400C, 400CL
- DeWALT DW099S, DW0165S, DW0330S
- Moasure One (New)
