bluejetty:00096679:ios.name: Face Swap Video AI - Facely
bluejetty:00096679:ios.summary: Facely is a powerful video face swap app that uses advanced AI technology to let you switch faces in videos with stunning accuracy. Whether you want to replace your face with a celebrity, insert your friend into a movie scene, or create fun
bluejetty:00096679:ios.description:
Facely is a powerful video face swap app that uses advanced AI technology to let you switch faces in videos with stunning accuracy. Whether you want to replace your face with a celebrity, insert your friend into a movie scene, or create funny social media content, Facely makes the process quick, easy, and incredibly realistic.
Upload your own video or record one directly in the app. Choose a face from your gallery or take a new photo. Facely does the rest, analyzing facial features, expressions, and movements to create a natural-looking swap that blends seamlessly into the original footage.
With precise facial tracking and smart blending technology, Facely brings your ideas to life in just a few taps. It’s the perfect tool for content creators, meme enthusiasts, and anyone looking to add a creative twist to their videos.
Key Features
AI Video Face Swap: Replace any face in a video with ultra-realistic results, using cutting-edge AI.
Upload or Record: Use existing videos or create new ones inside the app.
Celebrity Face Swaps: Try swapping faces with actors, athletes, musicians, and other public figures.
Multi-Face Support: Swap more than one face in a single video, ideal for group scenes.
Smart Facial Mapping: Our algorithm detects angles, lighting, and expressions for smooth, natural swaps.
Face History and Gallery: Save and manage faces you’ve used before for quick access.
Easy Sharing: Export your videos and share them instantly on social platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.
HD Export (with subscription): Download high-quality videos without watermarks.
Creative Uses
Insert yourself into famous movie clips
Create parody videos or memes
Swap faces with friends in party videos
Produce content for short-form platforms
Roleplay different characters
Surprise followers with fun transformations
Facely is designed to be intuitive and powerful, making complex AI video editing accessible to everyone. No editing experience required — just choose your video and face, and the app takes care of the rest.
Privacy
We are committed to user privacy. Facial data is processed securely and never stored or shared with third parties. All face swaps are performed locally or securely in the cloud with your consent.
Subscription & Access
Some features of the app require a paid subscription. These include HD video exports, removal of watermarks, unlimited face swaps

bluejetty:00098607:ios.summary: Step into the thrilling world of The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box, an immersive 3D safe-breaker puzzle game! Your goal is to prove yourself as a great puzzle solver and unlock safes to reveal the hidden secrets of Mars! In The Vault: Logic Puzzl
bluejetty:00098607:ios.description:
Step into the thrilling world of The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box, an immersive 3D safe-breaker puzzle game! Your goal is to prove yourself as a great puzzle solver and unlock safes to reveal the hidden secrets of Mars! In The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box, you will embark on a mystery puzzle box journey that will challenge your brain like never before! Solve unique 3D puzzles to unlock each safe and get incredible artifacts in this The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box game. 
FEATURES OF THE VAULT: LOGIC PUZZLE BOX GAME:
- Immersive 3D safe puzzle gameplay
- Intricate mystery 3D safes with a variety of logic puzzles and challenges
- Progressively challenging safe breaker levels
- Difficult puzzle box safes and cool mechanics
- Collect valuable items
UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES OF MARS
In The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box game, two fearless researchers, Mister Nathan Reed and Miss Zoe Vega, team up to go to Mars! Their task is to discover the secrets of this red planet and you need to help them! Each unlocked safe brings you closer to the truth in this 3D puzzle box game. Using your knowledge and courage, solve all 3D logic puzzles and uncover the mysteries of Mars and its civilization!
The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box is more than just a mystery puzzle box game. Each safe you crack open reveals a part of Mars’ mysterious history. 
TACKLE MIND-BENDING PUZZLES
Every locked box in The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box offers a unique 3D puzzle that tests your logic and reasoning. Unlock safes, and reveal the treasures this mystery puzzle box game hides. Each locked 3D safe is challenging yet captivating. Whenever you crack open one of them you triumph as a master puzzle solver.
COLLECT VALUABLE ARTIFACTS
Open the box in The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box to find incredible artifacts, each a piece of Mars’ grand civilization. It's not just about unlocking safes, but discovering the wisdom and power these items hold. 
The adventure through The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box game is filled with challenges. Stay sharp and determined on your path as a 3D mystery puzzle box expert. Each 3D puzzle you tackle tests your skills, as you strive to unlock the treasures that hold the unbelievable powers. Dive in, solve puzzles, and let the adventure begin!

bluejetty:00187310:ios.summary:
QuickPlan makes project planning easier than ever before. Project management with natural gestures on the Gantt chart, sync and share projects across multiple devices and teams, and support integration with Microsoft Project Plan.
## PRIVA
bluejetty:00187310:ios.description:
QuickPlan makes project planning easier than ever before. Project management with natural gestures on the Gantt chart, sync and share projects across multiple devices and teams, and support integration with Microsoft Project Plan.
## PRIVACY FOCUSED
User-created projects are stored on the user's device or in iCloud Drive.
## ACTIVE UPDATING
- Continually evolves based on best practices from experts and ideas from users.
- App-Liv.jp Top10 Project Management Apps of 2019 - 1st Place.
- BestApp Ever Awards 2014 "Best Business App" - 3rd place.
* QuickPlan is now available for macOS. *
Download the free 15-day trial from https://quickplan.app/trial.
With NATURAL GESTUREs on a clean and elegant interface, project management is more accessible, faster and more efficient than ever before. Visualize, manage and simplify projects flexibly and efficiently with Gantt charts, outline list and property editor, create tasks, organize your project calendar and resources, track status. It's easier than you think, with a minimum of effort and learning.
QuickPlan App supports exporting projects to image, Excel, PDF, Microsoft Project and WBS files. AND to import projects from Microsoft Project, WBS and Mind-map files. 
The app supports synchronization of project plans between the same user's macOS and iOS devices and supports team collaboration via iCloud Drive. And it supports syncing and sharing via OneDrive and Dropbox. QuickPlan also supports duplicating projects by members for better teamwork.
QuickPlan fine-tunes the best features of Microsoft Project Plan and re-purposes them to work for iPad - without the complexity - providing users of all experience levels with an INTUITIVE and discoverable project management experience.
## EFFICIENT MAINTENANCE
- Gestures for tasks: Create, remove, move, indent and outdent, change order.
- Gestures to zoom in and out, collapse and expand.
- Keyboard shortcuts.
- Batch input.
- The most fluid Gantt chart app on a clean interface.
## STRONG PLAN
- Multiple Projects.
- Supports duplication of the entire project and duplication by specific members. 
- Organize tasks into REAL task groups and sub-projects.
- Task color, icon, contact, and required task fields.
- Five levels of outline (plus sub-project, for a total of ten levels of outline).
- Gesture-based management of task links.
- Lock editing, row height.
- Integration with the iOS Files app.
- Manual and automatic project backup.
- Project currency, charge rate, project resources, calendar, task date policy.
## TREE and LIST
- Display as tree with support for displaying cirtical path.
- Display as list with support for sorting and filtering.
## UI CUSTOMISATION
- Customization of the task column title and visibility.
- Style of the task bar.
## REPORTING
- Export as image, PDF and Microsoft Excel (including three sheets).
- With options to customize the output.
## SYNC
- Sync projects between iOS and Mac devices via iCloud Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox.
## TEAM COLLABORATION
- Sync between team members via iCloud Drive.
## INTEGRATION
- Export and import Microsoft Project XML files.
- Import and export SwiftApp WBS files.
- Import from Microsoft Excel files.
- Import from iThought Map files.
## SHARE
- Supports Airdrop, OneDrive, Dropbox.
## TEAMWORK
- Create a new project by exporting tasks for the selected project members.
## NOTIFICATION
- Widget to track ongoing tasks.
- Today widget and local notification.
QuickPlan simplifies the complexity of project planning that puts ease as the ultimate goal in organizing your professional projects, plans, efforts, goals and life. The best project planning app for iPad.
- Initialize, discuss, present and share your plan.
- Export it to Microsoft Project Plan for further editing on PC.
- Strategic Planning.
- Import MS Project XML file and reports, tracking.
- Schedule actions in meetings, confirm.
- Track progress.
- Guide employees.

bluejetty:00131479:ios.name: Participant 3rd Party Zoom App
bluejetty:00131479:ios.summary:
Participant is an intentionally simple, video-focused 3rd-party Zoom client* designed for meeting participants. No sharing, polls, or host features. Participant may not be for you, and that's OK. Here's what it gives you:
• Get back in tha
bluejetty:00131479:ios.description:
Participant is an intentionally simple, video-focused 3rd-party Zoom client* designed for meeting participants. No sharing, polls, or host features. Participant may not be for you, and that's OK. Here's what it gives you:
• Get back in that meeting quickly – your recent meeting IDs and passcodes are stored and one tap away. No more searching for the link or trying to find the passcode in an email.
• Control of your mic, camera, and raised hand – always on-screen and easy to reach.
• Data Saver Mode – bad connection or on cellular? Use Data Saver to turn off your camera and stop streaming videos. This will reduce your data usage by approximately 60-95% depending on the number of participants.
• Live Activity – control your mic or raised hand from the Dynamic Island or Lock Screen.
• Watch app – control your meeting from across the room. Use the Apple Watch app to control the mic, camera, and raised hand in a meeting on iPhone or iPad.
• Automatic Raised Hand Detection – turn this on in Meeting Settings and we'll raise your Zoom hand when you raise your actual hand. Vision at work.
• Put videos in focus – configure columns, focus on active cameras only, or hold and drag to sort it just how you like it.
• Sane chat – Pro users can use threaded chat. No more accidentally responding to everyone when you meant to DM.
• Get on the big screen – share to your Apple TV and you have total control of what is shown on the external display.
• Zoom in/zoom out – simply tap a video to get a larger view. Tap again to close it.
• Control host requests – you control what happens if a host asks to unmute or start your camera: ask, always allow, or automatically allow if your hand is raised.
Thanks for giving Participant a try. Let us know what you think.
Please note that webinars are not currently supported.
* Participant uses the Zoom SDK but is not endorsed, certified, warrantied, or supported by Zoom Communications Inc. If Zoom changes their policies or capabilities of their SDK this app may lose access.
If you choose to purchase a Pro subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
Terms of use: https://thinktapwork.com/tos.html

bluejetty:00175833:ios.name: World Flags Trainer
bluejetty:00175833:ios.summary: Learning world flags becomes more reliable when targeted repetition is combined with active recall. This app is built around that approach and offers a structured learning system that goes far beyond simple quiz guessing. Using an adaptive
bluejetty:00175833:ios.description:
Learning world flags becomes more reliable when targeted repetition is combined with active recall. This app is built around that approach and offers a structured learning system that goes far beyond simple quiz guessing. Using an adaptive spaced-repetition method, it adjusts review intervals to your actual memory performance and supports steady, long-term progress without unnecessary frustration.
Two complementary learning modes allow different ways of practising. Multiple Choice enables a quick and accessible start, helping you build initial familiarity. Self-Assessment focuses on active recall, one of the most effective techniques for strengthening long-term retention. Both modes work closely with the adaptive algorithm, which schedules reviews precisely when they are most useful.
All flags are grouped into clear categories by continent, allowing you to focus on the regions you want to learn. Each item can be practised in two directions: Flag to Country and Country to Flag. This dual structure ensures a complete understanding instead of surface-level recognition.
During each learning session, questions are repeated until every item has been answered correctly at least once. Incorrect answers do not reset your progress. Instead, the system adjusts the interval realistically, keeping the learning flow consistent and motivating.
The app also includes structured knowledge tests with medals. Each category and question direction features its own test, providing an accurate picture of your current skill level. Depending on your results, you can earn silver or gold medals, and tests can be repeated at any time.
Categories and question types can be adjusted freely without losing progress. All flashcards can be browsed and searched for quick reference. This creates an efficient and sustainable learning path for anyone who aims to truly master world flags.

bluejetty:00200193:ios.name: Roomy for Duo: Full Width
bluejetty:00200193:ios.summary:
Give websites room on the iPhone Duo front screen.
On the iPhone Duo front screen, Safari 27.1 shows its controls in a sidebar — and most websites leave the space beside it empty. Roomy is a Safari extension that lets you change that, one
bluejetty:00200193:ios.description:
Give websites room on the iPhone Duo front screen.
On the iPhone Duo front screen, Safari 27.1 shows its controls in a sidebar — and most websites leave the space beside it empty. Roomy is a Safari extension that lets you change that, one website at a time.
THREE OPTIONS, CHOSEN PER WEBSITE
Open the extensions menu in Safari, tap Roomy and switch on what the current site needs:
• Use full width — the page extends into the space beside Safari's controls instead of leaving it blank.
• Hide bars while reading — fixed headers and footers slide away as you scroll down and return as soon as you scroll up.
• Stretch narrow columns — lifts narrow width limits so articles use the whole width of the screen.
Roomy remembers your choice for each website, so it looks the way you like it the next time you visit. A website that should stay untouched? Switch Roomy off for it with one tap. And when you like a combination, make it the default for all websites right from Safari.
MADE FOR THE IPHONE DUO
• Folded: Roomy works on the front screen, where Safari's sidebar takes room away from websites.
• Unfolded: on the large inner screen, websites already have plenty of space — Roomy steps aside automatically, so scrolling stays smooth. If you like, bars can keep hiding while you read there.
• Fold your iPhone Duo again and Roomy is right back, no reload needed.
YOUR WEBSITES, IN ONE PLACE
The Roomy app is where you keep track of everything:
• See every website you've adjusted, with its saved options
• Edit a site's options or reset it with a tap
• Choose default options for websites you haven't configured yet
• A short setup guide shows how to turn on the extension, and the app tells you whether it has been active
• Language (Auto, English, Deutsch) and appearance (Auto, Light, Dark) settings
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Roomy collects no data. No accounts, no analytics, no network requests. Your settings — just website names and the options you picked — stay on your iPhone. The extension needs Safari's website access permission only to change how pages are displayed; it does not store or send page content or your browsing history.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Designed for the iPhone Duo front screen. Roomy also works on any other iPhone; there, "Use full width" mainly makes a difference in landscape.
• Every website is built differently. Some have fixed elements or their own layout limits, so results vary from site to site.
One-time purchase. No subscription.
Install Roomy on your iPhone Duo, turn on the extension, and let your favorite websites use the whole front screen.

SIE Exam Prep 2026 is an application that has been carefully designed and developed by industry exam experts. With more than 1,600 high-quality questions and answer explanations, multiple exam modes and a scientific analysis system, it helps you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere, making it more likely that you will pass the SIE exam on your first try!
SIE Exam Prep 2026 now supports The Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam preparation. Our examiners will update and revise the content based on the latest exam syllabus provided by the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA).
SIE Exam Prep 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied previous exam content and the latest exam requirements, and have expertly categorized all subjects on the exam so you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 1,600 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the SIE exam can be difficult, but with the help of SIE Exam Prep 2026, if you are determined to pass the certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goals!
Don't feel confused or frustrated about preparing for the SIE exam, effective changes take time and effort, follow in the footsteps of SIE Exam Prep 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started right now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).

DISCLAIMER :

bluejetty:00121836:ios.description:
Join 1,000,000+ players worldwide for thrilling online gaming! Pixel Gun 3D is a fun first-person multiplayer shooter. Download the game and enjoy blocky graphics, competitive gameplay, and much more:
• 900+ weapons
• 40+ useful gadgets and tools
• 11 various game modes
• 12 exciting mini-games
• 100+ beautiful maps rotating during the year
• Zombie-survival campaign
* NEW IMPOSTER MODE * 
Trapped in the Spaceship with other players, you need to do some tasks to keep the ship working and return home. But there is an Imposter in the team who will always interfere with your plans.
* CLANS *
Unite with friends, get your clan to the top divisions and enjoy valuable prizes.
Update and customize your Fort to resist PvE Sieges and create a powerful tank to raid other Clans’ forts.
* JOIN CLAN WARS! *
Conquer territories, control the huge global map, collect valor points, and gain income from your lands to win the war.
* HUNDREDS OF WEAPONS *
There are more than 900 different weapons in Pixel Gun 3D, and you can use all of them. Wanna use a medieval sword and shield or, maybe, the Dark Matter Generator? Just do it! And don’t forget about grenades..
* PLENTY OF SKINS *
Would you like to be an Orc, a Skeleton, a mighty Hero or someone else? Use extra-detailed skins and outfits to show off. Or create your own in the Skin Editor.
* GAME MODES *
Battle Royale, Raids, Deathmatch, Duels… There are so many opportunities for you to challenge yourself. Not mentioning the brawls that rotate every week..
* MINI-GAMES *
Tired of being the best on a battlefield? It is time to participate in the competitions and show your skill to the best warriors worldwide. Sniper Tournament, Parkour Challenge, Glider Rush and other challenges await their hero!
---
This is not an official Mojang app. Pixel Gun 3D & Cubic Games are not associated or connected with Mojang AB. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang AB and it is not endorsed by or affiliated with the creator of this game or its licensers.

Subscription options

This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to Apple ID Account after confirmation of purchase or at the end of the trial period if it is offered.

When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be cancelled.

bluejetty:00070227:ios.description:
Step into the immersive universe of Coin Tales, a thrilling, interactive mobile game that brings the excitement of the world to your fingertips. Embark on an adventure that will see you build, raid, and trade your way to legendary status in a land of enchanting whimsy and endless fun.
EXPLORE A VAST WORLD: Traverse through magical realms and diverse landscapes in your quest to become the supreme Coin Tales champion. Each location you conquer is filled with unique coins, treasures, and characters waiting to be discovered.
BUILD YOUR DREAM KINGDOM: Use your hard-earned loot to construct your empire. From simple cottages to imposing castles, the power is yours to create. Fortify your kingdom's defenses to ward off attacks from both friends and rivals.
RAID OTHER KINGDOMS: Connect with players from around the globe! Spin the wheel to snatch their coins or pillage their treasure. But stay alert – they can seek revenge! Launch daring raids to amass your fortune.
TRADE TO THRIVE: Need to complete your card collection? Our trading feature allows you to swap cards with friends. The more collections you complete, the greater the rewards!
DAILY REWARDS & BONUSES: Sign in every day for enticing bonuses and spin the wheel for a chance to claim fantastic prizes. Participate in our weekly events for an added layer of thrill.
PET COMPANIONS: You’re never alone on this journey. Unlock adorable pet companions that enhance your earnings and safeguard your kingdom. Level them up and watch your wealth multiply!
LEADERBOARDS & COMPETITIONS: Compete with players from around the world and ascend the global leaderboard. The more you play, the more opportunities you have to claim victory!
Join millions of players worldwide as you spin, build, and battle your way to the top. Can you become the wealthiest and most revered in Coin Tales? There's only one way to find out...
Download Coin Tales today and commence your epic adventure! 
Follow Coin Tales on Facebook for daily free offers and bonuses!

bluejetty:00129083:ios.description:
Kur'ân-ı Kerîm'in Türkçe mealini sesli olarak dinleyebileceğiniz, Arapça aslından okuyabileceğiniz sade ve modern bir uygulama.
114 sûrenin tamamını Türkçe seslendirmeli olarak tek tek veya toplu olarak indirip çevrimdışı dinleyebilirsiniz. Arka plan oynatma özelliği sayesinde uygulama kapalıyken bile sûreler arasında kolayca geçiş yapabilir, kilit ekranından oynatmayı kontrol edebilirsiniz.
YENİ: OKU
• Arapça metin, Latin okunuş ve meal bir arada
• 70'ten fazla meal arasından dilediğinizi seçme
• Tefsir ile ayetlerin açıklaması
• Kelime analizi ile kelime kelime anlam
• Farklı kârilerden ayet ayet sesli okuma
• Ezber modu: ayet tekrarı, ayetler arası bekleme ve okuma hızı
• Ayetleri hikâye, gönderi veya yazı olarak paylaşma
• Arapça ve meal yazı boyutunu ayarlama
Dinleme özellikleri:
• 114 sûrenin tamamı Türkçe meal ile
• Tek tek veya toplu indirme (varsayılan olarak yalnızca Wi-Fi)
• Arka plan oynatma ve kilit ekranı kontrolleri
• Kaldığınız yerden devam etme
• Günlük dinleme hedefi ve seri takibi
• Hatırlatma bildirimleri (saatini siz seçin)
• Hassas zaman çubuğu ile saniye saniye geri sarma
• 0.75× – 2× arası oynatma hızı
• ±10 saniye geri/ileri atlama
• Tekrar modları (mevcut sureyi tekrar / tümünü tekrar)
• Uyku zamanlayıcısı (5–60 dakika veya sure sonu)
• Yer imleri ile favori konumlarınızı işaretleme
• Sıradaki sureleri görüntüleme
• AirPlay ile hoparlör ve cihaz desteği
• Açık/Koyu tema seçimi
KUR'AN-I KERİM PRO
Pro ile tüm reklamlar kalkar; okuma ve dinleme kesintisiz olur. Aylık ve yıllık abonelik seçenekleri mevcuttur. Reklamları daha önce tek seferlik satın alma ile kaldırdıysanız hakkınız aynen devam eder.
Kur'ân-ı Kerîm'in anlamını keşfetmek, her an huzurla okuyup dinlemek için hemen indirin.
Gizlilik Politikası: https://codeida.com/privacy/kurandinle.html

bluejetty:00128039:ios.name: Train Maker
bluejetty:00128039:ios.summary:
Create your own trains by freely uniting the carriages of bullet trains and regular trains in any way you want!
The trains you create will travel through tunnels and railway crossings.
You can experience the bumpy experience with the vibrat
bluejetty:00128039:ios.description:
Create your own trains by freely uniting the carriages of bullet trains and regular trains in any way you want!
The trains you create will travel through tunnels and railway crossings.
You can experience the bumpy experience with the vibration feature once your train gets going.
This is the perfect game app for anyone who loves trains.
User feedback
"It's really cool that so many trains are united with the rail yard!"
"It's so fun to unite the white bullet train with the yellow bullet train!"
"It's exciting to see the carriages of the united bullet trains moving up slopes!"
Features of this app
*You are free to unite your own choice of "leading carriages," "middle carriages," and "tail carriages" of bullet trains and trains.
*You can choose from eight different stages that your train will travel through: "a mountain and a tunnel", "lots of railway crossings", "a big river and a railway bridge", "highway route","Japanese scenery","Jet coaster","Inbound and outbound" and "Pass through many".
*You can switch between camera views and watch your running train from your favorite angle.
*You can use the "UP" and "DOWN" buttons to change the speed of your train or stop it.
*You can get new trains by accumulating "track miles," which you earn according to the distance you have traveled, and by turning the train roulette.
How to play
1. The game begins at the rail yard. First, tap the "Create" button to create your train.
2. After selecting your first train, tap the "+" button to select the next train.
3. You can tap the "-" button to remove carriages.
4. When you are done, tap the "Finish" button in the top right corner to return to the rail yard. The train you have created will be shown at the top.
5. Tap the "GO" button on the right and select your preferred stage in the stage selection screen.
6. On the play screen, you can adjust the speed of your train using the bottom left button, change the camera distance with the bottom right button, focus the camera on your choice of carriage using the top right button, and freely adjust the camera position by dragging the area outside of the train. Give it a go and find the coolest angle!
7. You can tap and hold to stop the camera. It is also exciting to wait for a passing train to come back.
8.Tap the arrow button on the upper left to return to the railroad yard from the play screen. You can then check how many "Track miles" you've earned for the distance you've traveled. 
9.100 Track Miles lets you play Train Roulette one time. You can link up the trains you win in Train Roulette to have more fun. 
10.Check your Train Collection to see the trains you've collected so far. (You can check your Train Collection from the rail yard screen.) 
11. You can tap the "Organizing" button at the rail yard to change the order of trains or delete trains that you do not want.
12. From the Settings button on the title screen, you can also toggle settings such as music, sound effects, image quality, vocal effects, and vibration mode.

ACCESS

bluejetty:00065858:ios.description:
Cargo Delivery Company Truck simulator is an amazing and realistic mountain truck game that would give you driving experience in megacities and hilly areas. Mega truck driving on the city highway and on impossible tracks would give you thrilling and adventurous driving experience that will engage you for hours.
Get yourself ready for 8x8 wheels truck driving on asphalt highway fully packed cars, trucks, trailers and other traffic vehicles. You have to get your way from other traffic vehicles for delivering the cargo on time. Being a cargo transporter truck driver, time and safety must be your first priority. You have to drive fast by following the shortest route in order to deliver the goods on time loaded in your offroad cargo truck. Meanwhile, you have to be very careful about the safety of the truck when you are driving furiously for overtaking the other traffic vehicles in order to reach on time.
Cargo Delivery Company Truck contains the variety of trucks that are fully loaded with latest auto technologies, unlike other euro truck driver games. All euro trucks are fully equipped hydraulic brakes, powered windows, doors etc. you would find it definitely better from other new truck games 2018. These technology features will help to improve your driving experience, hydraulic brakes would help you to avoid crashes by reducing the speed in minimum time. Power doors will let you to sit on driving seat very comfortably for enjoying the Cargo Delivery Company Truck.
Discover beautiful natural sceneries of hilly areas while traveling on offroad tracks, green hills, natural waterfalls would make your driving experience amazing and soothing. And you will like to drive for hours for enjoying the attractive sceneries. So this tuck legend game is one of the best truck parking game among all truck simulation games 2018 due to its unique features and gameplay. Suspension shocks, hydraulic brakes, comfortable inner environment, loud truck horn, and smooth controls will make this euro truck simulator game more interesting and challenge for driving on the deadly offroad tracks.
By playing big truck simulation game you will enjoy adventurous racing of mega trucks against heavy traffic vehicles on American roads. Smooth and real physics-based controls will make your offroad truck driving more realistic and smooth. Power steering will help you to take sharp turns easily and smoothly on the offroad edges. So fasten your seatbelt and get into your best truck 2018 and become best euro truck driver of all truck simulation games 2018.
You have to discover maximum locations and beautiful routes from making your journey more memorable and exciting. The more you drive your offroad truck the more beautiful destinations you would discover for improving your driving experience by driving on versatile tracks.
There are a variety of trucks available on the store. You have to play more and more to earn maximum in-game cash currency for buying the different luxurious trucks with different specifications. The more expensive truck, the more power it would have for driving on the variety of tracks of offroad and different highways. You can drive the offroad truck with steering and with tilt controls as well. Press acceleration button for boosting up your speed. Brake button is given for applying brakes in the emergency situation to avoid any accident unlike other truck driving games 2018.
Features of Cargo Delivery Company Truck
- variety of challenging missions
- multiple luxurious and latest trucks
- realistic 3d environment along hd graphics
- multiple camera angles
- best time killing game

bluejetty:00026999:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00026999:ios.description:
Fall asleep in the mountains. Wake up at home.
Find your flow by the sea. Without leaving your desk.
Portal brings the magic of the natural world into our everyday lives - from cloud forests in Costa Rica to volcanic vistas in Iceland. With immersive Spatial Audio, cinematic motion visuals and smart lighting, it's designed to make nature feel present - transforming your space into somewhere calmer, more peaceful and inspired.
Decades of research have shown how deeply connected we are to nature: it can improve our focus and spark creativity, ease anxiety and help us sleep better.
Portal helps reconnect us.
Whether you’re chasing flow, unwinding after a long day, drifting off to sleep, or looking for a moment to breathe, Portal immerses you in some of the most beautiful and peaceful places on Earth.
Already loved by over a million people worldwide - and recognised by Apple as an Editor’s Pick and Mac App of the Year finalist - Portal is helping people turn distraction into focus, stress into calm and restless nights into peaceful ones.
REAL STORIES FROM THE PORTAL COMMUNITY
FOCUS
The tech professional who found focus almost impossible amid the noise, stress and distraction around him.
“Portal provides me with something I haven’t had in years: mental clarity and peace. It’s an instant ‘on switch’ for being able to focus and do deep work.”
RELAXATION
A woman undergoing treatment for stage III breast cancer.
“Portal literally lowers my heart rate and lets me escape while I’m receiving chemotherapy. Thank you for bringing nature’s calm back into my world during a time I can’t go outside.”
SLEEP
A mother living in a war zone, using Portal to help her children fall asleep while the sound of bombing can be heard in the distance.
“Thank you for bringing peace to the chaos of our world.”
ADHD
A university student struggling with their ADHD.
“I achieved a First Class this year of which I am very proud and forever grateful for the help Portal has given me. It’s better than any medication, therapy or treatment for my ADHD brain!”
OTHER POPULAR USES
Creativity, mindfulness, meditation, stress and anxiety relief, PTSD, tinnitus, insomnia, SAD management and childbirth.
KEY FEATURES
- 100+ portals to beautiful and peaceful corners of our planet, including Costa Rica, Iceland, St Lucia, Scotland, England and Slovenia
- Circadian Flow: brings the rhythm of the world outside indoors, from sunrise to sunset
- Immersive, true-to-life Spatial Audio recordings
- Stunning retina-quality ultra high definition motion visuals
- Philips Hue, HomeKit and Nanoleaf smart lighting integration
- Webby Award-winning design
- Virtual sunrise wake-up alarm
- Sleep timer
- Pomodoro timer
- Meditation and breathing exercises
- Mix Portal audio with music, podcasts, audiobooks and guided meditations
- Offline use
- Siri Shortcuts
- Family Sharing
- Privacy conscious: no third-party tracking, targeted ads or collection of personal data
MEMBERSHIP OPTIONS
Portal Open Access: free access to 3 portals, refreshed monthly.
Portal Premium: unlimited access to our growing Library. Available as a Monthly, Annual or Lifetime purchase. Premium includes access to Mac, iPhone, iPad and Vision Pro apps.
Try Premium free for 7 days: no upfront payment details, no auto-subscribe and no need to cancel. After your trial, continue with Open Access or become a Premium Member.
OTHER NOTES
Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled in your App Store account at least 24 hours before your Membership ends.
Dynamic (head-tracked) Spatial Audio requires compatible headphones that support head-tracking (AirPods (3rd Gen & up), AirPods Pro, AirPods Max, Beats Fit Pro).
OUR MISSION
We’re a small indie team based in the UK, on a mission to bring nature’s magic back into our daily lives.
Every detail of Portal is crafted with care, inspired by science, technology and the natural world.
Terms of Use: portal.app/terms
Privacy Policy: portal.app/privacy

bluejetty:00132250:ios.name: Peridot
bluejetty:00132250:ios.summary: Peridot fulfills your fantasy of bonding with a magical, brag-worthy creature that can fly through the air, always wants to be by your side, and might have a secret love for turkey sandwiches. With the power of AR, this pet simulation game
bluejetty:00132250:ios.description:
Peridot fulfills your fantasy of bonding with a magical, brag-worthy creature that can fly through the air, always wants to be by your side, and might have a secret love for turkey sandwiches. With the power of AR, this pet simulation game places whimsical beings known as Peridots (“Dots“ for short) in the real world with you. And with Peridot, playing with friends is better, simple as that. Meet up with your besties IRL to Hatch new Dots that will inherit the Traits of their parents, then snap a pic and share it with your friends!
_______________
ADOPT your very own Peridot, creatures that feel and look totally real. Each Dot has unique DNA which makes them a truly special companion made just for you.
NURTURE your creatures and help them live their best lives. Play fetch, teach them how to shake their butt, give them belly rubs, and dress them up in hats, mustaches, bowties, and more!
EXPLORE the world, get outside, and see the world in a new way through your Dot’s eyes. Your Dot is curious about the environment and might uncover hidden items depending on where you adventure with them. When your Dot is looking particularly adorable, snap photos and videos to share with your friends on social.
COLLABORATE with your friends and other players to breed your Dots together and Hatch entirely new Dots that are genetically unique. Discover together what’s possible and encounter endless possibilities of Peridot Archetypes that resemble some of your favorite animals, including cheetahs, unicorns, peacocks, and more. You can even combine and pass down these rare Traits to the future generations of Dots.
EXPAND your beloved family of Dots by unlocking badass Peridot Archetypes and Traits as you climb the ranks within the Peridot Keeper Society.
EXPERIENCE a rich narrative as you learn about the mysterious ancient past of these creatures and work to preserve the species for future generations.
Join this heartwarming journey today and rediscover just how beautiful the world around you truly is. 
_______________
With the player’s permission, Adventure Sync uses the Health app to enable the player to earn walking distance when the app is closed.

• Peridot is optimized for high-end smartphones, tablets are not supported. Device compatibility is not guaranteed and may be changed at any time. Supported device information can be found at: https://

Dino Academy is an educational game for preschool kids and toddlers. This colorful world of Dinos has fun toddler games for 2-5 year olds to help them visualize and understand different shapes and colors. These learning games for toddlers are perfect for 2-5 year olds!
In Dino Academy, kids can learn shape sorting, color sorting, learn how to color, and a lot more! These games for toddlers will help them in developing color recognition skills and shape identification skills.
Your little one can play a range of learning games with Dinos. 2-5 year olds kids and toddlers can learn to identify, trace and differentiate between shapes and colors.
Features of Dino Academy Games are: 
- A range of interactive learning games
- Play with Dinos
- Colorful themes
- Learn how to color and draw
- Easy shapes and coloring games
- Play sorting and matching games
These fun learning games for toddlers include:
1) Tracing Games: Your child can learn about the different types of shapes such as squares, circles, ovals, etc, and improve their hand strength by tracing them.
2) Shape Sorting: With the help of fish, cookies, and various other objects, kids can learn to differentiate between shapes and learn sorting. Shape sorting will enhance your child’s cognitive skills.
3) Tangram Learning Games: Match the right shapes to build cars, trucks, busses, and a lot more! We promise to build your child’s spatial ability.
4) Funny Faces: Learn about expressions and shapes in this fun game and let your child have a fun-filled learning experience with colorful shapes and characters.

bluejetty:00062869:ios.name: Writing Therapy
bluejetty:00062869:ios.summary:
Writing Therapy is a unique app for spelling practice for adults with brain injury or stroke as well as ESL speakers or children learning to spell. 
** Try it for FREE in Language Therapy Lite or purchase at a discount in the Language Ther
bluejetty:00062869:ios.description:
Writing Therapy is a unique app for spelling practice for adults with brain injury or stroke as well as ESL speakers or children learning to spell. 
** Try it for FREE in Language Therapy Lite or purchase at a discount in the Language Therapy 4-in-1 app! ** 
With 4 modes and 3 levels of difficulty in each, users have access to 12 different exercises to practice writing over 500 words + unlimited custom words! 
* Fill-in-the-Blank 
* Copy 
* Spell What You See 
* Spell What You Hear 
Unlike other learn-to-spell apps, Writing Therapy allows users to select and rearrange letter tiles until they are satisfied, choosing when to submit an answer, rather than letters only fitting into the correct spot. Writing Therapy also has a built-in cueing hierarchy to give "hints" on each level, making the exercise one step easier to allow success on each trial. A virtual set of letter tiles makes therapy go faster with more repetitions in less time. 
You can add your own words and pictures to create completely customized spelling lists! Learn to spell names, places, or words related to each user's needs. 
This app features clear photographs, iconic graphics, and a clear male voice in 5 languages. Users will benefit from the trial-and-error format and self-selected cues for learning these common words with graduated activities that will grow with them as they develop or improve. 
Settings allow limiting the length of the words, selecting capital or lowercase letters, designating which of 12 categories are presented, and choosing how letters are selected. For users with difficulty dragging, an alternative tapping access method is available. Speech-Language Pathologists, family members, and teachers can recommend the appropriate modes and levels for each user and receive e-mailed reports of results (ready for professional progress notes). 
Writing Therapy is another powerful app in Tactus Therapy Solutions' professionally-designed Language Therapy suite of speech-language therapy apps. It is the perfect companion to Comprehension Therapy, Naming Therapy, and Reading Therapy. 
Our customers love this app! Read what they have to say: 
"I really like that this app can be used by both children and adults. I love the great real-life photographs used instead of cartoon pictures or line drawings. The functional, categorized vocabulary you use in your apps is appreciated!! I especially like the feature allowing older students/clients the opportunity to analyze their responses prior to submitted them. This app has great control over the length of the words selected, the voice quality is good, and clinicians will appreciate the data reporting! Great job!" 
"Great app, highly engaging! I used this app with two of my aphasia clients- one in her 30s and one in his 50s. Both found it engaging and wanted to continue to use the app throughout their session. I like the different levels of difficulty and the hints (which both of my clients appreciated as well). Great app!" 
"Beautifully done! A child or an adult can use this; the very nice part is that it isn't childish as many learn to spell apps are, which I absolutely love. My favorite part is the fact that words can actually be misspelled which allows the user to decide for themselves if it is correct or not BEFORE hitting the check button. So the target word is actually learned rather than just swiping letters until they all go into the correct slot. Love this app!"

bluejetty:00035729:ios.description:
Create Stunning AI Photos, Remove Objects and People & Reshape Your Body — All in One App
MagicEditor is your complete photo editing studio — powered by generative AI and smart retouching tools.
With just a few taps, you can:
• Generate AI portraits and AI-generated photos from your selfies
• Remove objects, people, or blemishes from any photo
• Reshape your body using a powerful and realistic body editor
• Fix blurry or low-quality shots with advanced photo enhancement
Whether you're creating a professional headshot, cleaning up a vacation picture, or retouching your style, MagicEditor gives you total creative control — effortlessly.
AI Portraits & Photos – Powered by Generative AI
Turn your regular selfies into AI-generated photos and stunning portraits with MagicEditor’s powerful AI image generator.
Using advanced generative AI and artificial intelligence models, you can transform your photo into a high-quality headshot, creative avatar, or artistic portrait — in seconds.
Whether you need a professional LinkedIn portrait, a fantasy-themed image, or just want to enhance your selfies with AI, MagicEditor makes it effortless.
Choose from dozens of portrait styles, including:
• Business / LinkedIn headshots
• Lifestyle & casual looks
• Travel & adventure scenes
• Fantasy, anime, or cinematic AI portraits
Our AI photo generator works instantly — just upload a selfie, pick a style, and let AI create your image. It’s more than just a filter — it’s intelligent AI-powered photo creation.
Remove Objects, People & Blemishes – Object Removal Made Easy
Clean up your photos in seconds with our smart object removal tools.
Easily remove objects from photos, erase people in the background, or fix messy elements ruining the perfect shot.
Use MagicEditor to:
• Remove people from photos or erase strangers from crowded scenes
• Remove unwanted objects from your picture with precision
• Perform fast blemish removal – pimples, scars, or skin imperfections
• Fix busy backgrounds by removing people, text, or distractions
Whether you want to remove a person from a photo, erase people from background, or simply tidy up a messy shot, MagicEditor’s removal tools do it cleanly and instantly — with no visible traces.
Body Shape Editor – Reshape Body Naturally
Look the way you want — no filters, just control. MagicEditor’s body editor lets you retouch your figure with natural-looking results.
• Use the body shape editor to slim, stretch, or reshape
• Smooth your waist, tone arms or legs, and adjust posture
• Enhance proportions while keeping a realistic look
Smart Retouch
One-tap retouching to improve lighting, smooth skin, and enhance facial features — no manual editing required.
Crop and Resize
Easily crop and adjust your photo to fit any format, platform, or aspect ratio.
MagicEditor is perfect for content creators, professionals, and anyone who wants clean, powerful, and professionally edited photos — without needing editing skills. Just tap, and it’s done.
Whether you’re editing for confidence or creativity, this is your all-in-one body editing app.

• Payment is charged upon purchase confirmation.
• Subscription renews automatically unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Renewal charges are made 24 hours before the period ends, with renewal cost displayed.
• Manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in Account Settings after purchase.
We respect your privacy and do not store personal data, image content, or editing requests. All processing is private and secure.

Terms of Use: https://humanapps.net/terms.html

bluejetty:00127893:ios.description:
The BAFTA-winning pre-school learning show Numberblocks brings you Numberblocks - Card Fun!
This app features four game modes and five packs of cards offering 60 levels of different gameplay that will help you help your child with their numeracy skills. It features Numberblocks 1 to 10.
As seen on Cbeebies.
● Snap - Find a snap when you see two cards with matching values, this could be Numberblock One and one Apple or numeral six and six Numberblobs.
● Match - Turn over the cards to find matching pairs of card value. The values could be anything from a mix of things to stamps.
● Add it up - A series of addition equations that feature different card packs and card values. You will be adding Numberblocks, Stamps, Things, Numberblobs and numerals.
● Take it away - A series of subtraction equations that feature different card packs and card values. You will be adding Numberblocks, Stamps, Things, Numberblobs and numerals.
When a level is completed a new one with increasing complexity will unlock. Also, your card packs will increase in size with larger values helping to offer a challenging experience that will help your child to progress with their number literacy.
This app does not contain any in-app purchases or involuntary adverts.

Bro
bluejetty:00188213:ios.description:
Libby connects you to your local library’s collection of ebooks, audiobooks, magazines, and more. With just your library card, you can instantly read or listen to books on your phone or tablet — for free, thanks to your public library!
Browse and borrow everything from timeless classics to the latest New York Times bestsellers, and enjoy your next great read anytime, anywhere.
What You Can Do with Libby
- Browse your library’s digital catalog of books
- Borrow and enjoy ebooks, audiobooks, and magazines
- Send ebooks to your Kindle (U.S. libraries only)
- Listen to audiobooks through Apple CarPlay
- Download titles for offline reading, or stream them to save space
- Use tags to create to-be--read lists or organize your favorite titles
- Keep your reading position with automatic syncing across all your devices
A Beautiful Reading Experience
Enjoy a seamless reading experience with Libby’s elegant, easy-to-use ebook reader:
- Adjust text size, background color, and book design to fit your preferences
- Zoom into magazines, comics, and graphic novels
- Define and search for words or phrases instantly
- Read and listen to interactive read-alongs with your kids
- Add bookmarks, notes, and highlights to personalize your reading
An Immersive Audiobook Player
Libby’s audiobook player makes listening effortless and enjoyable:
- Slow down or speed up playback (0.6x to 3.0x)
- Set a sleep timer for nighttime listening
- Swipe easily to skip forward or backward
- Add bookmarks, notes, and highlights as you listen
Read Anywhere, Anytime
Libby is designed for everyone, including kids, teens, and adults. Whether you’re exploring new stories, catching up on bestsellers, or revisiting your favorite books, Libby keeps reading simple, fun, and accessible.
Built by OverDrive, Libby proudly supports public libraries and the joy of reading for all.
Download Libby today and turn your device into your personal library.

bluejetty:00119069:ios.description:
O Bookplay é uma plataforma com conteúdo educacional, informativo e de entretenimento. São mais de 100 mil livros, 3,5 mil áudios, 3 mil cursos, cursos de idiomas, revistas e jornais! 
Além de todo esse conteúdo, o Bookplay possui uma versão segura e didática para a criançada, com milhares de obras, atividades para imprimir, áudios e jogos. A plataforma também conta com um Clube de Benefícios, com ofertas e descontos especiais em alimentação, lazer, bem-estar, saúde, produtos e serviços.
Baixe o aplicativo e crie agora mesmo sua conta!
Como funciona?
 • Com uma única conta, você tem 3 perfis simultâneos e acesso ilimitado a todo o conteúdo.
 • Navegue por categorias, como Empreendedorismo, Educação, Literatura e Saúde, e encontre aquilo que mais combina com você.
 • Pesquise por títulos, autores, editoras ou palavras-chave.
 • Adicione seus livros e revistas favoritos à estante para ler mesmo sem estar conectado.
Conheça o Programa de Educação Continuada*
O Bookplay atua em parceria com a Faculdade Bookplay, instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC), no Programa de Educação Continuada (PEC). O PEC, além dos livros, áudios, jornais e revistas do Bookplay, disponibiliza cursos de pós-graduação, cursos livres e de extensão em 25 áreas do conhecimento, oferecidos pela Faculdade Bookplay. 
Para conhecer os Termos de Uso, acesse: bookplay.com.br/termos
*O Bookplay oferece livros, audiolivros, jornais e periódicos. A Faculdade Bookplay é responsável pela prestação de serviços educacionais. Consulte o contrato para mais detalhes.

bluejetty:00141798:ios.summary:
► A FANG-TASTIC SURVIVAL GAME

bluejetty:00141798:ios.description:
► A FANG-TASTIC SURVIVAL GAME
Ugh, all these humans are running around your castle, time to show them who’s in charge and make them fear you! This delightful vampire RPG will have you taking out enemies by the handful as you work to regrow your power and rid your dark kingdom of these pests – they seem to have forgotten what all those legends were based on. Along the way you’ll get to do battle with all manner of frightful creatures, explore dungeons, hunt, and be hunted! This survival simulator game is chock-full of excitement, not to mention cute characters and great visual effects that will keep you on your toes.
 ► REALLY SINK YOUR TEETH INTO IT
Begin the game by hunting down various groups of humans who have gotten into your castle, and stealing their blood – take it to the blood altar, and watch your powers grow! You’ll need those powers as you seek to stay the hunter, and not become the hunted. But it’s not just about battles and survival, this great goth vampire simulator also includes fun collectible pets and clothing items that will help you on your adventures.
◾ Great graphics – Just because you’re hunting in the dark doesn’t mean there can’t be amazing graphics! This game features exciting music and sound effects too, so make sure you pop on your headphones and turn up the volume to really get in the mood as you suck the blood from those nasty humans.
◾ Endless enemies and opportunities – You’ll never get bored of being the hunter! All manner of enemies endlessly spawn, giving you tons of opportunities to level up and collect new items. As your vampire powers grow you’ll be able to range further and further from your original dungeon, and get to explore the entire kingdom.
◾Collect them all – Hunting certain types of humans will earn you loot, which you can use to make yourself even stronger. Collect all sorts of cool clothing items that you can mix and match for the right balance of strength, defense, and goth realness in battles. And don’t forget to pick up a pet bat or two – not only will they help you, but they make the game that much more fun!
 ► STEAK IT OR LEAVE IT 
The ultimate vampire survival rpg awaits you, so download Blood Invasion today and get to hunting! This game centers on you, the vampire, as you set out to remind those silly humans that the legends and tales they like to tell are based on truth. Collect their blood and turn it into power as you explore dungeons and castles, but beware the vampire hunters who are out for YOUR blood! With cute graphics and lots of excitement, you won’t want to miss out!

bluejetty:00120748:ios.description:
Yomiwa is a dictionary, translator and optical recognizer designed to help you read, write and learn Japanese.
Yomiwa's powerful offline Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engine can recognize more than 4000 Japanese characters in your pictures or with your device camera. Yomiwa will help you read newspapers, books, menus, signs or your favorite mangas.
Yomiwa's dictionary is extensive, intuitive, fast, and delivers Japanese word details into more than 20 target languages. You can input words in any language, alphabet, or even by drawing.
Yomiwa helps you improve your Japanese with flashcards. Flashcards are a powerful and enjoyable way to learn new words. You can use flashcards to learn new words from the built-in lists or from your history. Then, based on your learning statistics, you will be shown everyday a deck of flashcards tailored for you.
Yomiwa features advanced Japanese text analysis. Paste or write some Japanese and the text analyser will break sentences into words, describe conjugate forms and display furiganas.
Unique social feature: whenever you have trouble with some Japanese, you can always ask a question or post a picture on the Yomiwa wall. Yomiwa's users, from beginner to advanced level, will come to help you.
EXTENSIVE DICTIONARY:
• Detailed information about words (~ 200K entries) and kanji (on-yomi, kun-yomi, meaning, stroke order, compounds etc.)
• Huge database of example sentences (> 250K) built from numerous sources
• Search definitions in any kind of alphabet: kanji / hiragana / katakana / romaji 
• Bidirectional dictionary: you can search from both Japanese words or from foreign words
• Look up conjugated forms, even if they are incomplete 
• Pitch accents for more than 60k words
• Handwriting Recognition

1Drop – Write anytime. No pressure
Have you ever had a moment like this? You want to note something down, but get tripped up by questions like, "Is this idea even worth saving?" or "What tag should I give it?" Gradually, the act of recording itself becomes a burden.
That's why 1Drop was created.
We believe every one of your thoughts has the right to be recorded, without having to go through any judgment. This is a truly "light" place, designed for you:
[ A Truly "Light" Space Means: ]
Capture Purely, Offload Instantly
Whether it's text, a photo, or a sudden voice memo, you can focus purely on expressing yourself. We'll handle the rest. With automatic voice-to-text transcription, reviewing is effortless.
Default to Today, Focus on the Present
Open the app and see only today's thoughts. We intentionally hide the long list of the past, so you can be with your present self, pressure-free.
Let Ideas Nap (Zzz)
Have a half-baked idea you can't bear to delete? Just let it "Zzz." It will disappear from your main feed, ready to be awakened whenever you need it. It’s the perfect cure for the "compulsion to organize."
Freedom from Tags & Folders
We are firm believers in no categories and no tags. All your thoughts flow naturally in chronological order. You don't need to be a librarian; you just need to be a free thinker.
Your Personal AI Butler [Pro]
Converse with your past self through powerful semantic search; discover forgotten sparks of inspiration with your "Weekly Rewind." (More AI capabilities are continuously evolving.)
Private & Secure iCloud Sync
All your data is saved securely in your own iCloud account. We never read, analyze, or upload any of your content. Your thoughts belong to you, and you alone.
[ Our Promise ]
1Drop is not a traditional notebook or a memo pad; it is a weightless container for the flow of your thoughts.
Here, every thought is a single drop of water, which will eventually gather into an ocean of memory that is uniquely yours.
Recording, without burden. Expression, without barriers.
Download now and begin your pressure-free recording journey.

Welcome to iList, a third-party client designed specifically for OpenList/AList users. Whether you’re streaming audio and video, browsing cloud photo albums, or managing files of all kinds, iList provides an intuitive, effortless experience.
About the App
iList lets you add OpenList/AList servers or share links as storage drives. Browse, search, add files to favorites, upload and download files, and perform batch file operations. You can also manage multiple servers, account credentials, and access URLs, and switch between them whenever you like!
What Makes iList Stand Out
- File Browsing: Display folders and files together. Set and save a different sort order for each folder, so there’s no need to reconfigure it when switching folders.
- Favorites: Add files and folders to your favorites for quick access to the content you love.
- Photos: Preloading and Scroll View support make browsing smoother.
- Video: Supports subtitle effects, bilingual subtitles, gesture controls, and video zoom. iList can automatically select subtitles based on your preferences, save playback progress, and open VLC, Infuse, and other apps for streaming or local playback.
- Audio: Supports playlists, line-by-line and word-by-word synced lyrics, sleep timers, and audiobook progress tracking. Audio can also be downloaded in advance for seamless transitions.
- PDF: View PDF files directly in the app.
- Text and Code Files: View and edit text and source code files.
- Servers: Supports multiple servers, multiple users, and even multiple Endpoints. On launch, iList can automatically select the appropriate Endpoint for your internal or external network. You can also add share links as read-only storage drives.
- Independent Passcode Lock: Unlike a system-level app lock, iList’s built-in passcode lock provides an extra layer of privacy when sharing a device.
Privacy
iList contains no advertising or analytics SDKs, and the developer does not actively collect your personal information.
Your server addresses, account credentials, access history, favorites, and cache are stored locally on your device. The files you access and related data are processed by the OpenList/AList service you configure.
Please note: iList is a third-party client and does not provide OpenList/AList servers. Before using the app, make sure you have permission to access the relevant servers, accounts, files, and share links.

apple-itunes:1471394318.name: Weather on the Way
apple-itunes:1471394318.description:
Weather on the Way is a route weather app for iPhone, iPad and CarPlay. It shows drivers, motorcycle riders and RV owners the forecast for every point on their route, timed to when they'll be there, so they can pick the best time to leave and miss the storm.
Enter where you're going and when. Then move the departure slider until the whole drive looks clear.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Pick the best time to leave. See rain, snow, wind and temperature along the route for any departure time in the next 7 days, and go in the dry window.
• Compare alternate routes and pick the dry one. Arrows on the radar show which way the storm is moving.
• Watch weather radar on CarPlay and see the storm cells ahead of you on the car screen.
• Check for wind and gusts before you tow into them.
• Read the road ahead in winter: National Weather Service alerts and advisories, closures, and road surface conditions (snow, sleet, wet road) reported by US state DOTs.
• Look at the road yourself on live traffic cameras from US state DOTs along your route.
• Plan multi-day drives. Add stops and overnight stays, and the forecast for the rest of the route moves with them.
• Find out when you'll be driving into the sun. Sunrise and sunset are marked on the route timeline.
• Check the route for family and friends. Share a link with route weather, even if they don't have the app.
Stop checking the weather for towns on the way and stitching them together in your head!
WHO USES IT
Motorcycle riders who want to avoid wet roads on every ride. RV owners and anyone pulling a trailer. Drivers who cross mountain passes and snow-belt interstates all winter. The passenger who plans the trip while someone else drives. Parents watching a kid's drive home from college.
"We have a 29ft travel trailer and I don't take off without checking weather conditions along my route, specifically wind and gusts." (App Store review)
"I can set my departure time and see just what the conditions will be all along my route." (App Store review)
QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK
How do I check the weather along my route and not just where I am now?
Enter your start, your destination and a departure time. You get the forecast for each point of the drive at the hour you'll pass through it: temperature, rain and snow, wind and gusts, visibility, UV and weather alerts.
What is the best time to leave to miss a storm?
Drag the departure slider and watch the route change. If Friday morning is wet and Thursday evening is dry, you'll see it before you pack.
Is there a weather radar app for CarPlay?
Yes. Weather on the Way puts live radar on the CarPlay screen, with arrows for the direction each storm is moving.
Does it work with Google Maps, Waze or Apple Maps?
Yes. Keep your navigation app. Send your route to Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze or Scenic for turn-by-turn directions, and get Live Activities and weather updates in the background while you drive. You can also load a route from a GPX file.
Where does it work?
Route forecasts work in more than 70 countries. Severe weather alerts cover the US, Canada, EU countries and Israel. Traffic cameras are US only. The app is in English and German. It plans car routes and has no truck routing.
What does it cost?
The route forecast is free. PRO adds alternate routes, departure planning for the days ahead and all weather layers. 7 days free trial, then $20 per year or $4.99 per month (US prices). Cancel anytime in the App Store. There is also a one-time Lifetime purchase, and a Family plan through Apple Family Sharing.
Rated 4.7 from 20,000 ratings on the US App Store. Featured in 9to5Mac, iMore, Stuff Magazine, Club MacStories and Travel Codex.

fdroid:com.ausha.receiver.name: Ausha
fdroid:com.ausha.receiver.summary: Listen to your computer's audio on your phone over Wi-Fi
fdroid:com.ausha.receiver.description:
Ausha turns your phone into a wireless speaker for your computer, and into the computer's microphone on the way back.
Whatever the computer is playing — music, a video, a call — comes out of the phone over your Wi-Fi, with a delay small enough to watch video against. Turn on call mode and the phone's microphone goes back the other way, so the phone works as a wireless headset for a call you take on the computer.
 You also need the sender on your computer 
This app is the receiver half of Ausha. On its own it does nothing: it needs the free Ausha sender running on a computer on the same Wi-Fi network. The sender is a Linux command-line program, built from the same source repository linked below.
 Pairing 
The sender prints a QR code. Scan it and audio starts. If your router passes mDNS the app also lists senders it finds on the network, so you can tap one instead.
 Built for a real Wi-Fi network 
Audio is Opus in RTP over UDP, in 20 ms frames. A jitter buffer, forward error correction and packet loss concealment handle the losses a normal access point produces, and clock drift between the two devices is corrected continuously so playback never slowly runs dry. You can trade delay against resilience: low, balanced or stable.
 Privacy 
Everything stays on your local network. There are no accounts, no servers, no analytics and no advertising identifiers. The app talks only to the computer you paired it with, authenticated by a pairing code the sender generates; audio can optionally be encrypted end to end. The INTERNET permission is used for local sockets only. The camera is used solely to read the pairing QR code, and the microphone only while call mode is switched on.
 Good to know 
• The sender currently runs on Linux; the Windows sender is written but untested, and there is no macOS sender yet.
• Use headphones on the phone in call mode. Echo cancellation on speakerphone has not been confirmed on real hardware, so without headphones the person you are talking to may hear themselves.
• Guest and hotel Wi-Fi networks often block device-to-device traffic, which stops Ausha from connecting.

fdroid:com.erenium.snaplock.name: Snaplock
fdroid:com.erenium.snaplock.summary: KeePass-compatible password manager. No account, no trackers
fdroid:com.erenium.snaplock.description:
Snaplock is an open-source, KeePass-compatible password manager that feels like part of Android. It works directly on your own encrypted .kdbx file: keep it on the device or sync it with any app you like, and use the same database with KeePassXC, KeePass or KeePassDX on your other devices.
Everything works offline. Two optional features go online only after you turn them on: the breach check against Have I Been Pwned, which sends just the first 5 characters of a password's SHA-1 hash, and site icon downloads, which ask each website for its own icon.
 Sign in everywhere 
 Autofill for apps and browsers, with suggestions in the keyboard
 One-time 2FA codes filled in after the password
 Passwords and passkeys in the Android 14+ sign-in sheet
 Passkeys are stored the KeePassXC way, so they also work in KeePassXC
 Offers to save new and changed logins
 Your database 
 Groups, custom fields, attachments, entry history and a recycle bin
 Password, key file or both, changeable at any time
 AES-256, ChaCha20 or Twofish with Argon2 or AES-KDF, and a one-tap benchmark for the key derivation
 Merges changes made on other devices instead of overwriting them
 A daily backup of the database file, kept on the device for 7 days
 Import from Bitwarden, Chrome, Firefox, 1Password, Proton Pass, LastPass and KeePassXC CSV exports, and export to CSV
 Passwords 
 Password and passphrase generator (EFF wordlist) with a strength meter
 Health check for weak, reused, old and expired passwords, with a tip for logins that could use 2FA
 TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes, added from a QR code or a setup key
 Share and find 
 Show a password, field or Wi-Fi login as a QR code for another device to scan
 Search through notes and custom fields, forgiving accents, punctuation and typing mistakes
 Part of Android 
 Material You colours, light and dark themes, per-app language
 Biometric unlock, auto-lock, blocked screenshots and clipboard clearing
 Quick Settings tile and launcher shortcuts
 The list and entry side by side on tablets and foldables
Every release is a reproducible build signed with the developer's key, so the APKs on GitHub and F-Droid are interchangeable.
Snaplock has no account, no ads and no trackers, and collects no data.
